articleTitle: Algorithmic Optimization and Synthesis Strategies for High-Performance Computing Integrated Circuit Design
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The objective of this research is to develop new algorithmic optimization and synthesis techniques in the IC design topography to enhance performance of High Performance Computing Platform. The Design employs GA and PSO algorithms for optimization to obtain enhanced desirable attributes like speed, power and area. The research demonstrates notable results: The proposed architectural enhancements provide memory modules with up to 22.3% increase in speeds, up to 12.3% cuts in power consumption for arithmetic units, and 15.2% improvements in area utilization for memory modules. Real-world testing supports these results, reporting the real execution speed of 2.1 GHz for simple logic gates, the real execution of 3.0 GHz for arithmetic units, real power consumption values of 0.5 W and 1.0 W, and average thermal output that ranges from 75°C to 85°C. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed methodologies in improving IC design for the high-performance computing applications by providing remarkable improvement in performance and power consumption..

articleTitle: Optimizing Early Lung Cancer Detection with Divide and Conquer Kernel SVM and Radial Basis Function Neural Network enchanced by SMOTE
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The medical condition referred to as cancer is characterized by aberrant cell growth that spreads across the entire body. Lung cancer develops from aberrant cell development in the lungs. The primary respiratory control system in the body, the lungs are in charge of making sure that every region of the body obtains oxygen. It cleans the air and keeps undesirable materials and germs out of the body. Every organ has the ability to fight against infections and inflammation according to our immune system. However, occasionally they are insufficient to combat these infections, inflammations, and even cancerous cells. It is inevitable that this will eventually develop cancer. Lung cancer is classified in stages 0 through 4. A patient's chances of survival are great if lung cancer is detected in its early stages, or stage 0 or stage 1. There is an extremely low survival rate if the cancer is discovered in its advanced stages. For this reason, early detection of breast cancer is crucial. For the prediction of lung cancer, there are numerous medical diagnostic techniques available such as X-ray, Lung cancer Screening. However, there are situations where these diagnostic techniques provide false positives or false negatives and force patients to undergo unnecessary treatments. Alternative strategies are required to prevent these consequences associated with lung cancer predictions. Although there are a number of computerized techniques available for predicting lung cancer, their accuracy is similarly inadequate. We have therefore developed a model that uses Radial Basis Function Neural Network algorithms and Divide and Conquer Kernel Support Vector Machine Learning techniques to predict lung cancer in its early stages using the lung cancer patient databases from Kaggle. This is done in order to overcome these conventional methods. Accuracy, Precision, and Recall are the metrics used to assess the performance of these algorithms. Neural networks provide superior accuracy of 98.5 when compared to algorithms such as Support Vector Machine. The dataset is preprocessed using techniques including the approach known as SMOTE to solve the problems of class imbalance.

articleTitle: Analysis of Big Data and its Disruption via Data Mining Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The development and implementation of computer technologies have been very fruitful, leading to the generation of massive amounts of data that need analysis. The collected data, however, is a major source of concern due to the high risk of its exploitation or public disclosure. While there are several options for archiving this data, none of them are ideal since they lack scalability and efficiency, and address concerns related to data usefulness or privacy. With an efficient perturbation approach that leverages huge data via optimum geometric transformation, the suggested study offers a solution to such challenges. Using five classification algorithms and nine datasets, the suggested work was evaluated and tested for efficiency, scalability, accuracy, and attack resistance. The suggested approach outperforms previous privacy-preserving algorithms in experimental tests concerning attack resistance, scalability, execution speed, and accuracy.

articleTitle: Image Quality Assessment Metrics for Hyperspectral Image Compression Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: When it comes to hyperspectral image-based object detection, image quality is one of the most significant variables to consider. Evaluation of hyperspectral image quality based on the ground truth is necessary for authenticity. In actuality, however, it might be quite challenging to locate the truth of the matter. The evaluation of image quality is carried out using full reference measures, such as MSE (Mean Square Error) and PSNR (Peak Signal to Noise Ratio). In contrast to MSE and PSNR, two additional full reference metrics known as SSIM (Structured Similarity Indexing Method) and FSIM (Feature Similarity Indexing Method) have been developed in recent years with the intention of comparing the structural and feature similarity measures between reconstructed and original HS images on the basis of perception. The comparison of several image quality criteria is the major focus of this article in order to provide a complete picture.However, when viewed from the standpoint of representation, SSIM and FSIM are normalized, although MSE and PSNR are not. When viewed from the viewpoint of semantics, MSE and PSNR only give the absolute error, whereas SSIM and PSNR give the error based on perception as well as error based on saliency. Therefore, the SSIM and FSIM can be considered to be more easily comprehended than the MSE and PSNR. Some other image quality metrics for the hyperspectral image compression such as Bjontegaard Delta PSNR, Maximum Difference, Average Difference, Normalized Quality Index, Normalized Cross-correlation, Structural Content, Normalized Absolute Error and Structural dissimilarity can also use for the analysis.

articleTitle: Analysing Neural Network Techniques for Efficient Routing in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) play a crucial role in fields such as environmental monitoring, healthcare, and smart city infrastructure. Effective data routing is vital for enhancing network performance and prolonging the lifespan of network nodes. This paper presents a comparative analysis of neural network-based routing algorithms versus traditional protocols in WSNs. We assess their performance based on energy consumption, packet delivery ratio, and end-to-end delay under various network conditions. The findings highlight the potential of machine learning techniques in improving WSN routing protocols, leading to more intelligent and adaptive network management solutions. Future research could investigate the integration of other advanced machine learning models and their applications in large-scale and heterogeneous WSN environments.

articleTitle: IoMT & ML Model to Detect Stress in Human
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Today's fast-moving surroundings cause stress for heaps. Real-time stress administration may be troublesome, regardless of the allure of negative effects on tangible and insane fitness. ML, IoMT, and AI abilities change how we live and work and solve this question. "A Smart Biomedical Healthcare System to Detect Stress Utilizing IoT, Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence," intends to utilize physiological sensors like soul rate, hotness, dampness (sweat) sensors and first verbalizations to detect stress. The submitted approach can path and categories folk into "difficult" and "non-tense" circumstances. Our classification results manifest the advantage of our approach in certain-occasion stress identification. The main aim of the original search out supports a novel procedure of identifying early stress something did surroundings, knowledge atmospheres, and administrative settings to support laborers’ and scholars' welfare and someday increase productivity

articleTitle: Enhanced load forecasting utilizes Convolutional Neural Network and Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Power is now an integral part of any country's social and economic infrastructure. Because energy is so difficult to store, accurate load forecasting is critical for control providers to ensure a steady supply, plan accordingly, and cut down on waste. This research presents a new architecture for short-term load predicting using Deep Neural Networks. The design takes into account various input variables and processes them using the relevant components of the network. Use recurrent mechanisms to describe the implicit dynamics and convolutional neural network elements to extract rich characteristics from historical load order. Furthermore, use dense layers to convert various sorts of characteristics. The method's superiority is shown by experimental findings obtained from an extensive data set that includes hourly loads. The suggested approach is also quite multipurpose; thus, it may be used for other types of time series forecast problems.

articleTitle: Digit Recognition and Separation of Overlapped Digits using Deep CapsNet
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Separation of overlapping digits is observed as a very difficult task when done with human eye, but subsequently it becomes easy when computer vision is used for the same task. The authors have constructed a capsule network which recognizes and separates the overlapped digits. Small sized convolutional kernels were used for the first step of feature extraction which provides grained features this reducing the training parameters. The same process could also possibly be applied for overlapping alphabets and characters also. The process was further followed by insertion of capsule layer into the model which resulted in 93.08% accuracy. Finally the overlapped digits were separated and the image of each digit was reconstructed.

articleTitle: Implementation of Predictive Machine Learning Models for Accurate Crop Yield Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Agri-Photovoltaic (A-PV) system in India enhances the agricultural sector's resilience to climate change by balancing energy generation and food production. This is accomplished by bringing the temperature of the air close to the solar panels down. There is a payback period of 1.73 for the system, and the land equivalent ratio is 9.49 with this system. Enhanced interactions between land, food, and energy are among the key advantages. Other advantages include dynamic system adaptability, fewer land-use disputes, enhanced crop rotation, and improved livelihood development. However, in order to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals for medium and large-scale audiovisual system installations, additional study is required. According to the results of performance studies, Support Vector Machine (SVM) models performed better than Decision Tree (DT) models. articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Lifespan Prediction Modelling for Electric Submersible Pumps in Oil Wells
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: To maintain the output flow rate and prolong the life of oil wells, artificial lift is crucial to the petroleum industry. Electric Submersible Pumps (ESP) are a widely used artificial lift technique due to their ability to generate large flow rates in very deep wells. ESPs have a much shorter lifetime than anticipated, even though they are designed to function in harsh environments including corrosion, high temperatures, and high pressure. Because ESP intervention work is far more expensive than other artificial lift techniques, particularly for offshore wells, ESP failures result in production loss and raise replacement costs. Knowing when an ESP may fail is thus highly helpful in the oil production industry and affects how oil wells are designed, built, and managed. Using three machine learning algorithms—Decision Tree, Random Forest, and Gradient Boosting Machine—this study contributes to the construction of prediction models for ESP lifespan that take into account both dynamic and static ESP features. The model that produced the best results for ESP life cycle prediction was determined by comparing the output of various models. To predict the most influential characteristics on the length of ESP, this research also assessed the influence factor of different operational parameters. By knowing more about ESP behavior, early efforts to avert possible ESP failures may be realized thanks to the study's findings.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning-based Convolutional Neural Network Model for Alzheimer's Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The primary symptoms of Alzheimer's disease (AD), a neurodegenerative condition that progresses over time, are memory loss and cognitive decline, posing significant challenges to patients, caregivers, and healthcare systems worldwide. Early detection of AD symptoms is crucial for timely intervention and improved patient outcomes. In this study, we present a novel approach utilizing Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for the detection of Alzheimer's symptoms from neuroimaging data. The CNN model was trained on a diverse dataset of structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans, comprising both healthy individuals and patients diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease at various stages. Through meticulous training and validation processes, we achieved a validation accuracy of 91.35%, indicating the model's high accuracy in discriminating between healthy individuals and those with Alzheimer's pathology. Furthermore, the validation loss was minimized to 0.2597, reflecting the model's ability to effectively minimize errors and generalize to unseen data. The success of our CNN model in detecting Alzheimer's symptoms underscores the potential of deep learning techniques in revolutionizing the diagnosis and management of neurodegenerative diseases. By automatically learning intricate patterns and features from neuroimaging data, our model offers a valuable tool for early detection and personalized treatment strategies, ultimately improving patient care and clinical outcomes. In model findings contribute to the growing body of research at the intersection of artificial intelligence and healthcare, demonstrating the transformative impact of deep learning in addressing complex medical challenges.

articleTitle: Road Less Travelled: Travelling Using Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The travel and tourism sector has undergone a revolutionary shift thanks to augmented reality (AR), which provides immersive experiences beyond conventional sightseeing. This abstract presents a cutting-edge augmented reality application that uses flashcards to enhance travel and tourism by offering deeper exploration and instructive insights. Using the Unity Game Engine, Blender 3D, Vuforia, and Photoshop, this augmented reality application creates an interactive travel platform. The creation of 3D flashcards that consumers can scan with their mobile devices is the central idea. The tool allows users to superimpose digital content—which includes historical details, cultural context, and interactive aspects about landmarks, monuments, and destinations—onto the real world when they point their cameras towards these flashcards. This application has a lot of possibilities. It creates a stronger bond between visitors and the locations they visit by transforming passive tourists into knowledgeable and involved travelers. It gives users the ability to investigate historical sites, museums, and outdoor locations in more context, making every trip an educational experience. This AR app is also easily accessible, intuitive to use, and adaptable. For travelers of all ages and backgrounds, it is an indispensable tool that can be installed on ordinary devices. This augmented reality (AR) flashcard application opens the door for a new era of exploration, learning, and discovery as the travel and tourism sector strives to offer more immersive and educational experiences.

articleTitle: Optimizing EfficientNetB0 for Shoe Brand Identification: A Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The fast growth of the worldwide footwear market has increased brand competition among shoe companies, hence proper brand recognition from photographs is more important. The state-of-the-art CNN EfficientNetB0 is explored in this work to handle the difficult shoe brand categorization challenge. With a dataset taken from the Kaggle platform—46 photos spanning three well-known brands—Adidas, Converse, and Nike; it explores how deep learning might improve retail and e-commerce systems. Separated with suitable labels into training, validation, and test sets, the dataset guaranteed balanced representation and robust model training. The approach comprises in four phases: dataset collecting, preprocessing, model training and validation, and model evaluation. While noting areas for development, especially with Nike, the upgraded EfficientNetB0 model showed exceptional performance with an overall accuracy of 87% and dominated the categorization of Adidas. The study emphasizes the need of early trademark identification in maximizing business activities and fighting counterfeiting. The outcomes highlight the larger consequences of implementing creative artificial intelligence technologies such as EfficientNetB0 into the footwear sector, therefore offering the path for more creative and effective corporate processes.

articleTitle: Emotion Analysis in Animation: Applying MONAI-PyTorch to Tom & Jerry Cartoon Episodes
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: This research article investigates utilizing deep learning approaches using MONAI and PyTorch frameworks the categorization of emotional expressions in the animated series "Tom & Jerry". The study focuses on spotting in stylized cartoon figures emotions including anger, happiness, sadness, surprise, and ambiguity—a choreography where conventional emotion identification techniques generally fall short. Presumably based on ResNet50, a thorough dataset of annotated frames from "Tom & Jerry" episodes was assembled, pre-processed, and used to fine-tune a convolutional neural network (CNN) model, hence facilitating emotional classification. Evaluated by accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and accuracy, the model performs effectively in identifying some emotions but also draws attention to difficulties in less represented categories. This work provides insightful analysis of the possibilities of sophisticated deep learning methods for emotion recognition in animated content, therefore supporting artificial intelligence uses in multimedia and entertainment.

articleTitle: AI algorithms for Autonomous Robotics Navigation
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Robotic systems depend much on autonomous navigation since it allows them to operate on their own in environments constantly changing and lacking clarity. The most evolved artificial intelligence (AI) techniques applied in self-driving robot navigation are briefly reviewed in this work. These approaches call for classical methodologies, machine learning, and deep learning as well. We examine the advantages and drawbacks of numerous approaches applied in route planning, location finding, map creation, obstacle avoidance. We investigate how neural networks, sensor fusion, and reinforcement learning may be applied to provide increased dependability and flexibility for guiding systems. Case examples illustrating the advantages and drawbacks of applying artificial intelligence (AI) in practical contexts including service robots, drones, and self-driving cars abound. Combining modern AI algorithms with conventional approaches indicates that it is feasible to create self-driving robots more dependable and efficient based on the increased tracking performance.

articleTitle: IoT-Enabled Smart Retail Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The objective of this investigation of Internet of Things (IoT) technology in retail environments is to cause a revolution in efficiency by leading to improvements in both the efficiency of operations and the quality of the customer experience. The purpose of this article is to investigate Internet of Things (IoT) enabled smart retail environments, with a particular emphasis on the revolutionary impact of linked bias and detectors on ultramodern retail practices. Smart retail systems can optimize force operation, streamline force chain processes, and achieve the highest possible level of customer satisfaction through the use of real-time data collecting and analysis. Among the colorful Internet of Things operations that we investigate are smart shelves, automated checkout systems, and dynamic pricing. These are all examples of operations that lead to improved functional workflows and increased customer pleasure. Moreover, the study covers the difficulties associated with enforcing the outcomes of the Internet of Things (IoT), which include data sequestration, security companies, and the requirement for a resilient network structure. The paper highlights how Internet of Things technologies are fostering innovation and effectiveness in retail contexts by using case studies and recent breakthroughs. The results of our research indicate that the abandonment of the Internet of Things in retail settings has the potential to bring about significant benefits; nevertheless, to fully realize its potential, it is necessary to give careful thought to both technological and ethical counterarguments.

articleTitle: Supercapacitor Electrode Material using Asian Palmyra Palm as Activated Carbon Source
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Recently, a lot of focus is given to agricultural by products as source of activated carbon production because they are in expensive or free and environmentally friendly. Here in, Asian palmyra palm is utilized as carbon source in producing activated carbon with predominant micropore and high surface area using KOH as activation precursor. Two different activation temperature (650 °C and 750 °C) were studied. The correlation between structural characteristics, surface chemical properties of the samples and their electrochemical performance were studied. A BET surface area of 930.271 m2/g and 1715.436 m2/g were obtained for APP-650 and APP-750 respectively. articleTitle: Automated Machine Learning to Streamline Data-Driven Industrial Application Development
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The emergence of the fourth industrial revolution has resulted in a fundamental change in the way organisations function, highlighting the need to make decisions based on data. Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) has become a key tool in this revolution, allowing quick model building and deployment without data science skills. This article examines how AutoML simplifying data-driven industrial application development affects efficiency, precision, and scalability. AutoML basics and industrial applications. AutoML tools automate data preparation, feature selection, model selection, hyperparameter tweaking, and model assessment for machine learning. Automation saves time and effort in developing effective ML models. Compared to more conventional white-box modelling methods, machine learning has often been shown to be the better choice in practical industrial settings. Still, development-related human variables reduce the predictability of locating a solution near the theoretical optimum. In contrast, Hyperparameter optimisation, model selection, and feature extraction may all be fully automated using automated machine learning (Auto ML). The article shows how AutoML can simplify the creation of data-driven industrial apps using a well-known open dataset. AutoML is a breakthrough tool that can expedite data-driven industrial application development. AutoML democratises sophisticated analytics and helps enterprises maximise data to use for smarter, more effective operations by automating difficult machine learning procedures.

articleTitle: Implementation of Digital Tools in The Food Supply Chain for Reducing Food Wastage
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Agricultural Waste Management: An Innovative Approach to Sustainability. Waste management refers to the steps taken to gather, transfer, dispose of, recycle, and track trash. Reducing the negative impacts of garbage on the environment, human health, and aesthetics is the primary goal of waste management initiatives that aim to recycle waste. Agricultural, municipal, industrial, and mining waste are only a few examples of the many types of trash people generate. Medical and nuclear waste pose a greater threat than other types of trash. The methods used for waste management include incineration, pyrolysis, recycling, composting, anaerobic digestion, landfilling, and plasma gasification. Biogas is the byproduct of anaerobic digestion, which is a biofuel. The process of plasma gasification converts waste materials into energy. Recycling entails gathering waste materials, separating them, and then processing them again to create new goods. Due to the presence of rich nutrients and growth-encouraging components, vermicomposting produces vermicompost known as black gold, making it the preferred type of composting

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review Of Junctionless Transistors
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Owing to the advancements in the field of technology, the interspace between the junctions has been reduced to under 10 nm. Consequently, mandating exceedingly high concentration gradients. Intricacy in fabrication becomes the aftermath. Junctionless transistors serve as an alternative. In contrast to the classical MOSFET, a Junctionless transistor features identical doping in the source, channel, and drain regions, leading to a negligible concentration gradient. The Junctionless transistor switches off because of the variation in the work function of the semiconductor and the material of the gate. Transistors without junctions provide a substantial edge compared to conventional MOSFET devices. Their advantage lies in the non-existence of a p-n junction, leading to a simplified fabrication process. Improved short-channel effects are a perk. Ever since the fabrication of the initial Junctionless transistors, several other transistors of this kind, with structure variations, doping and gates have been proposed and investigated. This review paper aims to offer a straightforward yet comprehensive analysis of JLTs introduced in the past few years. It is observed that DG JLFET has a superior performance for different doping profiles than single gate. AlGaN/GaN FinFETs exhibit higher off state current than the GaN JL FinFETs. It is reported that InGaAs when compared to classical JLFETs have lesser deterioration owing to impurity scattering. When a germanium junctionless GAAFETs was compared to silicon one, it reported, reduced DIBL, Ion/Ioff ratio and SS. The Ge JLFET also exhibit a higher band gap of 2.36 eV when the film thickness in 1nm. It reduces to 0.86 eV when the film thickness is 3nm.

articleTitle: Load Frequency Control of Microgrid a Sliding Mode Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Load Frequency Control (LFC) is essential for maintaining the stability and reliability of microgrids, particularly in the context of renewable energy integration and fluctuating load demands. This paper examines a Sliding Mode Control (SMC) approach for LFC in microgrids. The proposed methodology addresses the non-linearities and uncertainties inherent in microgrid operations by utilizing the robustness of sliding mode control to enhance dynamic response and maintain frequency stability. The efficacy of the SMC strategy is evaluated through simulations under various operating conditions, including load disturbances and renewable energy fluctuations. Results indicate that the sliding mode-based LFC exhibits superior performance in terms of transient response, robustness against parameter variations, and the capacity to mitigate external disturbances compared to conventional control techniques. This approach presents a promising solution for modern microgrid systems aiming for high resilience and reliability.

articleTitle: Detecting Fake Political News on Social Media by Support Vector Machine Compared to Naive Bayes
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The primary objective is to enhance the precision of the Support Vector Machine and evaluate it in comparison to the Naive Bayes algorithm in terms of its ability to forecast fake political news on social media networks. This research work focuses on two groups: Support Vector Machine and Naive Bayes Algorithm, where each group is executed for 10 times. The ClinCalc software was used in calculating samples in which the alpha value is considered as 0.05, and the confidence interval of 95%. Result: There is a statistically significant difference between the algorithm used by Improved Support Vector Machine and Naive Baye with P value as 0.001 (Independent Sample t-Test P<0.05) in SPSS statistical analysis. The accuracy of the Improved method Support Vector Machine is 98.12%, which appears to be superior to Naive Baye of 95.03% correspondingly. Conclusion: According to the results, the Support vector machine has an accuracy of 98.12%, which is higher than the Naive Bayes accuracy of 95.03%.

articleTitle: Enhancing Weather Condition Detection with Fine-Tuned EfficientNetB3
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: For many different industries, including disaster management, transportation, and agriculture, accurate and timely classification of meteorological conditions—such as clouds, rain, shine, and sunrise—is vital. Focusing on the EfficientNetB3 model noted for both performance and computational efficiency, this work uses deep learning to progress weather condition classification. We obtain an astounding 97% classification accuracy by optimizing the EfficientNetB3 design. Balancing accuracy and efficiency, the model optimizes network depth, width, and resolution by use of a compound scaling technique. By means of extensive experimentation with a dataset of 1,125 photos split into training, validation, and testing subsets, the model shows its performance in practical settings. The outcomes draw attention to how well the model might improve resilience against negative weather and decision-making procedures. This work highlights the part advanced deep learning methods play in obtaining high-accuracy weather categorization, therefore promoting sustainable practices in disaster preparedness, agricultural output, and transportation safety.

articleTitle: Age Prediction of Transformer Oil Using Soft Computing Method
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The power transformer stands as a cornerstone within the electrical network. Central to the functioning of power transformers is the transformer oil, which serves the dual purpose of cooling and insulation. Over the time, the insulating properties of the transformer oil are degraded. Therefore, it becomes imperative to regularly monitor the condition of the oil to potentially predict its remaining lifespan. This study focuses on six key properties—moisture content, flash point, resistivity, interfacial tension, tan delta, and breakdown voltage (BDV). Data for these properties were collected from oil samples of ten operational power transformers with capacities ranging from 16 to 20 MVA, located in various power substations across the Indian state of Punjab. An Adaptive Neuro Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS) model is proposed to predict the age of loaded transformer oil samples, using the six parameters as input variables and the age as the output variable. The model is based on the Sugeno principle. The developed model is then used to estimate the age of unidentified transformer oil samples taken from the Anpara Power Project in India. The results showed a strong correlation, with a Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of 7.01 and a regression coefficient of 0.971, demonstrating a high level of accuracy in the age estimation of the transformer oil samples

articleTitle: Evaluation and Implementation of Optimal Classification Algorithms for Credit Card Fraud Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Nowadays, the credit card industry is more concerned about credit card fraud than any other problem. The main idea is to examine optional techniques used for fraud detection and to identify the different types of credit card fraud. Numerous strategies exist for lowering the prevalence of credit card fraud, each tailored to the specific threats faced by banks and the credit card industry. Credit card fraud prevention is the primary goal of implementing these measures. Existing methods have several unresolved issues that cause legitimate credit card customers to be mistakenly labelled as fraudulent. The amount of fraud in the financial sphere may be inferred from this paper's emphasis on integrating the best classification algorithm out of four distinct methods.

articleTitle: Certain Analysis of Continuous Flow in Water Treatment Unit to Enhance The Quality of Water By Using PID Controller Design on Comparison with PI Controller for Stability Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: In order to improve water quality, a PID (Proportional-Integral-Derivative) controller design is being implemented in this research article, which provides a thorough examination of continuous flow in a water treatment unit. This research seeks to establish the performance of the PID controller in increasing stability as opposed to determining the effectiveness of the PI controller. The credibility of the research investigates the dynamic behaviour of water treatment system by carrying out various investigations with experimental as well simulation approaches toward identifying thoroughly the responsiveness, robustness and capacity of improvement of the PID controller towards the overall quality of the water. In conclusion the findings of this study could supply valuable understanding in the improvement of water treat ment techniques and present an actualistic model to achieve infinite complex manage strategies thus ensuring better steadiness and water quality.

articleTitle: Facial Emotion Recognition Using CNNs: Implications for Affective Computing and Surveillance
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Human-computer interaction depends on facial expression detection, which also finds utility in mental health monitoring to improve digital environment user experiences. Perfect spotting Computer vision has always baffled emotions including rage, disdain, disgust, fear, happiness, neutrality, grief, and surprise. Since they can automatically generate hierarchical feature representations from raw visual data, CNN have been rather helpful tools in tackling these problems. This article presents a CNN-based method for facial emotion prediction by using the power of the network to detect minute changes in face features linked with different emotional states. Having been trained on a large collection of annotated facial photos, the suggested model achieved final accuracy of 92%. The results reveal in emotional computing, surveillance, and automated customer service the effectiveness and most likely applications of the model. This study helps sustainable digital technologies—, which might be applied in health, education, and well-being—to be always developed.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Stock Market Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: This study investigates the operation of deep literacy methods to prognosticate stock request movements. The purpose of this investigation is to improve the delicacy of soothsaying and the decision-making processes they include. Exercising advanced neural network infrastructures, such as convolutional and intermittent networks, the study examines the usefulness of these networks in analyzing literal stock data and relating patterns that are reflective of future price developments. To capture both time dependencies and complicated request signals, the investigation incorporates several deep literacy models, which are analogous to Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks and Motor infrastructures. In this research, the prophetic performance of these models is evaluated by conducting rigorous backtesting on real-world stock data. The results of this evaluation are compared with standard statistical and machine literacy methodologies. Deep literacy models have been shown to give considerable advancement, as demonstrated by the results, which emphasize their potential for providing practical perceptivity and strategic advantages in stock trading. Through the validation of the capacities of deep literacy in the management of the problems of fiscal request vaticination, this study contributes to the expanding field of fiscal analytics.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Models for Loan Default Forecasting: Accuracy Comparison
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: This research addresses the difficulty of accurately predicting loan defaults, which is essential for financial institutions to successfully manage credit risk. The study was conducted in order to solve this challenge. By using sophisticated machine learning algorithms and ensemble methodologies, the research improves the accuracy of predictions, which in turn enables financial institutions to make well-informed choices on lending and reduces the likelihood of incurring financial losses as a result of loan defaults. The aim of this work is to investigate the application of sophisticated machine learning classification techniques for the prediction of non-performance of bank loans. We obtained accuracy of 87%, 89% and 88% correspondingly using a variety of different classifiers including logistic regression, random forest and decision tree. With very high degrees of accuracy and robustness in its capacity to predict loan defaults, Random Forest became the classifier with best performance. The results have led to the rather successful use of ensemble techniques, especially Random Forest in detecting loan defaulters. This helps financial institutions in turn reduce credit risks.

articleTitle: Leveraging Advanced AI-Driven Pedagogical Strategies to Enhance English Listening Skills
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The impact that high-tech pedagogical tactics powered by artificial intelligence have on the development of English listening skills. We intend to achieve our goal of producing a literacy experience that is more individualized and effective by combining artificial intelligence with novel tutoring approaches. To analyze and cater to the specific needs of individual students, the research makes use of artificial intelligence technologies such as natural language processing, machine literacy, and adaptive literacy systems. These AI-driven approaches are aimed at improving the understanding and memory of spoken English using a combination of interactive exercises, real-time feedback, and content that has been acclimatized to the language. According to the major findings, students who practice these tactics demonstrate a considerable improvement in their ability to sharpen their chops when compared to those who practice traditional styles. Additionally, the paper investigates the possibility that artificial intelligence could eventually adapt to a variety of literacy styles and paces, thereby providing a scalable solution to the problem of language education. Based on our findings, it appears that the implementation of artificial intelligence in language teaching not only improves students' ability to harken but also encourages less engagement and provocation among students.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cooperative Spectrum Sensing Performance with Fusion Rule in Cognitive Radio: Hybrid Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The issue of limited wireless spectrum may be addressed with the use of Cognitive Radio (CR). Without affecting the primary users (PU), or licenced users, it allows other users, known as secondary users or unlicensed users, to exploit spectrum gaps, improving spectrum efficiency. Energy detection, a matching filter, and cyclostationary detection make up the CR, which determines whether the spectrum is idle or not. Cognitive Radio Networks (CRNS) are hindered in their ability to improve performance by noise. No signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) may be efficiently achieved with a cooperative spectrum employing a set sensing time in terms of throughput performance. There are two ways that this research suggests they might improve the effectiveness of energy detectors in the wireless spectrum. At its core, the first method is an energy detector-based hybrid of the Additive Wavelet Transform as well as the Homomorphic (AWTH). Mixing the Haar Discrete Wavelet Transform with the Homomorphic technique (HDWTH) is the basis of the second approach. The Two Quality Metrics Used: False Alarm Probability (Pf) and Probability Detection (Pd). The efficiency of the energy detector is enhanced by implementing the two methods that have been suggested. Metrics for quality demonstrate that the first method improves the wireless spectrum's Pd point perspective. But from a throughput perspective, the second strategy succeeds in maximising.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis for Prediction of Trending Footwear Classification using DensNet compared with Logistic Regression model
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The purpose of this work is to investigate the effectiveness of DensNet and Logistic Regression in terms of accurately predicting the classification of footwear trends.In this study, there are two groups: the Novel DensNet model and the Logistic Regression model. Each group is being iterated for a sample size of ten, which is being generated with the ClinCalc software. The alpha value is set at 0.05, and the confidence interval is set at 95%. We took into consideration the footwear prediction dataset that was available on Kaggle.com and had a size of 15854. The statistical analysis reveals a significant difference between the DensNet algorithm and the Logistic Regression model, with a value of p=0.001 (independent sample t-test p<0.05). The DensNet algorithm exhibits a significantly higher accuracy rate of 94.56% when compared to the Logistic Regression model, which records an accuracy rate of 90.62%.In comparison to the Logistic Regression model, the DensNet algorithm has a higher level of accuracy when it comes to predicting the Novel Footwear Trending situation.

articleTitle: Automation Using Robots, Machine Learning, and Artificial Intelligence to Enhance Production and Quality
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Automating everyday jobs, expanding production, and improving quality are all examples of how the integration of robotic automation and machine intelligence (AI) is causing activities to change. The purpose of this study is to examine the relationship between artificial intelligence (AI) and robotics, specifically focusing on how machine intelligence (ML) algorithms and AI approaches enable androids to do complicated jobs with greater efficiency and precision. Through the automation of everyday and repetitive tasks, organizations can redirect their workers into activities that are more important and innovative. Automated systems that are driven by artificial intelligence can learn and adapt from data, therefore rebuilding their performance over time and ensuring logical quality. This strategy not only increases productivity but also decreases the number of mistakes and the expenses associated with it. It is important to note that the associations of these gadgets stretch across a variety of fields, including manufacturing, healthcare, management, and departments that interact with consumers. This highlights the potential for wider financial and friendly advantages. A discussion of the difficulties and opportunities associated with the integration of mechanics is presented in the last section of the study. Particular attention is paid to the relevance of ongoing innovation and ethical considerations in the configuration of artificial intelligence and robotics.

articleTitle: Investigating Economic Load Dispatch Problems for Microgrids with Consideration of System Constraints
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Microgrids (MGs) are more important lately because of their power to expand the elasticity and efficacy of the electricity delivery system. ELD is a perilous optimization delinquent in MGs process that used to diminish operational prices while satisfying a various of system boundaries. This research discovers plentiful ELD problems for MGs, with a prominence on different system boundaries. It explores the mathematical preparations, explanation tactics, and issues intricate with ELD in MGs, accenting the implication with taking boundaries for operative MGs operation. The research highlights how imperative it is to have a well-intended plot for dealing electricity in MGs so that they can function sustainably. It stresses that academician should endure working on verdict answers for new glitches and employing new skills. This way, MGs can become more vigorous and frugally effective in the elongated period.

articleTitle: A Dense Residual Network-50 Model for Identification of Real and Fake Images
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence has led to the creation of highly realistic synthetic images, posing significant challenges in distinguishing them from real images. This study addresses this issue by employing a ResNet-50-based model to classify AI-generated and real images. The dataset comprises 120,000 images, equally divided between REAL images from the CIFAR-10 dataset and FAKE images generated using Stable Diffusion version 1.4. The model's architecture integrates batch normalization and dropout layers to enhance training stability and reduce overfitting. Results indicate a steady improvement in training accuracy, reaching 98.87% by the 22nd epoch, with a corresponding decrease in training loss to 0.0457. The validation accuracy stabilized at 95.59% from the 11th epoch onwards, while validation loss fluctuated, settling at 0.1887 by the 22nd epoch. These outcomes demonstrate the model's robust capability to distinguish between real and AI-generated images, highlighting its potential for applications in digital forensics, content verification, and intellectual property protection. The integration of explainable AI techniques further enhances the model's transparency and reliability, ensuring user trust in its classifications. This research contributes to the ongoing efforts to develop reliable methods for synthetic image detection and emphasizes the importance of early detection in maintaining content authenticity.

articleTitle: Novel Game Puzzle Methods Based Optimal Placement of Modules in PV Array Reconfiguration
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Present investigation provides a comparative examination of the conventional Series-parallel (SP) arrangements and the novel game puzzles 1 & 2 (GP-1 & GP-2) arrangements for photovoltaic (PV) arrays under partial shading conditions (PSCs). The results emphasize the efficacy of the proposed reconfiguration strategies based on the GP-1 and GP-2 in improving the performance of commercial PV systems through MATLAB/Simulink simulation study. The study indicates that the GP-2 configuration obtains a higher Global Maximum Power Point (GMPP) of 112.9W under shading scenarios compared to conventional SP and GP-1 configurations as 92.84W and 107.3W respectively. The HS-SRA configuration is a prospective solution for improving PV array efficiency under different shading conditions, as it exhibits a substantial decrease in power loss.

articleTitle: Enhancing The Accuracy In Predicting Wine Preference of Customers Using K-Nearest in Comparison With Random Forests
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Improvement of the exactness in terms of when predicting wine preference by K-nearest (KNN ) than random forests (random forest) The code is written and run by using the dataset of the table format. Clinicalc.com is utilised to determine the test sample size which is estimated at a minimum of 2 samples per group or subgroup with a confidence interval of 85% with an alpha error rate of 0. accuracy of 05 and a G power of 85%. The findings reveal that the accuracy of the KNN of accuracy 85 87 percent yielded percent yielded the highest percentage. 00%. and random forest of accuracy of 78. 00%. The results of conducting the sample t-tests mean that, yes, there are differences among these groups, and the observed differences are statistically significant. In this case, the outcome indicates that the KNN algorithm has a better outcome than the random forest algorithm with statistically significant differences. We at last concluded that out of the available algorithm the KNN algorithm will be most suitable for us.

articleTitle: A Comparative Evaluation for False Data Injection Attacks using Bagging Classifier and XGB Classifier in enhancing the Control System Security
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: To secure control systems against false data injection attacks using Bagging Classifier compared with XGB Classifier. The open-source lab at Saveetha School of Engineering served as the study site for this project. The necessary data has been gathered, preprocessed, and comparison metrics acquired for the research. The Bagging Classifier and XGB Classifier are the two groups involved in this study. We compared the accuracy of each of these machine-learning algorithms using various sample sizes. For the Identification of False Data Injection Attacks utilizing Bagging Classifier and XGB Classifier to increase accuracy, Bagging Classifier of value of 98.9% is more accurate when compared to XGB Classifier value of 97.2%. As the values have been discussed earlier, the significance value is yielded by the software as p=0. Values of p <0. 010 (p<0. 05) have shown significant difference when using bagging Classifier compared to XGB Classifier when determining False Data Injection Attacks that will improve accuracy. FDIAs are significant threats to industries such as Banking and heath care and their detection can identify them with 98%. Remind that the level of 6% accuracy is achieved when Bagging and XGB Classifier are combined. Machine learning allows for proactive, real-time detection, offering improved cybersecurity despite resource constraints and changing threat strategies. FDIA identification will be strengthened by future developments in blockchain data integrity, AI-driven detection, and strict restrictions. To remain ahead of developing dangers, proactive actions and compliance-driven expenditures are essential. The Bagging Classifier outperforms the XGB Classifier, which detects False Data Injection Attacks (FDIA), with an accuracy of 98.9%. When compared to XGB Classifier in the research, it exhibits a better learning capacity for FDIA recognition, proving its increased accuracy.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Particle Swarm Optimization in Agricultural Based System
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The design and application of particle swarm optimization (PSO) in an agriculturally based system are presented in this article. In the current study, PSO application was used to create the ideal planting pattern in farming. Economic and environmental considerations must be taken into account in order to develop the finest designs. There are four main objectives that have been determined: raising the net earnings of farmers, cutting back on water use in the agriculture sector, and utilizing fewer chemical fertilizers and pesticides. The results clearly showed that the current cropping approach needed to be adjusted. The PSO-based cropping method that has been recommended has optimized financial and environmental ideas to the fullest.

articleTitle: Wireless Health Monitoring for Calculating Vitals Device by Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The fast evolution of the Internet of Things (IoT) has paved the way for innovative healthcare solutions. This paper affords the format and implementation of a wireless health monitoring device the use of IoT technology. The tool continuously tracks critical signs and signs along with coronary heart rate, blood pressure, and oxygen saturation, transmitting real-time facts to healthcare providers. The proposed solution enhances affected man or woman care with the useful resource of the usage of allowing early detection of anomalies and properly timed medical intervention. The paper discusses the architecture, hardware components, software program software integration, and functionality challenges, offering insights into future trends in IoT-enabled healthcare.

articleTitle: Leveraging Naive Bayes to deciphering online posts for detecting Depression and Anxiety
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The perennial challenge of accurately identifying and managing depression has become even more pressing with the societal upheavals of recent times. Historically, depression detection relied heavily on self-reported symptoms and clinical evaluations, methods that, while invaluable, have their limitations in terms of scope and timeliness. As mental health issues increasingly impact communities worldwide, affecting productivity, quality of life, and overall well-being, the need for more robust detection tools has become critical. Enter the era of machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL), which has revolutionized this domain. Present techniques utilize algorithms that parse through vast datasets, unveiling patterns and correlations that may escape traditional analysis. Our research integrates these advanced computational strategies with psychological insights to address depression more effectively. Using a novel hybrid model that combines textual and auditory data, our approach achieves a nuanced understanding of depressive indicators. The results are promising: with an accuracy rate peaking at 93.4% , precision rates hovers around 99%, and f1-scores ranging from 0.54 for challenging classes up to an impressive 0.96, we demonstrate a significant leap forward in mental health diagnostics. These figures not only represent numerical triumphs but also signal a new chapter in mental health care, one that is more accessible and informed by the nuanced complexities of human emotion and expression.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Print and Electronic Media on Brand Equity Using AI and Data Science Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The impact of print and electronic media on brand equity is analysed in this study using state-of-the-art artificial intelligence and data science techniques. In order to preserve a competitive advantage, it is essential to consider brand equity, which is influenced by a variety of media. When it comes to establishing a brand's value, both traditional print media and contemporary electronic media have their own set of advantages and disadvantages. The efficacy of digital and print media in establishing brand equity is evaluated and analysed in this study using artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms and data science methodologies. The study employs sentiment analysis, data visualisation tools, and machine learning algorithms to examine the relationship between brand equity ratings and media content. The objective of this analysis is to provide marketers and brand managers with essential information that will aid in the optimisation of their media strategies. The goal is to increase client engagement and elevate the brand's value.

articleTitle: AR Journeys: Enhancing Tourism Through Interactive Globe Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The augmented reality globe for travel and tourism is a ground-breaking application that utilizes cutting-edge technology like Blender, Adobe Photoshop, Unity Gaming Engine 3D, and Vuforia. In collaboration with cultural experts and tourist agencies, it compiles a comprehensive database of historical information, traditions, and destinations for every country. Users are provided with a dynamic platform to explore the world's unique cultural fabric more deeply through this immersive experience. The interactive globe, when paired with accurate information and 3D models, changes the travel experience by offering an engaging and educational journey. Beyond entertainment, the app has the potential to revolutionize the travel and tourism industry by encouraging eco-friendly travel and the preservation of rich cultural legacies. Since it deftly blends technology and cultural knowledge, the augmented reality-based globe marks a huge advancement in fostering global awareness and appreciation for the diversity of cultures around the world.

articleTitle: Dual Axis Solar Tracking System with Weather Sensing
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: This paper presents a two-axis sun tracking mechanism that harnesses solar energy to provide renewable and environmentally friendly energy. A dual-axis solar tracker produces power efficiently by following the sun and takes in as much radiation as possible occupying the same space as a single-axis solar tracker does, thus effectively utilizing the land. A simple two-axis sun monitoring mechanism is employed within the proposed project's design and implementation to follow the sun's rays as they approach the solar panel from various angles and increase solar energy output. The prototype’s central processing unit, the Arduino UNO controller integrates a solar panel, servo motors, LDR’s, Temperature sensors and an LCD to carry out all tasks. The primary objective of this venture is to improve performance by positioning the photovoltaic panels to face the sun continually in all four directions to achieve optimal radiation intensity and yield a maximum energy conversion. The microcontroller uses the voltage from the panel, which is calculated once per hour, to sense the ambient weather and climatic conditions. The LDR sensor measures how much sunlight is striking the photovoltaic panel. The panel is moved by servo motors so that it is nearly perpendicular to the solar irradiance. The buck converter serves to maintain a steady power flow across the circuit, increase the battery life, lessen heat, and safeguard against high voltage. The system's prototype was constructed affordably and tested in real-world situations.

articleTitle: Real-Time Bottle Classification Using MobileNetV2: An Evaluation of Beer, Plastic, Soda, Water, and Wine Bottle
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: In several fields, especially retail, recycling, and trash management, object classification is important. This paper investigates five types of bottles: Beer Bottles, Plastic Bottles, Soda Bottles, Water Bottles, and Wine Bottles using a convolutional neural network (CNN). Based on a 25,000-image balanced dataset, the paper evaluates MobileNetV2's F1 score, accuracy, precision, and recall. Plastic bottles show almost perfect accuracy and recall of 99%, so the model attained an astounding general accuracy of 97%. Additionally showing great accuracy rates of 97% and 98%, respectively were water and beer bottles. The model clearly distinguishes between bottle types despite small misclassifications, including Soda Bottles being sometimes confused with Beer Bottles. Good model tuning with low over fitting is shown by the study of training and validation losses. The model's resilience even further is confirmed by the close alignment of the training and validation accuracy. The confusion matrix points up various misclassifications, which offer information for the next developments. This work highlights MobileNetV2's great fit for real-time bottle categorization uses, therefore providing major advantages for retail and recycling sectors of industry automation. Future research will concentrate on improving the model to solve found misclassification problems and raise its practical relevance.

articleTitle: Lemon Perfection: Leveraging VGG16 Deep Learning for Superior Quality Assessment
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: This work intends to improve lemon quality evaluation by means of photo categorization applied with the VGG16 deep learning model. Lemons need perfect quality control to keep their attraction and commercial success; their vibrant colour, acidic taste, and high vitamin C content call for this. Early diagnosis of quality problems can help to enhance consumer satisfaction and lower post-harvest losses. From a Kaggle dataset, the research groups 2,523 images—each with 300x300 pixels—into empty backdrop, great quality, and horrible quality lemons. Having been trained and tested on this dataset, the VGG16 model—known for its accuracy and efficiency in picture classification—achieves an incredible 97% classification success rate. Research on automated photo classification show that it increases efficiency, lowers labour costs, and offers smart data-driven analysis to help to maximize production processes and so raise lemon industry general profitability.

articleTitle: Mapping the Landscape: A Bibliometric Analysis of Deep Learning in Cardiac Research (2014-2024)
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Deep learning has emerged as a promising technology in the field of biomedical signal processing, particularly for the purpose of automating the identification and categorization of cardiac arrhythmias based on electrocardiogram (ECG) data. The purpose of this study is to offer an introduction to deep learning algorithms for identifying and categorizing ECG arrhythmias. Additionally, a bibliometric analysis of research publishing trends, citation patterns, author collaborations, and institutional affiliations is presented. In the introduction, the clinical significance of ECG arrhythmias, the comparison between traditional methodologies and deep learning methodology, the most common deep learning architectures, the datasets that are extensively utilized, and the criteria for performance evaluation are discussed. There is also a discussion of the difficulties and potential advances that lie ahead in the field. Quantitative insights into academic production are provided by the bibliometric study, which highlights notable contributors, newly emerging research concerns, and possible areas for future growth. In order to facilitate collaboration and foster innovation in cardiovascular healthcare, the purpose of this study is to provide a comprehensive understanding of the current state-of-the-art in deep learning for ECG arrhythmia detection and classification. This will be accomplished through a systematic analysis of research trends and a synthesis of the existing literature.

articleTitle: Integrating Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) Methods to Produce Reliable Wind Power Predictions
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Wind energy forecasting is crucial for effective implementation due to weather instability and unpredictability. Seamless incorporation into contemporary electricity systems. Various methodologies and strategies have been used and utilized to achieve precise wind power prediction over a wide range of timeframes. Every approach has advantages and disadvantages. This study first examines the current uses of Machine Learning and Deep Learning methods in wind power and wind speed predictions. An extensive examination and classification of the most significant forecasting techniques has been conducted. Simultaneously, thought-provoking conversations are offered to facilitate the examination of all the topics presented. Two algorithms, one from machine learning (ML) and the other from deep learning (DL), have been chosen and used to anticipate wind power. The findings have shown the strong capacity of both algorithms to accurately capture the characteristics of the produced power. Additional analyses of the outcomes about their correctness and prospects are being contemplated.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Improve Diabetes Prediction Accuracy using the Adaboost Algorithm Compared with a Naive Bayes Classifier
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: We evaluate the accuracy of predictions made by Naive Bayes using data from this research and compare it to that of new adaboost methods. Naive Bayes and innovative adaboost algorithms were used to predict diabetes based on a sample size of 10, with 0.05 serving as the alpha value. The G-Power was 0.8, and the confidence interval was 95%. The sample size was 10 at various periods, and the G-Power was 0.8. One of the new adaboost algorithms has an accuracy percentage that is substantially greater than the accuracy percentage of Naive Bayes, which is 93.44%. This is because the accuracy percentage of one of the novel adaboost algorithms is 96.36 percent. Moreover, the statistical study conducted demonstrated a statistically significant difference between the Adaboost Algorithm and the Naive Bayes Algorithm, with a 2-tailed value of p=0.009 (p<0.05 being the significance level). When compared to the Naive Bayes technique, the Adaboost method, which is a new approach, has lower accuracy.

articleTitle: Parametric Optimization and Mathematical Analysis of Dual Halide Lead Free Perovskite Solar Cell
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The scientific community has recently taken an interest in perovskite solar cells, often known as PSCs. Dual halide PSC has the best efficiency reported in the literature at 20.9%. The purpose of this work is to improve a lead-free dual halide photovoltaic (PSC) by modifying the material of the hole transport layer (HTL) and the electron transport layer (ETL), as well as regulating the thickness of the absorber layer. In order to evaluate the device, the following metrics are taken into consideration: fill factor (FF), power conversion efficiency (PCE), open circuit voltage (VOC), and short circuit current density (JSC). With optimization, the gadget can reach an efficiency level of 24.03%. Further investigation into a tandem or dual structure method may be possible with this work.

Author Keywords: electron and hole transport layer dual halide lead-free PSCs

articleTitle: Optimizing Rainfall Prediction: A Comparative Study of General Type-2 and Interval Type-2 Fuzzy Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Rainfall prediction is vitally important in the agricultural, hydrological, and meteorological sectors. Correct rainfall prediction is becoming more difficult with the increasing impact of change in climate on rainfall patterns. In the recent years, fuzzy logic-based methods came to be progressively used for rainfall pre-diction. This study represents a comprehensive comparative analysis of two prominent fuzzy logic paradigms, General Type 2 Fuzzy Systems (GT2FS) & Interval Type 2 Fuzzy Systems (IT2FS) to optimize prediction of rainfall. IT2FLS has the benefit of handling skepticism and obscurity better than standard fuzzy logic systems. The comparative study includes the analysis of prediction preciseness, agility, and computational ability. In addition, the interpretability and adaptability of the fuzzy models has been surveyed, that are necessary for the practical applications in the decision support systems. Rainfall prediction is a knotty task that involves analyzing multiple meteorological facts and their relationships to forecast coming times precipitation.All-inclusive, this research put up to the advancement of the rainfall prediction methods by assisting with a detailed comparative analysis of two fuzzy logic paradigms. The outcome can guide the researchers, practitioners, and policymakers in picking out the most befitting approach for optimizing rainfall prediction models, thereby refining our capacity to manage water resources and lighten the impacts of extreme weather events.

articleTitle: NeuroOpt: Bridging Neural Networks and Optimization for Liver Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Liver illnesses, which range in severity from viral infections and fatty liver disease to more serious problems like cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma, are a widespread and urgent worldwide health concern. The development of an accurate and economical diagnostic model is crucial to identify liver disease in its early stages. In light of this, a brand-new, incredibly accurate NeuroOpt model is presented in this publication to help identify and categorise patients' liver disease stages. The suggested model uses a hybrid Grasshopper Optimisation Algorithm (GOA) and Whale Optimisation Algorithm (WOA) to self-tune its neural network architecture, which improves its illness classification performance. Furthermore, the suggested work additionally makes use of a strong and efficient hybrid feature selection approach to carefully choose important properties from the provided dataset. The results of the experiments demonstrate that the suggested model is successful in detecting disease in patients, with a 97% binary classification accuracy on the ILPD dataset and a 98.9% accuracy on the multi-stage disease classification of the CPD dataset.

articleTitle: Enhance Image Quality by Implementing Deep Residual Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Computer vision research, Single Image Super Resolution (SSIR) aims to use creative ways to generate high-resolution pictures from low-resolution. Autonomous cars, remote target detection, medical/satellite imaging, and many more areas may benefit from SSIR. Deep learning methods have lately been popular in SISR as an alternative to classic approaches based on interpolation. This is because of their higher efficiency and computational cost. An Auto encoder-based deep-learning Model for SSIR is suggested in this paper. Without subsampling layers, the down-sampling portion of the Autoencoder mostly employs 3 by 3 convolutions. To do up-sampling, the down-sampling section makes use of residual connections and transpose convolution. To train the model, use data from both the Real SR database and a portion from the VILRC Image Net database. In the tests, quantitative indicators like PSNR and SSIM reach values of 0.94 and 76.07, respectively. Qualitative metrics, including perceptual quality, were also used.

articleTitle: A Blockchain-Based Framework for Securing Digital Documents Using Off-chain Attribute-Based Encryption
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Preventing unwanted access and tampering is essential to digital document security. This study introduces an innovative approach that combines blockchain technology with an off-chain attribute-based encryption (ABE) framework to strengthen digital document security. There are seven different categories of digital papers: travel documents, health records, financial documents, legal documents, educational certificates, and automobile registrations, among others. Documents can be uploaded by users to off-chain storage. In order to access documents, organizations need to navigate attribute-based encryption on the off-chain platform. The combined off-chain and on-chain architecture is designed to optimize blockchain throughput while using user processing power. The framework that is being suggested will control the availability of electronic documents and provide users with a trackable setting so that they can keep an eye on which companies are accessing and using materials. In the end, this framework seeks to improve users' digital rights by offering strong control and supervision over document access and usage.

articleTitle: Analyzing Signal Distortion Using Enhanced Novel Low Noise Amplifier In Comparison With Audio Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The purpose of the present study is to analyse and compare, by applying the amplitude variation of Signal Distortion techniques through the use of a Novel Low Noise Amplifier (LNA) with the existing audio amplifiers in Audio Signal Processing context. The two groups of components considered are a low noise amplifier and an audio amplifier, and the nurturing consisted of fifteen samples of each type. The first important analysis of the novel low noise amplifier and audio amplifier is f 80 being the maximum signal distortion. Overall, the results reveal 73 % distortion and 86 of the 100 sampled reports are distorted. A novel low noise amplifier was thus designed at an Amplitude of 150 V with a % distortion of 19 % %, 19 % % respectively to evaluate the importance of improved interconnects with copper hence do an Independent T-test took a p=0. 049 (p<0. 05). The research findings in this study clearly suggest that the new low noise amplifier offers better results than audio amplifiers.

articleTitle: Enhanced Cybersecurity through Advanced Phishing Detection using ML-driven Classification Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: One of the most significant cybersecurity threats is phishing attacks, which target users through deceitful websites to capture sensitive information.
