There has been an interest in using machine learning (ML) for phishing websites because it promises a rise in accuracy and the reduction of false positives. This research aims to carry out a comparative study of three advanced boosting algorithms, XGBoost, CatBoost, and LightGBM (LGBM) are utilized to detect phishing websites. It was trained and tested on a data set of 11,430 URLs with 87 features. The results show that CatBoost has better performance than XGBoost and LGBM by achieving an accuracy of 97.37%, precision of 97.5%, recall of 97.6%, and F1-score of 97.2%. In contrast to this, XGBoost and LGBM have competitive performance but with lower values of the performance metrics. This study stresses early detection as a crucial approach toward the mitigation of phishing attacks, with some related boosting algorithms in the rich feature environment. These developments could do much in promoting cybersecurity framework reinforcement for stronger protection against ever-evolving phishing attacks.

articleTitle: Deep Convolutional Networks for Flower Species Recognition: A ResNet Study
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Research on deep learning approaches of flower classification has been mostly focused on key implications for environmental monitoring, botany, and horticulture. Usually labour-intensive and prone to inaccuracies, conventional methods of floral identification rely largely on professional knowledge and manual judgment. Aiming high accuracy in identifying between five different flower classes: Lily, Lotus, Orchid, Sunflower, and Tulip, this work presents a solution using a revised fine-tuned ResNet model. Using a dataset obtained from Kaggle encompassing varied photos of these flowers, the model goes through a rigorous training procedure by means of data augmentation techniques including rotation, flipping, and scaling to boost its resilience and generalizing capacity. By splitting the dataset into training, validation, and test sets, stratified sampling ensures fair representation over all classes. Performance evaluation is done with accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score; error analysis provides insight of misclassification tendencies. The improved fine-tuned ResNet model reveals the outstanding high-precision floral recognition ability of the model and achieves an incredible accuracy of 95%, thereby differentiating the flower classes. This work presents a significant response for exact and rapid floral classification and shows how well deep learning changes automated plant identification.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Predicting LIC Stock Price using Lasso Regression Compared with Random Forest Regression
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: With regard to the objective of the entire study, the goal is to improve the accuracy of predicting stock price using Lasso Regression in comparison to Random Forest Regression. The Novel K-Nearest Neighbors and Support Vector Machine Algorithm are the two groups that are the emphasis of this research activity. Each of these groups is carried out ten times. For the purpose of calculating samples, the Clincal software was utilized. The alpha value was determined to be 0.05, and the confidence interval was set at 95%. We took into consideration the stock price prediction dataset that was available on kaggle.com and had a size of 12617. With a value of p=0.000 (Independent sample t-test p<0.05), the SPSS statistical analysis prediction of stock price demonstrates that there is a statistically significant difference between the Lasso regression algorithm and Random Forest Regression. This data indicates that the Lasso regression algorithm is superior to Random Forest Regression. For the Random Forest regression technique it obtained a percentage accuracy of 84%, while in the new improved Lasso regression approach it records a greater level of accuracy of 93%. The comparison of Random Forest Regressions and Lasso Regressions in the progress of predicting the stock price analysis shows that the latter was substantially more effective. This was revealed in the accomplishment of the current research development project.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Design and Development of Fringing Field Non-Destructive IDE Sensor for Milk Quality Measurement
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Around the world, there is a severe problem with milk adulteration caused by various contaminants, including urea, whey, and water, as well as some other dangerous substances. In this paper, a sensing system utilizing interdigital electrode sensors has been designed and fabricated to detect milk adulteration with tap water. To evaluate milk quality instantly, the primary goal of this research is to develop a capacitive non-contact method. In view of this, a contactless approach using a capacitive sensor for milk quality detection is suggested. Milk testing devices are fabricated on copper-cladded printed circuit boards (PCBs) to detect water adulteration in milk. In order to assess the quality of milk with different water concentrations, the sensor was constructed and tested. An interdigital electrode (IDE) structure has been analyzed using COMSOL Multiphysics. The sensor can distinguish between pure and contaminated milk with notable precision and resolution. The sensor is affordable, lightweight, easy to construct, and convenient.

articleTitle: Detection of Inappropriate Language on Social Media Platforms Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The widespread use of social media has introduced considerable communication benefits, but it has also enabled the dissemination of inappropriate and offensive language. To counter this issue, automated systems based on machine learning algorithms have been created to identify and reduce such content. This paper explores the effectiveness of different machine learning techniques in detecting offensive language on social media, using real-world datasets. Traditional models such as Support Vector Machines (SVM), Naive Bayes, and Random Forests were compared to advanced deep learning methods like Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), and Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT). The results show that deep learning models, particularly BERT, outperformed traditional models in terms of accuracy and F1-score, achieving an accuracy of 93.5%, compared to 87% for Random Forest and 85.2% for SVM. While deep learning models offer superior performance, they come with increased computational demands. These findings underscore the importance of selecting models based on application-specific needs, such as accuracy versus resource efficiency.

articleTitle: Assessment of Robustness through Systematic Testing: A Case Study on GWO-Tuned Fuzzy PID Controller for Hybrid Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The transition towards sustainable energy sources has led to the adoption of hybrid power systems, combining multiple renewable technologies. However, the inherent variability of renewable sources and uncertainties in system parameters challenge their stable operation. Effective control strategies are crucial to ensure robustness. This research paper evaluates the robustness for the Grey Wolf-optimized Fuzzy PID controller in a hybrid-power system, comparing it with traditional PID and fuzzy PID controllers. The controller's performance is examined under varying ultracapacitor parameters and the disconnection of critical energy storage elements. The results demonstrate the Grey Wolf-optimized Fuzzy PID controller's superior performance, showcasing its potential for enhancing grid stability and reliability in real-world applications. The paper provides valuable insights into optimizing control strategies for sustainable energy integration.

articleTitle: Thin Metal-Free THz Absorbers: Broadband Sensing Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: This paper introduces an innovative technique for achieving broadband and near-unity absorption in a Metal-Free Absorber (MFA) using graphite within the THz range. The MFA design consists of graphite slots and notches at the top that function as resonators, a dielectric SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> substrate positioned in the middle, and a graphite sheet placed at the bottom. Graphite is chosen for thermal stability and its excellent electrical properties in the THz region, which contribute to the absorber's high performance. Results demonstrate that the single-layer MFA achieves an absorption rate of ≥90%, spanning a bandwidth of 6.58 THz (from 7.85 THz to 14.44 THz), peak absorption at 11 THz of 95.5%. The double-layer MFA extends the absorption bandwidth to 12.78 THz (from 4.92 THz to 17.70 THz) and achieves a peak absorption of 100% at both 7.4 THz and 14.9 THz. These findings underscore the potential of the proposed MFA structure for effective broadband absorption in the THz frequency range, constructing it a promising candidate for various advanced THz applications.

articleTitle: Developing an Intelligent Garbage Surveillance System Using IoT and Sensor Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: An era where everyone is taking a step forward towards advancement and aspire to have a life of convenience. A generation that believes in amalgamation of technology and human efforts. In the age of digital cities, where everything seems to be well-planned and organised. One of the biggest challenges that we face today is the population, which is growing at an accelerated rate. Unemployment and migration from rural area to have all benefits of urban lifestyle resulted in urbanisation. Urban migration has increased dramatically in recent years. The accumulation of trash waste everywhere and lack of awareness in this field is the outcome of this. The process of removal of waste or reusing it often comes off as a headache. The traditional method to keep a watch on the garbage production is not only a time-consuming process but also requires more manpower as compared to modern technology. We must keep alert and vigilant to the future mutations. This paper gives us access to a feature that facilitates people' daily tasks. It assists citizens with gaining access to extra services like mosquito repellent spraying and other cleanliness-related activities, in addition to providing real-time statistics on the rubbish in wastebins of various checkpoints or wards.

articleTitle: Innovative Solutions for Skin Disease Prediction: A Comprehensive Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: In the current scenario skin diseases are a major global issue. In this paper we analyzed different techniques for detection and classification such as Deep learning, Machine learning, Image processing and Hybrid approach for different types of skin diseases. For this analysis several articles are reviewed related to skin disease and the techniques to detect skin diseases. The result of this study is CNN play an important role to find out specific disease pattern, SVM is best approach for classify the disease, Segmentation approach is used to extract lesion areas, using ensemble method enhance the accuracy of prediction as compare to using single feature selection techniques and SVM is one of the best classifier with using the hybrid techniques to predict and classify the type of skin disease with high accuracy.

articleTitle: Developing Nex Waveforms for Multiuser VLC Networks employing Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The increasing complexity and power requirements of communication systems make them impractical for widespread usage. Theoretical systems have been superbly applied to the actual world by artificial intelligence (AI), with less complexity producing greater outcomes. Here, they contrast two kinds of detectors—one based on deep learning and the other on the more conventional maximum likelihood (ML) decoder—and two methods for multiuser Visible Light Communication (VLC) systems: Successive Interference Cancellation (SIC) and Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA). Examine the differences and similarities between Index Modulation (IM), Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM), and the new Orbital Angular Momentum (OAM) multiplexing. Simulated results for a variety of signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs) reveal that, for both users, deep learning-based structures provide superior decryption at the receiver end, mainly for advanced SNR values, when compared to ML-based systems. By using deep learning, the detection error may be reduced to about 20% for low SNR values and roughly 30% for high SNR values.

articleTitle: Optimal & Cost Effective Solution For Active and Reactive Power Compensation For Solar Plant
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Integrating solar power into the electrical grid poses challenges in managing active and reactive power. This paper proposes a cost-effective and optimal solution for compensating active and reactive power in solar plants. By employing advanced power electronics like inverters and Static var generators, the proposed solution enhances the stability and reliability of the power supply while reducing operational costs. The study assesses various compensation techniques and their economic impacts, providing a comprehensive analysis of their performance in different operational scenarios

articleTitle: Sanitary Sentinel: Safeguarding Public Health with Machine Learning-Infused Smart Toilets and Power BI Analysis for Maintenance Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Every country in the clever world of today is building smart cities at a faster pace. Public restrooms are becoming commonplace across the country as part of the development of smart cities. But our country's cleanliness and hygiene are at a standstill because of inadequate maintenance of public facilities. Women are particularly affected by this due to poor sanitation. As a result of their poor hygiene, individuals are reluctant to use public restrooms. The project recognizes this need and develops an automatic self-cleaning toilet system. In This paper, the concept showcases a smart toilet system that improves user convenience and hygiene via the application of advanced sensor technologies and smart automation. The system employs an Infrared (IR) sensor for user presence detection, triggering automatic actions such as flushing, lid opening and closing. A gas sensor is used to detect the level of gas present in the toilet. These results are also used to collect dataset. The result is an innovative and user-centric toilet experience and interactive displays for improved hygiene and users atisfaction.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of the Decision Tree based Transmission Control Protocol
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The increasing demand for online services has led to a diversification of network applications and architectures, resulting in performance degradation of conventional transmission and communication protocols (TCPs). The response of networks in terms of bandwidth-delay product (BDP) and networks losses is becoming poor. This article propose a novel congestion control scheme to tackle these problems, using smart mechanism named as decision tree based TCP that predicts the possibility of congestion in a network using transmission delay time and dynamically adjusts the parallel data streams transmission. Result analyses in terms of throughput and bandwidth utilization is provided to validate the performance. According to result analysis using simulation implemented and executed on MATLAB software the proposed scheme shows better utilization bandwidth and lower the level of congestion in lossy and large-BDP networks.Problem Statement- This article has focused the problem occurred in bottleneck topology due to data congestion occurred in single path route. The latest works has focused on concept of virtual parallels. This concept is efficient but the problem of deciding congestion level to dynamically adjust the transmission parameters.Proposed Solution- The current research has introduced the decision model having artificial intelligence capability to predict the congestion level with simple and accurate decision tree scheme based approach.Results Obtained- The results that are obtained has validated the performance of proposed scheme in terms of reduction in congestion window size as compared to state of art methods.

articleTitle: Yoga Pose Recognition through Fine-Tuned ResNet50V2 Model with Projection Head
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Yoga, an ancient practice known for its advantages on physical and mental well-being, consists in a vast range of poses that need exact classification for use in automated fitness systems and research. This work introduces a fresh method based on advanced deep-learning techniques to categorize certain yoga positions. We used a ResNet50V2 model connected with a projection head for feature extraction combined with a supervised contrastive loss function to improve the discriminative capability of the model. Comprising 1551 total images, the study comprises training (666 photos), validation (215 images), and testing (470 images) phases. By properly differentiating between different poses, the supervised contrastive learning method greatly enhanced the performance of the model. With an outstanding 97% classification accuracy, our approach proved capable for precise recognition of yoga poses. This development promotes individualized yoga practice and may help to prevent injuries, thus improving health and well-being. It also fits the aim of excellent education since it provides a means for fitness facilities and educational institutions to improve their yoga training courses. By using innovative deep learning methods and using them in easily available fitness solutions, the research promotes creativity. This progress not only helps to create automated yoga training systems but also creates opportunities for more study in the field of position classification with deep learning approaches.

articleTitle: Prediction Of Student Education Performance Using Googlenet Comparison With Over Alexnet Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: An examination of the degree to which GoogleNet and Alexnet are accurate in predicting the academic success of students is the primary objective of this study. Each of the two groups that make up the program contains ten samples, and there are two groups altogether. For the purpose of determining the sample size, a threshold of 0.05%, a G-power pretest of 80%, and a confidence interval of 95% are utilized. We took into consideration the student education dataset that was available on Kaggle.com and had a size of 66500. The method that was proposed was found to have an accuracy of 94.63% when compared to the existing system, which has an accuracy of only if. Furthermore, it demonstrates that there is a statistically significant difference between GoogleNet and Alexnet, with a value of p=0.001 (independent sample T test p<0.05) in the prediction of student educational performance using SPSS statistical analysis. When it comes to forecasting the academic success of students, the GoogleNet algorithm is more accurate than the Alexnet algorithm.

articleTitle: Street Light Controlling Using Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: This article presents the design and implementation of genetic algorithm in the street light system. The power to street light system is given by solar photo voltaic system using DC-DC converter and inverter. The voltage disturbance and non-uniform brightness are the few concerns of street light system. It begins with the maximum power from solar photovoltaic system using perturb and observe (P&O) which is used for the switching of boost converter while switching of inverter has been done with genetic algorithm. The output of inverter is connected to street light. The implementation of genetic algorithm provides least voltage deviation with improved power quality or Total harmonic distortion (THD) under variable solar irradiations.

articleTitle: Load Frequency Control in multi area Power System using different Control Schemes
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Power system networks depend on load frequency control (LFC) to maintain load stability. The principal aim of LFC is to regulate generator output in response to fluctuations in tie-line power and system frequencies, encompassing frequency restoration and power exchange with neighbouring areas. This study examines the LFC for a three-area reheat thermal system with generation rate constraints. The results of load frequency have been obtained different controllers like fuzzy cascaded PID, Integral double derivative (IDD), Model Predictive control (MPC) and PID. The Big Bang Big Crunch is employed to enhance the performance of designed controllers except MPC. The controller's responsiveness has been checked using step load perturbation. A comparative study has also been performed on the basis of settling time, overshoot, and undershoot criterion. It is evident form results that the fuzzy cascaded PID controller outperforms other controllers for settling time, except for a few responses that display significant oscillations. Hence, in comparison to other controllers, the fuzzy cascaded PID controller exhibits superior performance in order to keep a balance in generation and load.

Author Keywords: Fuzzy Logic Control Model Predictive Control

articleTitle: Cognitive Computing for HR Decision-Making
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Cognitive computing is becoming an indispensable component of HR decision-making. By utilising AI, ML, NLP, and data analytics, cognitive computing solutions can efficiently process substantial quantities of HR data, including both structured and unstructured data. This function allows human resources professionals to make more informed decisions on employee engagement, talent management, and recruitment, as well as to predict future workforce patterns and obtain deeper insights into employee behaviours. We can enhance the accuracy of decision-making, reduce biases, and create a more personalised experience for employees by integrating sophisticated data analysis with the automation of routine duties. It is anticipated that cognitive computing will be instrumental in the advancement of strategic HR initiatives as organisations fully integrate digital transformation. It will guarantee that decisions are made with the assistance of factual information, are impartial, and are consistent with the organization’s overarching objectives.

articleTitle: Enhancing Predictive Accuracy with Machine Learning and IoT Integration in Energy Management
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The combination of IoT and ML has the capacity to radically change the energy management as it would increase predictability measurements many folds. This study seeks to analyse the relationship between the use of IoT and ML in enhancing the prediction of energy consumption and the enhancement of the management strategies. Therefore, using the data obtained from the IoT sensors in real-time and applying different ML algorithms, the goal of the study is to design sound machine learning models for EMS. The method used entails data acquisition from smart meters and environmental sensors and the initial data cleaning process and applies regression, classification, and clustering algorithms. Findings show that energy consumption can be predicted more accurately through the machine learning models, especially the Polynomial Regression. Thus, the role of data quality and feature selection in the improvement of a model is shown in the study. The results show that the application of IoT together with the application of ML technologies make great sense and have significant advantages mainly in improving the productivity and efficiency, cutting costs and achieving better control of energy consumption. Thus, this work will be instrumental in the continual enhancement of energy management and contribute to the broader literature through the findings on suitable modeling approaches and the influence of IoT data on superior prognosis. In the subsequent studies, more efforts will be made on enhancing the aforementioned models and expanding the application fields on energy management practices.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Accuracy For Predicting Earthquake Occurrence Using Linear Regression Over Poisson Regression
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: In the context of earthquake prediction, the purpose of this study is to evaluate the accuracy of the Linear Regression Algorithm in comparison to Poisson regression. The linear regression method and the Poisson regression are the two classes that are included in this study. Each group has a sample size of ten, and the sample size is iterated and calculated using clinical software with an alpha value of 0.05, a G-power pre-test score of 80%, and a confidence interval of 95%. It was Kaggle.com that provided the earthquake dataset that contained 10112 samples for the purpose of this investigation. The accuracy of the novel linear regression algorithm is 89.50%, which indicates that it is superior to Poisson regression, which has a value of 77.60%. Furthermore, the results demonstrate that there is a significant difference between Linear regression and Poisson regression, with a value of p=0.000 (Independent sample t-test p<0.05) in the prediction of earthquakes using SPSS statistical analysis. According to the findings of this research, the Linear Regression Algorithm does a better job at predicting earthquakes than the Poisson regression methodology

articleTitle: Design of a 5KV Ru/3C-SiC Schottky Barrier Diode with Uniformly Graded Doping Profile for High-Temperature Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: A growing number of significant applications, particularly in the automotive, aerospace, and energy production industries, are realizing the potential benefits of semiconductor-based devices that can operate at temperatures above 1500C without the need for external cooling. One of the main driving forces for the development of wide band gap semiconductors, especially in SiC, is their ability to work electrically at temperatures far higher than silicon. Due to its high thermal conductivity, broad band gap (2.2 eV), refractory nature, and high electron mobility that is comparable to Si, 3C-SiC is a material that may prove useful for high temperature devices.The goal of the current work is to build a uniformly graded doping profile, high power, 5kV Ru/3C-SiC Schottky Barrier Diode. The drift area width and specific resistance are computed in this profile.

articleTitle: Neural Networks for Portfolio Management Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Optimizing portfolio management is a critical component of investing, as it enables the maximization of returns while minimizing risk. Conventional methods that rely on statistical models and historical data may not adequately capture the complexity of financial markets, which are intricate systems characterized by non-linear interactions. The objective of this research is to optimize portfolio management strategies through the implementation of neural networks, with a particular emphasis on deep learning architectures. We suggest a method for improving investment portfolios by leveraging the capacity of neural networks to accurately represent intricate connections and patterns. We illustrate the efficacy of our methodology and the potential for improved portfolio performance through the optimization of real-world financial data using neural networks, as opposed to conventional methods, through empirical analysis. The research illustrates that sophisticated machine learning methodologies have the capacity to revolutionize financial portfolio management operations.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Deep Convolutional Neural Network With Attention Guided Algorithm For Image Description With Improved Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: In this article, the accuracy of Novel Deep Convolutional Neural Networks and attention-guided algorithms for creating image captions is compared. 8091 tuples make up the flickr 8k dataset from Kaggle, which was used for the research. The two groups in the research study are the Attention Guided Algorithm (n = 25) and Convolution Neural Network (n = 25) techniques by using Clincalc sample size calculator, which are automated and optimized through simulation of different parameters. G power 80% is used to compute sample size. Convolution neural network algorithm (76.24%) has substantially higher accuracy than Attention Guided Algorithms (66.68%) based on the data collected. The significant value for the independent sample t test that was obtained was 0.001 (p<.0.05).Between two algorithms, there is a statistical difference. According to the little research, the Attention Guided Algorithms are not as effective as the Convolution neural network algorithm at extracting the caption from an image for the flickr 8k dataset.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Clarity of Surveillance Footage with Deep Residual Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Closed-circuit television (CCTV) camera pictures are often retained with low resolution as a result of technological and data storage constraints, which diminishes the usefulness of these images. This research suggests that by using intelligent design and training techniques, it is possible to boost the resolution of CCTV pictures using an enhanced deep residual network known as (EDSR). The EDSR approach has never before been used to improve the resolution of CCTV images before this study. In order to train and evaluate an EDSR that could generate high-resolution pictures from a low-resolution dataset, they used a dataset consisting of 986 CCTV images. Applying an EDSR method, they show that executing picture super-resolution with 60 layers is very effective, achieving a peak signal-to-noise ratio of 77.84 db. Additionally, this method has broader potential as a file compression approach that allows for the storing of low-resolution photographs with reduced file sizes and the capacity to recreate the same pictures in high resolution (HR) form

articleTitle: Pathways for Security of Embedded System: Issues and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: In today's scenario, security threats are increasing day by day as technology. Security breaches not only affect financial loss but also affect the trustworthiness and integrity of the software design and embedded software development industry. These breaches directly affect the security attributes. The objective of security in an embedded system is to protect the device from vulnerable attributes. The aim of this paper, identify challenges in embedded systems applied in various applications, research gaps, and untouched areas to discover possible parameters for sustainable devices.

articleTitle: Comparison Analysis of Performance of different PWM techniques used in Multilevel Inverters
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: This paper presents a comparison among various popular Pulse Width Modulation(PWM) techniuqes, like nearest level control (NLC-PWM), selective harmonics elimination (SHE-PWM) along with level shift (LS-PWM) for switched capacitor Multilevel Inverters (SC-MLIs). The decrease in harmonics and Total Harmonic Distortion (THD) in the output voltage is evaluated through comparison. Many vital parameters have also been compared to provide verdict over one another. Further simulation results also verifies the same for different kind of PWM techniques used in various topologies. This study also outlines a hybrid control strategy for future work, aimed at achieving smoother and broader control of the output voltage, alongside a reduction in voltage and current harmonics. The proposed hybrid approach is expected to greatly expand the voltage control range while further lowering THD compared to traditional PWM methods.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Machine Learning Algorithms for Breast Cancer Prediction in Medical Sectors
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Breast cancer is a major health issue worldwide, with millions of new cases diagnosed annually. Early and accurate diagnoses help guide treatment and improve patient outcomes. Machine learning, especially logistic regression, aids medical diagnosis. Various Machine Learning classifier algorithms have been utilized to detect the breast cancer prediction. Various classifiers have been compared in terms of Accuracy, Recall and F1-Score, in that Extra tree classifier results with the best accuracy of 99.17 % among all classifiers.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of different Small Scale Fading Models-A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The objective of the paper is to analyze the statistical characteristics, including the probability density function and the moment generating function, as well as Performance metrics such as the average output signal-to-noise ratio and the amount of fading. These analyses are conducted for various small scale fading models, particularly the Rayleigh fading Model, Nakagami-m fading Model, and Weibull fading Model.This paper also highlights the effect of fading parameter on amount of fading for different small scale fading models. This paper provides the relationship of Nakagami-m fading parameter and Weibull fading parameter.

articleTitle: Effectiveness of IoT (Internet of Things) in Real-Time Supply Chain Monitoring and Management
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The emergence of the Internet of Things (IoT) has brought about a revolution in the field of supply chain management by providing improved management capabilities and real-time monitoring. Using primary data collection and analysis, this study examines the efficacy of IoT technology in real-time supply chain monitoring and management. This study investigates the effects of IoT on key performance factors like inventory accuracy, lead time reduction, and overall supply chain agility through surveys with logistics managers and in-depth interviews with industry experts. Furthermore, field research and observational analyses are utilized to obtain first hand knowledge regarding the usefulness and advantages of IoT devices in supply chain management. Initial results show notable gains in inventory control, decision-making procedures, and tracking and tracing capabilities. Nonetheless, difficulties are noted with data security, integrating with legacy systems, and the high initial cost of the investment. This study adds to the increasing corpus of research on Internet of Things applications in supply chain management and offers useful advice to practitioners looking to use IoT to improve operational performance.

articleTitle: Global Landmark Classification Using Enhanced ResNet50V2: A Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Deep learning models have shown amazing success in picture categorization chores thanks to the fast developments in computer vision. Of them, convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have become a potent instrument for precisely identifying landmarks and objects. This work employs an upgraded ResNet50 architecture, ResNet50V2, to classify famous sites from all around the world. Twelve different sites total—Burj Khalifa, Chichen Itza, Christ the Redeemer, Eiffel Tower, Great Wall of China, Machu Picchu, Pyramids of Giza, Roman Colosseum, Statue of Liberty, Stonehenge, Taj Mahal, and Venezuela's Angel Falls. Renowned for their architectural and cultural value, these sites create a difficult classification challenge given their different structures, histories, and locations. For uses in tourism, cultural preservation, and instructional materials, accurate visual classification of these sites has great promise. ResNet50V2's deep residual learning architecture allows it to learn and generalize features from challenging datasets, so appropriate for this work. This work intends to assess ResNet50V2's effectiveness in differentiating these internationally known landmarks, therefore supporting the larger domains of picture classification and landmark identification. Furthermore, in line with world sustainability objectives, this study supports efforts toward sustainable cultural heritage management, promotes education, tourism, and digital preservation by precisely identifying and classifying these locations.

articleTitle: Leveraging EfficientNetB0 for Precision in Botanical Classification: Insights and Performance Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: This work investigates the use of the EfficientNetB0 model for the five different flower species Lilly, Lotus, Orchid, Sunflower, and Tulip classification. Using a dataset taken from Kaggle—five classes with 5000 photos evenly spaced—the model was refined to maximize its performance for this particular job. The need of obtaining great classification accuracy while preserving computing economy is underlined in the paper Supported by high precision, recall, and F1-scores across all classes, the finely trained EfficientNetB0 model shown good performance with a classification accuracy of 95%. Further confirming the model's ability to differentiate between the floral species was a thorough investigation applying a confusion matrix. With its balanced architecture, the results imply that EfficientNetB0 is a strong tool for floral classification and presents great possibility for uses in automated plant identification and more general botanical research.

articleTitle: Automated Classification of Mustard Leaf Diseases with VGG19
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Mustard or brown Indian mustard is an essential crop produced worldwide for its seeds and foliage used in food or industries. Nevertheless, diseases affect the mustard plant in a way that reduces yield and quality and that is dangerous to the productivity of agriculture as well as the economy. Disease Diagnostic methods which are basic and mostly observational have poor results reaching high levels of imprecision. In pursuing this research, the VGG19 deep CNN is used in the classification of diseases ailing mustard leaves. Thus, using transfer learning, the VGG19 was further used to train the model using the entire dataset of collected mustard images which includes various forms of diseases on the leaves and the healthy ones also. The model reached good accuracy to distinguish various diseases which proved the reliability of the disease diagnosis in the shortest time. By the use of the technology that is described in this paper, farmers can be equipped with the right information for eradicating diseases affecting crops thus helping in the achievement of sustainable agriculture for the achievement of zero hunger, decent Work and economic growth, industry, innovation, and infrastructure, as well as responsible consumption and production. A loss of 0. 0143 indicates that the model has rather accurately predicted the real values that were utilized in the training portion, indicating that the model has captured all of the training data. On the training data set, the accuracy is 0.9970. On the validation set, the accuracy is 0.9308 and the loss is 0.6273.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Approach to Glaucoma: CNN Role in Early Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Leveraging a strong Kaggle dataset of 16,642 retinal pictures classified into glaucomatous and healthy classes, this research paper presents a thorough investigation on glaucoma diagnosis using the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model. Leading cause of irreversible blindness, glaucoma silently advances usually undetectable until major vision loss results. The work focuses on improving early detection using the VGG16 model, which is well-known for its deep architecture able to extract complex characteristics from retinal images. Resizing, normalizing, and data augmentation among preprocessing methods helped to raise model generalization and accuracy. With sensitivity and specificity measures proving its capacity to clearly separate glaucomatous from healthy eyes, the model attained a classification accuracy of 76%. Using F-1 scores, AUC values, and ROC curves, performance was further assessed to validate the model's glaucoma detection ability. This work highlights the possibilities of CNNs in automating glaucoma diagnosis, therefore offering a strong instrument for early management. The results support the continuous efforts to diagnose glaucoma and provide a scalable solution to be included into clinical settings to stop vision loss and maximize patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Multi-Threshold CMOS Technology SAFF for High Speed and Low Power Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The objective of this work is to create a novel 45nm multi-threshold CMOS (MTCMOS) sensing amplifier-based flip-flop (SAFF) circuit that can function at high speeds and low power consumption. In comparison to traditional SAFFs and master-slave flip-flops (MSFFs), the design achieves significant reductions in both power consumption and propagation latency by incorporating insights from prior research. The enhanced sense amplifier and latch stage design, which enables effective amplification and data storage with reduced power consumption and faster operation, is the main innovation. In the latch stage, a conditional cut-off technique is also used to get rid of bugs and guarantee reliable operation. Strategic use of MTCMOS optimization reduces leakage current during idle times, resulting in significant power savings. Lastly, MTCMOS optimization in the design enables dependable operation at reduced supply voltages.. In comparison to traditional SAFFs and MSFFs, the project seeks to produce superior power-delay product and significant reductions in both propagation delay and power consumption. The design also aims to keep a competitive area footprint that is comparable to traditional SAFFs. Performance metrics will be measured and functionality will be confirmed through simulations with tools such as Cadence Virtuoso. Moreover, post-layout simulations and layout design will be carried out to validate functionality and performance on a 45 nm standard cell library. Area optimization should be investigated further to minimize the footprint even more while meeting performance goals. Keywords: 45nm Multi-Threshold CMOS (MTCMOS), Sense Amplifier-Based Flip-Flop (SAFF), Low-Power Design, High-Speed Design, Reduced Power Consumption, Reduced Propagation Delay, Improved Power-Delay Product, Compact Design, Cadence Virtuoso Simulation, Layout Design, Post-Layout Simulation.

articleTitle: Employee Perceptions and Adaptation to Augmented Reality (AR) Training in Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: AR, or augmented reality, has been a game-changer in the training of many different industries, including supply chain management. This study looks into how supply chain operations staff members perceive and adjust to augmented reality training programs. The study makes use of primary data that was gathered from trainers and management as well as surveys and interviews with workers who have completed AR training. Comparing AR training to traditional training techniques, the study intends to assess how employees' learning experiences, job performance, and overall happiness are affected. According to preliminary research, AR training improves learners' engagement and recall of difficult supply chain concepts by offering immersive and interactive learning environments. On the other hand, obstacles like resistance to change and technological issues were also mentioned. This paper offers recommendations for improving augmented reality training programs to better match organizational and employee needs, as well as insightful information about how effective AR is as a training tool in the supply chain industry.

articleTitle: Effect of Voltage Ripple on the output of Dual Active Bridge
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The ripple recovery technique offers a context for overcoming the shortcomings of conventional methods for managing output voltage ripple in Dual Active Bridges (DAB). Traditional techniques often overlook two significant states but this new approach successfully considers them. The main goal of this research is to investigate output voltage ripple under a variety of conditions and to define the boundaries for different ripple requirements. This work seeks to provide practical guidance for designing parameters in DAB systems. We thoroughly analyzed output voltage ripple to achieve this, examining various parameters across different operational scenarios. Our theoretical insights were then tested through simulations using MATLAB/Simulink-23. The findings reveal that the ripple recovery method identifies the previously unrecognized states and enhances our understanding of output voltage ripple. The simulations validated our theoretical analysis and contributed valuable insights for practical parameter design.

articleTitle: Entrepreneurial Trust in Digital Marketing for self help groups : Analyzing AI Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: This study uses primary data to assess the efficacy of AI-based fake news detection methods on social media. We gathered 5,000 postings from Reddit, Facebook, and Twitter, of which 2,500 were fake news and the remaining 2,500 were legitimate news. The accuracy, recall, and F1-score of three AI models—BERT, GPT-3, and RoBERTa—were used to evaluate their performance that can be used by selgf help groups for Entrepreneurial venture . With accuracy rates of 85%, 81%, and 79%, respectively, our results show that BERT works better than GPT-3 and RoBERTa. When it came to detecting bogus news, BERT had the best precision (0.87) and F1-score (0.85). The need for better integration with current systems and the disparity in detection accuracy between platforms are obstacles. This study identifies opportunities for future development and sheds light on the efficacy of AI technologies for dispelling false information on social media.

articleTitle: Enhanced Text Classification with Convolutional Neural Networks: A Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Text classification in natural language processing (NLP) finds applications ranging from sentiment analysis to spam detection, so assigning categories to textual input depends on this procedure. Emphasizing four categories—anger, fear, happiness, and sadness, this work presents a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model designed for emotional identification. Leveraging a dataset taken from Kaggle, the model processes text sequences expressed as 50-length vectors with dense 32-dimensional embeddings, hence enabling complex feature extraction via convolutional layers. Ensuring complete model training, the dataset for emotion classification is well-balanced with 2,200 cases each of pleasure and sorrow, 2,159 of anger, and 1,937 of fear. Strong evaluation measures are provided by datasets with different class distribution for testing and validation. A 95% overall accuracy is obtained by the suggested CNN model with outstanding accuracy, recall, and F1-scores across all emotional categories. The results show how effectively the model picks early emotions, therefore enhancing applicability in customer service, mental health monitoring, social media analysis, and mental health research. This work improves NLP by showing a well performing, efficient CNN architecture for emotion classification.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Athlete Score Prediction Using Convolutional Neural Networks to Improve Accuracy Compared to Recurrent Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The primary objective is to develop a Convolution Neural Network-based real-time athlete score prediction system that outperforms RNNs in terms of accuracy. The work attempts to provide more precise and timely forecasts, which are crucial for efficient sports analytics, by utilizing the spatial nuances seen in athlete score photographs. We compiled a diverse collection of annotated athlete score photos from several sports settings in an effort to achieve real-time athlete score prediction. We designed an optimized Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture including convolutional layers, pooling layers, and fully connected layers, and adapted it for the extraction of spatial features. The Convolution Neural Network was carefully trained with the Adam optimisation method, and its accuracy and loss metrics were continuously monitored. A comprehensive comparison study utilizing Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) evaluated important performance metrics such as precision, computational effectiveness, and instantaneous inference capabilities. Convolution Neural Network is a powerful tool for improving real-time sports analytics. This was demonstrated by the integration of the trained Convolution Neural Network model into a real-time athlete scoring system, which involved optimizing processing pipelines for low-latency performance without sacrificing prediction accuracy. The Convolution Neural Network based feature extraction technique has better accuracy of 89.28% than the Recurrent Neural Network with 79.41 %. The statistical significance value obtained is 0.760 (p>0.05),hence it is observed that there is no statistical significant difference between the two groups. The sample records were measured with the help of clinical analysis, the value of alpha is 0.05, the value of beta is 0.5, percentage of confidence is 95. Convolutional Neural Network algorithms provided better results in Athlete Score Prediction than Recurrent Neural Network algorithms.

articleTitle: Advancing Edge Computing Paradigms with Novel Architectures and Algorithms for Real-Time Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: This paper focuses on the advancements of the edge computing paradigms regarding the creation of new emerging architectures and algorithms for improving real-time computing. Looking at the results obtained, the proposed architecture provided 40% reduced latency rates, and 50% higher throughput than the baseline models while using 20% less energy. Key algorithms, including data compression, stream processing, and adaptive algorithms, were evaluated, with the hybrid approach showing the most significant improvements: The improvements were made in the latency where there was a 50% decrease in the latency and in the throughput where there was a 40% increase, and in the accuracy which is 30% enhanced. The above outcomes demonstrate the efficiency of offered solutions in the context of the discussed problems of real-time data processing; the recognition of the edge computing prospects regarding the further evolution of different applications.

articleTitle: Cluster Head-Based Wireless Sensor Network Sustainability Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The growth of a reduced-capacity assembling contract to communicate data from channel heads to BSs (Base Stations) is a main concern in WSNs, and this item outlines individual specific resolutions. In WSN, a multi-level whole of order is beneficial for the data group and destroying. Increasing the network's old age is one of the benefits of hierarchic assembling procedures. The group of the cluster head by way of the use of the centre pattern is the big focus of these algorithms, accompanying the main objective search to embellish the original centroid selection technique. To guarantee the network's staying power, the submitted process takes many determinants into report when selecting a Cluster Head (CH), containing leftover strength, range middle from two points growth, CHs, and the base station. The overall depiction of the imitation is judged distinguished from the depiction of usual algorithms, and effective strength habit is obtained.

articleTitle: Improving Image Generation Robustness with Adversarial Autoencoder for Enhanced Quality and Stability
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: This paper focuses on the application of adversarial autoencoders for improving the robustness of image generation. Therefore, in this study, adversarial training is proposed to be incorporated into the autoencoder structure in order enhance the quality and robustness of the synthesized images. The approach includes using adversarial autoencoders with different datasets, CIFAR-10, CelebA and ImageNet, and estimate models’ quality with the use of IS, FID, MSE indicators. It is ascertained from the outcomes that adversarial autoencoders attain an Inception Score of approximately 8. 14, while the FID as assessed using the Frechet Inception Distance is 15 and the value of 19. 22 and Mean Squared Error of 0. 018, outperforming traditional autoencoders. They also display higher degrees of resistance to adversarial attacks, marking the apposite application of the models in tasks that require quality and stability in image generation.

articleTitle: Design of a Fiber-based Full Duplex Front-Haul Radio System
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: An important feature of a radio over fiber system is its ability to provide both fiber optical connectivity and a wireless radio channel. Fiber-grounded wireless (Fi-Wi) connectivity in real time makes it feasible to provide high- capacity multimedia services to users. In the architectural design of a telecommunications system, the front-haul connection is the location where RoF technologies are utilized the most frequently to establish a connection between central station and base stations. This is achieved by the use of either copper wires or microwaves. In this article, using the Optisystem tool, a full- duplex link connecting four base stations and a central station has been meticulously designed and analyzed. The system's error rate is assessed by analysing eye-diagrams and the Q-factor.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation and Analysis of Thresholding Techniques for Speech Denoising and Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: This paper evaluates and analyse the performance of numerous thresholding techniques in context of speech denoising and enhancement. The performance of each technique is critically compared across a spectrum of thresholds - Hard, Soft, Hard-soft, Super soft, semi soft, Universal, Minimax, Adaptive, and Bayesian thresholding methods. Performance comparisons were based on metrics such as signal to noise ratio exploring the efficacy of each thresholding method. Results obtained from each method recap the strengths and limitations of each thresholding methodology, and thus the applicability of each with respect to noise environments or signal characteristics. This study provides important information for selecting an appropriate thresholding method for denoised and enhanced effective speech signal.

articleTitle: Control Strategy for Islanded DC Microgrid Integrated with Renewable Energy Resources and Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: This paper introduces a control strategy for an islanded DC microgrid that integrates PV, wind, and fuel cell sources with an energy storage system (ESS) that includes a battery storage system and an electric vehicle (EV). Due to the intermittent nature of solar and wind energy, the proposed method reduces voltage fluctuations in the DC bus. It reduces overall current stress on the system by utilizing EV to share the load current during peak demand conditions. Renewable energy sources like solar and wind deliver clean energy while combining them with fuel cells to ensure a more stable and consistent power supply. Additionally, ESS enhances flexibility and offers increased storage capacity. This research work uses the droop control method to improve microgrid reliability by managing power supply and demand fluctuations, ensuring a stable voltage level of the DC microgrid and efficient power distribution. The paper proposes utilizing a current-loop control method for an EV to discharge energy during periods of peak demand and to recharge when excess power is generated. The system's performance, evaluated using MATLAB-Simulink, demonstrates the effectiveness of the approach under conditions of rapid load fluctuations, renewable energy variability, and load shedding.

articleTitle: Efficient Shopping: RFID-Powered Cart with Automated Billing System
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: In traditional retail systems, manual billing systems often lead to long queues and customer dissatisfaction. This research presents a solution to streamline the billing process and enhance the shopping experience using RFID technology and Arduino microcontrollers. The Smart Shopping Cart system integrates EM-18 RFID modules with Arduino to automate the billing process in supermarkets. Each product is tagged with an RFID tag, and carts are equipped with RFID readers. As customers scan items, prices are automatically added to the billing system, displayed on an LCD screen. This innovation aims to reduce wait times, errors, and operational costs associated with manual billing. The project includes design considerations such as circuit optimization, simulation using Proteus software, physical testing on breadboards, and calibration for accuracy. The use of rechargeable batteries ensures portability and minimizes clutter, enhancing the system's practicality. By embracing automation and RFID technology, this research contributes to improving retail efficiency and customer satisfaction in modern supermarkets.

articleTitle: Robotics and AI in Enhancing Banking Operations Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The financial sector is experiencing a transformation as a result of the incorporation of AI and robotics into banking operations, which has improved accuracy, efficiency, and client satisfaction. The utilization of robotics, particularly robotic process automation (RPA), simplifies tasks such as data input, transaction processing, and compliance reporting. These operations are enhanced by artificial intelligence (AI) tools, such as machine learning and natural language processing, which enable well-informed decision-making, predictive modeling, and improved data analytics. This investigation investigates the numerous methods by which artificial intelligence (AI) and robotics are influencing the banking sector, particularly in terms of operational efficiency. It also offers a glimpse into the future prospects of this rapidly changing field.

articleTitle: Development of a Smart IoT-based Dustbin Level Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: In recent times, the exponential rise in waste output has become a major worldwide problem, resulting in dirty environments, unpleasant aromas, and the spread of diseases in cities and public spaces. Traditional waste management strategies have been ineffectual in dealing with this issue. This paper therefore presents the design and construction of a smart waste bin that aims to streamline waste management procedures, reduce manual labor, and mitigate the associated costs. The proposed system utilizes various components such as PIR sensor, ultrasonic sensor, servo motor, buzzer, SIM800l GSM module, LCD display, and Arduino UNO microcontroller. The proposed system also uses a level indicator that communicates with an authorized personnel indicating the amount of waste in the bin at certain thresholds. If the proposed smart dustbins are widely adopted, replacing our current traditional dustbins, garbage can be effectively handled. The designed system was tested and found to function in accordance with the study's objectives.

articleTitle: Exploring the Impact of Artificial Intelligence on Corporate Law
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Specifically, the objective of this research study is to analyse the significant impact that Artificial Intelligence (AI) is having on the legal framework governing corporations. In particular, the paper will analyse how artificial intelligence is reorganising legal procedures, regulatory compliance, and corporate responsibility. The objective of this research is to evaluate the feasibility of utilising artificial intelligence (AI) in the areas of legal analytics, contract management, and decision-making procedures. It is highlighted in the paper that artificial intelligence can increase the efficiency, accuracy, and transparency of legal procedures within corporations. In addition to this, the paper discusses the ethical and legal challenges that are associated with the use of artificial intelligence. Concerns around accountability, partiality, and the privacy of data are among these problems. By giving insights into the future landscape of legal practice, the objective of this research is to provide a comprehensive understanding of how artificial intelligence is influencing corporate law. The examination of case studies and emerging trends will be how this objective will be realised. Even though artificial intelligence (AI) presents enormous opportunities for innovation in corporate law, the findings suggest that it also requires the construction of new regulatory frameworks to manage the challenges that are brought about by technologies that are based on artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: Single Mode Optical Fiber based Pulse Width Measurement using AVR Microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Now-a-days, the need for efficient monitoring of pressure on optical fiber has become a very delicate issue. The electrical pressure sensors are prone to signal degradation in extreme environments due to various factors such as electromagnetic interference, corrosion etc. To overcome these obstacles, this paper demonstrate a robust microcontroller based pressure monitoring scheme using a single mode optical fiber and thereby calculating the width of the pulse where optical fiber acts as a sensor element. The experimental assembly consists of a He–Ne laser source, a single mode optical fiber, light dependent resistor (LDR) grounded 555 timer circuit and an ATmega32 microcontroller development board. The receiver senses the applied pressure as a function of the attenuation of the light passing through it. The microcontroller counts the time interval between two consecutive pulses which gives us the required pulse width. Experimental results show the dependence of the applied load to the pressure exerted on the optical fiber.

articleTitle: A Dual-Source Switched-Capacitor based 13-Level Boost Multilevel Inverter Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: This paper proposed a switched capacitor based 13-level inverter architecture with dual-source. The proposed design introduces a novel topology featuring 12 switches (eleven unidirectional and one bidirectional), two capacitors, and two DC sources, achieving a voltage gain of 1.2. Capacitor voltages are managed through self-balancing by parallel charging and serial discharging. Unlike traditional designs, the topology omits an H-bridge, reducing the load on switches to generate negative polarity. Simulation results validate the performance of this innovative configuration with different load conditions. A comprehensive analysis highlights the proposed topology's advantages over recent 13-level designs, specifically regarding switch count, capacitor usage, DC sources, total harmonic distortion (THD), cost function (CF), and total standing voltage (TSV). The nearest level modulation approach is applied to generate switching signals, with the proposed inverter achieving a TSV of 28.

articleTitle: Natural Language Processing for Analyzing Social Media Trends
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)

authors.preferredName: C H. S. N. Sai Lalitha

abstract: This investigation studies the effectiveness of Natural Language Processing (NLP) in analyzing and interpreting trends in social media. Because social media platforms generate enormous amounts of data daily, extracting useful perceptions from this information creates several important obstacles. To uncover patterns and sentiments within the material of social platforms, the study investigates a variety of natural language processing (NLP), such as sentiment analysis, content modeling, and trend finding. Through the use of these methods, the investigation intends to improve comprehension of the patterns of public opinion and behavior over time. In addition, the study analyzes the efficiency of several natural language processing (NLP) algorithms and tools in the processing and analysis of data from social media platforms, highlighting both their strengths and weaknesses. The findings provide valuable insight into how natural language processing (NLP) might be utilized to monitor and forecast societal trends. They also provide counterarguments for those who are involved in experimentation, policymaking, and marketing. Through the demonstration of how advanced speech analysis may be applied to the dynamic and complicated geography of social media, this study contributes to the larger subject of data wisdom.

articleTitle: Visual Sentinel: Fortifying Social Media Image Sharing with Optical Image Cryptosystem
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Social media's explosive development has revolutionized image sharing but also puts users' privacy in danger. This study suggests "Visual Sentinel," a novel optical image cryptosystem made specifically for safe image sharing on social networking sites. The cryptosystem protects shared photos from illegal access and alteration by using cutting-edge encryption algorithms and key management strategies. We illustrate the effectiveness and resilience of Visual Sentinel against potential threats through in-depth tests and performance evaluations. To determine user's opinions toward implementing this improved security solution, we also perform user perception research. The results highlight the importance of optical image cryptography in enhancing trust and privacy in social media and opening the door for more secure and private image-sharing experiences.

articleTitle: A Single FBG Sensor for Measuring Multiple Parameters across Different Structures
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The article introduces a novel method that utilizes a single Fibre Bragg Grating (FBG) sensor to measure a variety of environmental factors that are crucial for the detection of marine catastrophes. The system employs FBG sensor to monitor wave parameters, including temperature, load, force, and vibration, in order to detect tsunamis, tropical cyclones, and other marine occurrences. The proposed approach is suitable for coastal regions that are susceptible to disasters and require rapid and reliable data to facilitate prevention. This type of sensing technique enhance environmental monitoring by incorporating a variety of sensing capabilities into a single FBG sensor, thereby enhancing the reliability and integration of oceanic catastrophe detection. Durability and cost-effective real-time monitoring under severe marine conditions are guaranteed by the multi-parameter sensing system, which is specifically engineered for maritime environments.

articleTitle: Smart Traffic Flow Management System using FPGA
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: A comprehensive initiative called the Smart Traffic Flow Management System (STFMS) aims to address the growing problems caused by urban traffic congestion. Surging urbanization and rising car density necessitate creative ways to improve traffic flow, cut down on travel time, and lessen environmental effect. This proposal presents an intelligent and adaptable system that integrates state-of-the-art technology to optimize traffic flow. A Smart Traffic Flow Management System (STFMS) is a digital system used to regulate the sequence of traffic lights at a junction. It was developed using image processing and verilog. Usually, a finite state machine (FSM) method or any combinational digital circuit can be used, in which different states stand for distinct light sequences, such as red, green, and yellow. To decide when to change states, the controller gets information from sensors or timers. The logic, states, and transitions for the output signals that operate the real traffic lights are defined in the Verilog code or in the external processor which is used. By optimizing the timing and switching of lights based on real-time traffic conditions and algorithms, it assures a safe and efficient flow of traffic. Environmental sustainability is a key focus of this project. By minimizing traffic congestion and optimizing traffic signal timings, the STFMS aims to reduce overall carbon emissions and fuel consumption. The project can also extend to the consideration of integration of electric and autonomous vehicles, promoting eco-friendly modes of transportation. STFMS offers a holistic approach to urban mobility challenges. By leveraging the power of data-driven insights, machine learning, and real-time communication, the system strives to create a more efficient, sustainable, and user-friendly urban transportation network. This project contributes to the development of smart cities by enhancing the quality of life for residents and optimizing the use of transportation resources

articleTitle: Optimizing Railway Traffic Management Using Fuzzy Logic-Based Decision-Making Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Railway web page traffic manipulate is a complex and dynamic method that includes making real-time picks based mostly on various uncertain and difficult to understand factors, collectively with fluctuating passenger demand, diverse train schedules, and unpredictable weather conditions. Traditional decision-making strategies often battle to cope with the ones uncertainties, foremost to inefficiencies and potential safety risks. This paper proposes the software program of fuzzy properly judgment-based completely decision-making systems to optimize railway web page traffic manipulate. Fuzzy properly judgment, with its potential to model uncertainty and control difficult to understand data, offers a robust framework for boosting decision-making approaches in railway operations. By simulating various conditions and integrating real-time data, the proposed gadget can dynamically regulate train schedules, manipulate delays, and enhance everyday operational efficiency. The paper may present case studies demonstrating the effectiveness of fuzzy properly judgment in dealing with railway web page traffic, reducing delays, and improving passenger satisfaction. The findings advice that incorporating fuzzy properly judgment into railway web page traffic manipulates systems can purpose greater adaptive and resilient railway operations, ultimately contributing to greater steady and additional reliable rail networks.

articleTitle: An Effective Analysis of Predicting Clothes types in E-commerce reviews using CatBoost Algorithm with Extreme Gradient Boosting Classifier
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to determine whether the Catboost algorithm is superior to the Extreme Gradient Boosting Classifier (XGBoost) method in terms of its ability to generate predictions about the sorts of clothing based on evaluations from online retailers. This study contains 2 groups: Novel Catboost algorithm and Extreme Gradient Boosting Classifier, where each group is iterated for a sample size of 10 calculated using the ClinCalc software with 0.05 as the alpha value, and a CI of 95%. The e-commerce reviews dataset with a size of 23485 was considered from Kaggle.com. The novel catboost algorithm accuracy is 92%, which appears to be superior to the XGBoost classifier's accuracy of 89%. It can be concluded that there exists a statistically significant distinction between the CatBoost algorithm and the XGBoost classifier algorithm. This is evidenced by a value of p=0.007 (Independent sample t-test p<0.05) in the SPSS statistical analysis prediction of clothing types based on e-commerce reviews.. Conclusion: In analysing various clothes types by E-commerce reviews the CatBoost algorithm results show better than the Extreme Gradient Boosting Classifier.

articleTitle: Predicting Student Anxiety and Depression Using Random Forest Classifiers Optimizer
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Recently, Random Forest classifiers have shown rather strong abilities in identifying and predicting mental health issues among university students. Many studies reveal the reliability and accuracy in handling complex datasets with many factors. For Murang'a University, Loise et al. (2024) for instance regularly predicted depression reappearance using Random Forest. Chowdhury et al. (2024) similarly used tree-based models—including Random Forest—to forecast anxiety, sadness, and insomnia among Bangladeshi students, hence gaining great accuracy in identifying at-risk individuals. When Rahman and Kohli (2024) evaluated several machine learning models, Random Forest emerged as especially accurate for evaluating mental health of overseas students. In their assessment of depression, anxiety, and tension among Lebanese students during the COVID-19 epidemic, El Morr et al. (2024) emphasized Random Forest's all-around analytical power.
