Examining the mix of machine learning and deep learning, Bhavani and Naveen (2024) also studied the need of ongoing updates. The literature mostly stresses the improved efficacy of Random Forest classifiers in the early identification and intervention of mental health issues, so fostering better psychological outcomes in educational surroundings. articleTitle: IoT-Enabled Asset Management and Tracking in Organizations
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The manner in which assets are monitored, controlled, and utilized has been substantially altered by organizations that have implemented IoT-enabled asset management and monitoring technologies. When it comes to resource allocation and strategic decision-making, the data insights provided by IoT-enabled devices are of paramount importance. Companies that implement these technologies should anticipate an increase in productivity, a decrease in losses, and an improvement in their ability to comply with regulatory standards.

articleTitle: Data Protection in the Era of Big Data Advanced Encryption Standard VS Data Encryption Standard
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: This research is to seek to know which algorithm between the DES (Data Encryption Standard) and AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) is faster in encryption and decryption as well as determine which is safer The data set used in this research was an online dataset with a data capacity of one lakh. articleTitle: Enhancing IoT Security and Efficiency with DPOS Enabled Blockchain and IPFS Integration

abstract: Current research has engrossed on the potential of the blockchain system to resolve security concerns in the IoT net. This framework ensures enhanced efficiency and effectiveness in Internet of Things networks using constrained resources by using the delegation Proof of Stake (DPoS) consensus approach. To lessen the load on blockchain-based IoT networks, DPoS allows just a select group of chosen delegates to verify and approve transactions. To facilitate distributed storage, the investigators in this study constructed the Interplanetary File System (IPFS), and they also developed a Docker system to gauge net presentation in terms of latency, productivity, and source use. articleTitle: Comparative analysis of Deep CNN Models for Pancreatic Cancer with Adam Optimizer

abstract: In the field of cancer research, the possibility of increasing the effectiveness of diagnostic tools is based on the classification of biomedical data correctly. The computations revealed the performance by ResNet50 as the best in CPTAC-PDA and showed a higher capacity of generalization by InceptionV3 and InceptionResNetV2 in a Kaggle dataset. The results suggest that the performance of DenseNet121 and MobileNetV2 is not sufficiently sustainable. The proposed models, particularly ResNet50, achieved superior performance, with ResNet50 attaining a 96.08% accuracy and 0.9744 F1-score, surpassing reference models. VGG16 and InceptionV3 also showed strong results, further validated by improved ROC curves. Findings aid in creating robust diagnostic tools.

articleTitle: Predictive Logistics Management of Car Sales Based on Machine Learning Algorithm for Supply Chain

articleTitle: Augmenting EHR Systems by Utilizing Blockchain Technology with unique Aadhar Identity System

articleTitle: Machine Learning Techniques to Identify the High-Resolution Radar Image by Supervised Trained Virtual Data

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Predictive Maintenance in Power Systems

articleTitle: Behavioral Finance in Cryptocurrency Markets: Assessing Herding Behavior and Volatility

articleTitle: Supervised Learning in Task Assignment Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The practical application of supervised learning algorithms in task assignment systems to improve both efficiency and accuracy in a variety of organizational settings. One subfield of machine learning is called supervised learning, and it involves the utilization of labeled training data to develop predictive models that can categorize and assign tasks according to predetermined criteria. Within the scope of this study, various supervised learning strategies, such as classification and regression algorithms, are investigated to see how effective they are in optimizing the processes of responsibility allocation. The purpose of this research is to demonstrate how these algorithms improve work prioritizing, resource management, and overall operational performance by evaluating case studies and empirical data. The findings demonstrate the benefits of integrating supervised learning into task assignment systems, including improved automation, reduced human error, and better alignment with organizational goals. These advantages are highlighted when the data are presented. Through the provision of insights into the practical implementation of machine learning techniques for task management and the provision of recommendations for future improvements in this domain, this research contributes to the expanding field of intelligent systems.

articleTitle: Predictive Analysis of Consumer Behavior Using Supervised Learning Techniques

articleTitle: Real-time Traffic and Traffic Flow Prediction using Machine Learning Algorithm for Optimal Route Planning in Electric Vehicles

abstract: Electric vehicles are potential for electrifying traffic due to their effectiveness, environmental friendliness, and cleanliness Not only do electric cars (EVs) provide substantial loads for the electricity grid, but they are also essential to traffic flow. articleTitle: The Impact of AI on Industrial Economic Sustainability: Challenges and Remedies

articleTitle: Exploring Large Language Models for Natural Language Processing

articleTitle: Implementation of Artificial Intelligence in Medical Electronic Communication Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Artificial intelligence techniques in communications engineering to address the issue of high frame error rate is suggested in this research. An attempt to improve the safety of the Internet of Things' wireless communication system is made, using Low Power Wide Area Network (LPWAN) technology in AI as an example, using a novel design. The business, terminal access, data processing, and communication technology layers make up the bulk of the architecture. The experimental results demonstrate that the system configuration transmits four types of data every 30 seconds: "light, air pressure, humidity, and temperature." The receiving port records this data continuously for four hours. This configuration significantly improves the system’s throughput and processing effectiveness compared to the conventional design (15.7%), with a packet loss rate of only 5%. Wireless communication is improved by the stable, low-bit-error architecture. The evidence suggests that the new design, which takes LPWAN technologies as an example, provides a large total size in addition to a suitable commercial electronic communication interface. This enhancement significantly reduces the frame-number error rate and provides a more precise signal-to-frame-number conversion.

articleTitle: Delay and Packet Loss Reduction by Parameter Optimization Approach in Multipath TCP
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Connecting a host or computer network to more than one network is called multi-homing. Presently the availability of multi-homed devices is widespread. It has introduced a common practice to utilize multiple paths TCP (MPTCP) for data transmission for improving performance. However MPTCP helps improve network reliability & bandwidth efficiency, the transmission performance under short-time data transfer was observed to decline as compared to regular TCP communication mode under single path schemes for concurrent subflow data transfer on a shared path because of the aggressive starting behavior of MPTCP. Such strategy is generally uncoupled; each data is processed independently and significantly affects the concurrent traffic. This paper reveals the MPTCP’s performance under the impact of parameters depending on timeouts, retry, and wait time that affect the packet losses and delay. To accomplish this task the workflow presented based on simulation using MatLab-based implementation, that is employing the analysis for deriving the appropriate parameter set for minimizing the packet losses and delay in the network and reduces the possibility of congestion, and helps for controlling at end-host in avoiding packet loss for concurrent connections under MPTCP with text data flows application. The experimental results drawn from results obtained from MatLab implementation show that parameter optimization is useful in the significant reduction of delay time and helpful in retaining high throughput.

articleTitle: Policy Suggestions Using Artificial Intelligence Techniques – A Machine Learning Algorithms Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: In an increasingly automated world, artificial intelligence (AI) has the capacity to completely transform human employment, consumer behaviour, and societal advancement. While science and technology have progressed, humans have always sought solutions to problems. AI-based technology is not new and has a wide range of commercial applications. Given the complex relationship between the quantity of patent applications for distinct AI-related developments and international commerce, nations of different economic classes ought to develop AI innovations that benefit their own international trade. The boosting algorithm is preferred as an algorithm that transforms the poor learners as strong learners. This boosting technique improves the prediction quality of the model. The weak learners are improved in stepwise manner through boosting in each attempt. To conclude the businesses decision makers and general public faces complex challenges and unimaginable opportunities in integration of AI in international trade. These technological advancements provide automation machine learning and predictive analytics for improving the efficiency of supply chain, reduced transaction rate and streamlined trade process.

articleTitle: Fault Detection and Diagnosis in Wireless Sensor Networks Leveraging Transformer Models
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: We present this article which is a research summary on the fault detection and diagnosis in the wireless sensor networks (WSN) by means of the transformer model. Our methodology puts the emphasis on an innovative approach that uses intense machine learning, domain-specific know-how to increase the performance and dependability of fault detection techniques in WSNs. In depth study has been done using of sensors "in vivo" data and comparison of transformer based methods with traditional machine learning algorithms, which includes CNNs, RNNs and SVMs. The experimental results indicate that Transformer we have used yields the best result concerning precision (0. 95), precision (0. 93), recall (0. The sequence accuracy (0. 93), overall accuracy (96), and F1-score (0. 94) prove this model is quite optimized in studying and finding out the spatial and temporal dependencies and patterns in WSN data. Furthermore, the fault detection system that is based on the transformer model is very reliable, robust, and precise since it performs its task of identification of different types of faults which occur due to failure of sensors, communication or impact of environment with accuracy. In compliance with this, our evaluation of resources consumption shows, that the transformer-based fault detection and diagnosis systems are moderately consuming the resources, as detected CPU usage gets 80%, and memory (RAM) consumption amounting 6 GB respectively, while GPU remains unused, thus showing the possibility of deploying such systems on standard hardware configurations. These results reflect the possibility of transforming the impact of the transformer technology in sophisticated techniques of both detection and diagnosis of WSNs as an affirmation of future improvement and inventions of another kind of approach.

articleTitle: IoT-Enabled Consumer Behavior Tracking
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The incorporation of Internet of Things (IoT) technology into consumer gesture tracking results in the discovery of previously undiscovered perceptivity and opens up opportunities for businesses to comprehend and predict the needs of their customers. Within the scope of this study, we investigate the utilization of Internet of Things-enabled bias to get real-time data on consumer conditioning, preferences, and copping. the patterns. Businesses can collect precise information that may be used to generate focused marketing tactics, tailored advice, and improved client gests by utilizing Internet of Things detectors and smart bias. The research underlines the advantages of the Internet of Things, including the enhancement of data detail, the reduction of reaction times, and the facilitation of visionary engagement with customers. Furthermore, the investigation covers the difficulties associated with the sequestration and security of data, emphasizing the significance of ethical issues and compliance with nonsupervisory responsibilities. This article highlights the transformational potential of the Internet of Things (IoT) in consumer gesture shadowing by utilizing case studies and present operations. It also suggests potential avenues for the research and development of new concepts. It has been discovered that shadowing that is allowed by the Internet of Things has the potential to greatly improve corporate processes, increase customer loyalty, and generate a competitive edge.

articleTitle: Strategic Analysis of Uplink URLLC Traffic Impact on eMBB Efficiency in Next-Generation 5G Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: This paper provides a comprehensive analysis of the impact of Ultra-Reliable Low-Latency Communications (URLLC) traffic on Enhanced Mobile Broadband (eMBB) efficiency in uplink scenarios within next-generation 5G networks. Initially, we assess the throughput, latency reduction and resource allocation techniques for URLLC traffic by leveraging novel 5G techniques designed for latency control, such as flexible numerology, advanced scheduling mechanisms and mini-slot concepts. By employing system-level simulations, we accurately determine the URLLC throughput and subsequently evaluate the eMBB throughput degradation when both services are managed on the same radio carrier. Our findings highlight the significant tradeoffs and resource management challenges that arise from the coexistence of URLLC and eMBB services. Through our results, we provide actionable insights and recommendations for cellular service providers on how to effectively balance the demands of URLLC traffic while maintaining eMBB efficiency in uplink transmissions.

articleTitle: Detecting Muscle Strain using IoT Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Health problems resulting from muscle tension not only cause discomfort for the individual but also place a heavy load on healthcare systems. One of the main reasons for medical visits to the doctor and associated costs is musculoskeletal disorders. Musculoskeletal disorders significantly affect individual wellbeing and impose a considerable burden on healthcare systems. Proactively addressing posture issues might potentially alleviate pressure on muscles and healthcare resources while also improving the quality of life for a great number of people. To address modern posture issues, innovative, easily obtainable, and cutting-edge technology is the answer. The MSD empowers users to improve posture and reduce muscle tension by integrating sensors, data processing, and real-time feedback. It offers a customized approach and serves a broad spectrum of customers, including athletes, office professionals, and students.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Effectiveness of AI-driven Customer Interactions and Conversational Marketing
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: To determine whether or not conversational marketing and AI-driven client relationships are effective in terms of boosting consumer engagement and driving business expansion, the objective of this exploratory research is to evaluate the efficacy of these two marketing strategies. Because businesses are increasingly relying on artificial intelligence technologies to facilitate substantiated communication, it is vital to have a solid understanding of the impact that these technologies have on the happiness of customers and the transactions that take place in the business world. With the help of chatbots, virtual sidekicks, and other conversational tools powered by artificial intelligence, the objective of this study is to analyse how these tools are altering customer service by offering quick, personalised responses and developing closer links between businesses and their consumers. During the investigation, the efficiency, scalability, and overall effects of AI-driven relations on customer loyalty and retention are evaluated. The accomplishment of this evaluation is performed through the utilisation of a combination of performance criteria, stoner feedback analysis, and case studies. Based on the findings, it is clear that artificial intelligence cannot only simplify communication but also assist the development of additional marketing tactics that are both meaningful and effective. This will ultimately lead to improvements in customer service and an improvement in business difficulties.

articleTitle: Effective & Smart Urban Mobility System at Low Cost
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: There is no established metric for measuring urban smartness at this time. Various writers use various metrics to assess smart city transportation systems. The assessment indicators for the transport system that were offered in the scholarly works were reviewed, and the most relevant and impactful indicators were chosen. A hierarchical assessment model for smart city transport systems is developed in this paper. There are five categories, or "factors," that the indications fall into. Several indicators are assigned to each of the categories. This study used the hybrid MCDM (multi-criteria decision-making) method to evaluate urban transport systems and identify which of the given characteristics were most important. Top Priority Sorting based on Ideal Solution Similarity (TOPSIS), COPRAS, and Simple Additive Weighting (SAW) were the multi-criteria assessment methods in use. The importance of the components and indicators was determined using an analytical hierarchy process (AHP), rankings (prioritization), and direct evaluation (experts evaluate each criterion as a percentage; total assessments of all criteria equal 100%). There were two phases to the evaluation and comparison of mobility systems: first, smart mobility systems were evaluated comprehensively according to the integrated importance of the indicators; and second, multi-criteria evaluations were conducted according to the indicators of every factor separately. Based on the amount of intelligence, a top city is determined and rated. Building a hierarchical model for evaluating smart transportation systems is the focus of this paper.

articleTitle: Optimising IoT-Healthcare Systems with Deep Learning: sensors Data Fusion, Prognostic Modelling, and Smart Management
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) technologies allow real-time patient monitoring and data collection, changing healthcare. Deep learning has the potential to improve IoT-enabled medical facilities by combining sensor data, making predictions, and developing techniques to assist. The integration of sensor data is crucial for amalgamating medical, intelligent, and electronic medical record data. CNNs and RNNs excel at processing various data streams. This provides a complete patient health picture. Combining physical indications, activity levels, and outside elements may provide doctors with an accurate assessment of a patient's health. Based on historical data, predictive modelling employs deep learning to predict future health outcomes. Using LSTM networks and attention processes, IoT healthcare systems may predict illness progression, identify risk factors, and recommend early treatment. These prediction models enable fast therapies, preventative care, and resource optimization, improving patient outcomes and lowering healthcare expenditures. Deep learning helps to create patient-specific smart management approaches. Using real-time monitoring data and previous patient information, machine learning algorithms may create customized treatment regimens. These therapies may involve lifestyle modifications, pharmaceutical adjustments, or medical worker advice. These enlighten patients and healthcare providers to help them manage chronic diseases and make better decisions. When coupled, IoT and deep learning may transform healthcare. IoT-enabled healthcare systems may enhance patient surveillance, analysis, and treatment with improved information from sensor fusion, forecasting algorithms, and intelligent actions. This improves treatment and health outcomes.

articleTitle: AI-Enhanced Early Warning Systems for Natural Disaster Detection and Mitigation using Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Each year, natural disasters result in substantial economic and human losses, underscoring the critical requirement for predictive systems capable of issuing timely alerts. Technology, particularly Artificial Intelligence (AI), plays a pivotal role in enhancing early warning systems (EWSs) for natural disasters. AI algorithms analyze extensive datasets from various sources—such as satellite imagery, weather data, and seismic activity—to deliver more precise and nearly real-time warnings for events like earthquakes, tsunamis, and floods. This paper proposes an AI-driven approach that utilizes wireless sensor networks (WSNs) strategically deployed in disaster-prone coastal areas to monitor seismic activity and oceanic disturbances. The system aims to detect anomalies indicative of tsunamis and earthquakes, offering an advanced EWS that enhances both the accuracy and timeliness of disaster warnings, thereby mitigating potential risks to vulnerable communities. Additionally, the paper explores opportunities for further refinement of these systems to better protect at-risk populations.

articleTitle: Natural Language Processing Techniques for Enhancing Automated Essay Scoring Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: In this experimental work, we explore how Automated Essay Scoring (AES) systems can be improved through the use of sophisticated Natural Language Processing (NLP) approaches. Discretion and impartiality are becoming more and more important, especially when educational institutions are depending more and more on automatic technologies to assess essays. This study examines the most recent advances in natural language processing (NLP), including syntactic parsing, deep literacy algorithms, and semantic analysis, and assesses their applicability to the ongoing refinement of AES systems. The research specifically focuses on evaluating the utility of various approaches. This work aims to address issues related to environment knowledge, consonance evaluation, and bias reduction in automated scoring using these techniques. These techniques will be integrated to achieve this. The results show that the application of sophisticated NLP techniques may produce new, valid, and trustworthy assessment problems. This could be one of the main causes of the widespread AES abandonment in educational environments. This work opens the possibility that natural language processing (NLP) could be used to change the essay score by offering a more thorough and nuanced assessment of student notes. This would have the effect of improving every facet of the teaching process.

articleTitle: IoT-Enabled Office Space Management
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Increasing the efficiency of office spaces through the implementation of technology that is connected to the Internet of Things (IoT). Through the use of Internet of Things bias, the research provides a comprehensive framework for optimising space application, perfecting energy effectiveness, and enhancing overall plant production throughout the facility. To cover and control many aspects of the workplace environment, including lighting, heating, cooling, and occupancy, the frame combines intelligent detectors, real-time data analytics, and automated systems. The approach allows for dynamic changes to office conditions that are based on current operation patterns. This brings about a reduction in functional costs and a reduction in energy waste. The approach is based on the analysis of data obtained from Internet of Things bias. In addition, the investigation investigates the perpetration issues and implicit benefits of the results of the Internet of Things, focussing on the impact that these results have on both functional effectiveness and hand pleasure. According to the findings, Internet of Things (IoT) -Enabled operation systems have the potential to drastically transform conventional office environments into workspaces that are more adaptable, efficient, and responsive. This would pave the way for future developments in smart structure technologies.

articleTitle: InvNets: A Novel Approach for Parkinson Disease Detection Using Involution Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) is a progressive neurological ailment that requires early discovery for effective treatment. Traditional PD detection methods use convolutional neural networks (CNNs), which can be computationally intensive due to their huge number of parameters. This study proposes a novel approach for PD classification utilizing Involutional Neural Networks (InvNets), which reduce the parameter-intensive nature of CNNs. The involution kernel differs from the convolution kernel in that it is both location-specific and channel-agnostic. This location-specific operation enhances the network's ability to acquire detailed elements in medical images by adapting to diverse visual patterns across spatial regions. In that regard, magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) has become an important modality for PD detection. Furthermore, image preprocessing, data augmentation techniques, and the use of Block-Matching and 4D Filtering (BM4D) for noise filtering improve the robustness and accuracy of our proposed InvNets models. The proposed model results showed that InvNets outperformed traditional CNNs in classification tasks. The InvNets architecture has shown outstanding performance, achieving a training accuracy of 99.8%, validation accuracy of 98.5%, testing accuracy of 99.1%, precision 99%, recall 99%, and F1-score 99%. The suggested InvNets model is extremely effective for medical image processing, especially in situations with limited computer resources, as seen by improved accuracy and a lower parameter count. As a result, the study found that InvNets provided consistent and accurate features for breast cancer detection and quicker diagnosis.

articleTitle: An Investigation of the role of Artificial Intelligence in the Diagnosis of Autism Spectrum Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The current study provides a succinct and illustrative account of the function artificial intelligence now plays in the evaluation of autism. Artificial intelligence is a significant factor in the early identification of autism since it facilitates faster and more accurate diagnosis processes for medical professionals. The goal of the proposed research project is to examine and apply a broad range of deep learning and machine learning methods for the early detection of ASD in very big datasets. Autism spectrum disorders are developmental and neurological in nature. It is possible to identify autism spectrum disorder (ASD) by biological imaging and social media data. An external manifestation of ASD can be observed in face features. ASD is a neurological illness that impairs brain development. Particularly by the time they hit puberty, children with ASD have facial traits that are very different from those displayed by children who are developing normally. The development of a system that detects ASD using social media and face recognition is the innovative component of this work. The models used in this classification challenge were Xception, VGG19, and NASNET Mobile. The child and adolescent analytic model used by the system is the main objective of the ASD prediction technique. The Autism Query collections are utilized to collect the behavioural parameters. This proposed study has examined several classification models that can precisely identify ASD in children exhibiting particular features when paired with the child's behavior as well as medical data.

articleTitle: Assessing DMU’s Efficiency using Data Envelopment Analysis:A machine learning approach
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Supply chain management employs should be efficient if an organization wants to optimize resources and improve competitiveness. The method used in this paper is Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) to evaluate supply chain efficiency. The technique is nonparametric and is based on examining decision making units' input-output relationships. There are some theoretical DEA frameworks such as input and output selection; linear programming for mathematical representation; the calculation of efficiency scores. The significance of DEA in assessing the performance of supply chain elements while giving direction for strategic decisions that can improve overall effectiveness cannot be overemphasized. Additionally, this research will delve into combining other machine learning techniques such as random forests, support vector machines, and artificial neural networks with DEA models.

articleTitle: Combining the AIML Model with Acoustic Signal to Evaluate the Bowel Sound
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Automated methods for assessing bowel sounds (BS) were well developed by the early 2000s. Several teams, using diverse analytical techniques, achieved high levels of accuracy. BS has shown potential in doing non-invasive research on irritable bowel syndrome, studying gastrointestinal motility, and performing surgical procedures. This article introduces hybrid convolution and recursive neural networks that are used for BS analysis. It was among the first deep-learning approaches to be extensively studied. An experimental workflow and a novel dataset from a contact microphone device were used to assess the results. Data were obtained at night, the most neuro gastroenterological intriguing time. Previous studies solely preserved daytime information, ignoring this period. The programme accurately detects bowel noises. In addition, they acquired good diagnostic specificity. Medical professionals confirmed the data, supporting the clinical diagnosis. Medical professionals may submit patient recordings and have them analyzed online using the client-server solution. Technologies are established, but BS research needs a consistent methodology, a worldwide venue for debate, & a free platform for data interchange, hence it is not widely employed. A common BS research framework may start with the server.

articleTitle: Multichannel CNN and Cross-Modal Attention Residual Network for Detection of Fake News
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Social networking sites have been one of the most widely used platforms for news consumption in the past few decades. Various educational institutions have investigated automated fake news identification as a means of countering false information, given the detrimental effects that the spread of false information on social networking sites has on both people and the community. False news can propagate swiftly on social networking sites and tells a tale more effectively than textonly information when it combines textual and visual components. The many information formats offer fresh ways to identify characteristics of false news and provide more proof that news occurrences are occurring. However, maintaining every modality's characteristics while combining pertinent data from several modalities is a problem for multimodal false news identification tasks. Furthermore, the efficiency of the framework may be impacted by background data produced by the integration of data from several modalities when it comes to certain news. Regretfully, current approaches are unable to meet these difficulties. To overcome these limitations this study employs Multichannel CNN and Cross-model attention-based residual network for detecting fake news. The study uses CMAB-BiLSTM for obtaining textual characteristics, CMABCNN-RNN to recover visual characteristics, MFB for combining these two characteristics, and MLP to identify its authenticity. The research findings indicates that the suggested framework outperforms present approaches for identifying false information.

articleTitle: Importance of Green Supply Chain Optimisation on SME Sustainability Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in industries like manufacturing now need to use sustainable supply chains more effectively to boost their financial performance and solve environmental issues in fiercely competitive marketplaces. By evaluating previous research, this study investigates the connection between performance, environmentally responsible innovation, and cooperative efforts in the workplace. The goal is to identify the factors that influence the achievement of Indian manufacturing-based SMEs in green supply chain management (GSCM). The research determines that collaborative efforts in the environmental aspects of the supply chain have a significant impact on the ability of India's small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in the manufacturing sector to develop innovative and environmentally friendly solutions. Furthermore, it finds that via environmental performance, the capacity for green innovation positively affects financial performance. In addition to offering a theoretical framework for a thorough analysis of the structural procedures connected to green supply chains, this paper suggests tactical avenues for small and medium-sized manufacturing firms (SMEs) to successfully adopt green supply chain management (GSCM).

articleTitle: Enhanced Working of Grid-linked PV with Incremental Conductance MPPT and Integrated Battery Storage
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: This paper investigates the enhanced performance of grid-connected solar photovoltaic (PV) systems using the Incremental Conductance (INC) Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) algorithm coupled with an integrated Battery Energy Storage System (BESS). The INC MPPT algorithm is implemented to optimize the extraction of maximum power from the PV array under varying environmental conditions. By accurately tracking the maximum power point, the system ensures efficient energy conversion and minimizes power losses. The integration of a Battery Energy Storage System further enhances the system's performance by saving excess available power through stages of high solar irradiance and providing power during low irradiance or peak demand periods. This hybrid approach not only stabilizes the power output but also enhances the reliability and flexibility of the grid-connected PV scheme. The study includes a comprehensive simulation analysis accomplished in MATLAB/Simulink, demonstrating the effectiveness of the INC MPPT algorithm in achieving rapid and accurate tracking under dynamic conditions. The results indicate significant improvements in energy yield and overall system efficiency compared to conventional MPPT methods. Additionally, the incorporation of BESS provides a robust solution for energy management, reducing dependency on the grid and enabling better handling of load variations. This research highlights the potential of combining advanced MPPT techniques with energy storage systems to create more resilient and efficient grid-connected solar PV systems, contributing to sustainable and reliable renewable energy solutions.

articleTitle: Impact of Electric Vehicles in the India Market
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Pollution of the environment is a global issue nowadays. The harmful emissions from internal combustion engines, such as those running on gasoline and diesel, are one of the core causes of air pollution. Electric vehicles (EVs) are being actively pushed worldwide in an effort to solve environmental concerns (ECs) and lessen the consequences of fossil fuel emissions. Governments everywhere are using incentives to get citizens to switch to electric vehicles. India is taking part in the EV30@30 Campaign. aims to reach a 30% share of electric cars (EVs) by 2030, considering the strong links between EVs and a number of sustainable development goals. By 2030, the Indian government wants the use of" only Electric Vehicles" on the road. The advent and widespread use of electric cars (EVs) in India represent a revolutionary change in the nation’s automotive industry and its dedication to environmentally friendly transportation. In addressing the government initiatives, technological breakthroughs, urban problems, global trends, and economic ramifications that are creating this transformation, this study highlights the effects of electric cars on the market in India. The determination of this study is to give a thorough analysis of the current state of the electric car market and pinpoint areas that require development. Additionally, it emphasizes suggestions for changing the law. India is adopting electric cars quickly, aiming to have a fleet made up completely of EVs by 2030.

articleTitle: Enhancing Human-Robot Interaction through Natural Language Processing and Speech Recognition Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The rapid development of artificial intelligence (AI) has resulted in the gradual integration of robots into individuals' everyday lives and professional environments. The use of image recognition employing the robot's human-machine interface technology has become widespread. However, there are still some unresolved problems with the methods used for interaction between robots and machines, such as natural language processing (NLP) and speech recognition. Thus, building on previous research in the field, this work suggests a novel approach to robot-machine interaction by integrating the perceptron lexicon analysis model with the transfer dependence syntactic analysis model. To enhance interaction performance, researchers need to delve further into language-based human-machine interaction systems. An experimental evaluation of the structural perceptron model reveals a recall rate of 82%, an F1 value of 83%, and a testing accuracy of 96%. A maximum analysis of data speed of 751K/s is achieved using the data transfer dependence syntax analysis model. With superior robustness and reaction sensitivity, the novel technique for robot-machine interaction achieves a 93% accuracy rate in comparison to previous methods that have been tested in simulations. To conclude, research methodologies provide the foundation, both theoretically and practically, for better human-machine cooperation and enhanced robot interaction skills)

articleTitle: Design & Development of Battery Management System for Electric Vehicles to Minimize Various Faults
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Every significant automaker currently has electric vehicles (EVs) on their roadmaps since they are viewed as the answer to yet another environmentally friendly transportation system that will lower greenhouse gas emissions. In electric vehicles, the battery management system (BMS) is an essential part. The BMS's job is to ensure dependable and safe battery performance. Cell balancing, charge regulation, and state monitoring and assessment are some of the features that have been added to BMS in order to preserve the battery's dependability and safety. This research focuses on simulating and modelling batteries. The primary goal of this is to use MATLAB to determine the mathematical link between the battery's input and output parameters. Through a thorough assessment of essential functional variables like state of health (SOH), temperature vacillations, electrical execution and state of charge (SOC) under fluctuating load situations, the simulation gives exhaustive comprehension of the mind boggling elements of lithium-particle batteries in applications connected with EV. The novelty of the study ensure the health and safety of batteries, the BMS was specifically developed to prevent common failures including overvoltage, undervoltage, and overcurrent. The results show that the model used for simulation accurately represents the efficiency of battery packs in real life and point to significant developments in BMS techniques, especially in the areas of predictive maintenance and adaptive charging. This research lays the foundation for more robust, effective, and intelligent storage of energy in EV by integrating computational intelligence with BMS in a seamless manner. It also signifies an important milestone in e-mobility innovation.

articleTitle: AI-Based Risk Management in Financial Services
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: When it comes to the financial services industry, efficient risk management is very necessary to guarantee stability and compliance in the face of constantly shifting market conditions. The purpose of this research study is to investigate the potential roles that artificial intelligence (AI) could play in improving risk management methods throughout financial organizations. To identify, evaluate, and mitigate financial risks, we investigate a variety of artificial intelligence techniques, such as machine learning algorithms, natural language processing procedures, and predictive analytics. Artificial intelligence models can deliver real-time insights and prediction skills that traditional approaches frequently lack. These capabilities are achieved through the analysis of historical data, transaction patterns, and market trends. Within the scope of this research project, the effectiveness of AI-driven approaches is compared to that of traditional risk management tactics. Particular attention is paid to enhancements in terms of accuracy, efficiency, and scalability. According to the findings, artificial intelligence dramatically improves risk detection and management, providing financial institutions with more powerful tools to tackle regulatory obstacles and uncertainties. This research highlights the revolutionary potential of artificial intelligence in redefining risk management frameworks, thereby paving the way for financial risk mitigation measures that are more proactive and data-driven.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning based Approach towards the Analysis of Chronic Kidney Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is characterized by a decline, in kidney function, which can lead to impairment or complete cessation of kidney function. This lasting condition involves a progression of kidney function decline and the risk of eventual kidney failure. It is essential to preserve function and prevent complications through care. The University of California manages an AI database that contains updated information, on this condition. Using AI methods this research delves into CKD and its symptoms based on the dataset mentioned earlier. This study in conclusion correctly categorizes this disorder with a notable 99.64% precision rate. The main aim of this work is to create a clear and precise model for precisely recognizing chronic kidney disease.

articleTitle: Implementing RNN and LSTM Models to Electrical Load Predictions
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Electrical utilities attach significant emphasis to power load forecasting to design the generating, transmission, and distribution systems. Additional uses of load forecasting in the power network include demand and supply management, determination of power plant operational resource needs, planning of spinning reserve, and scheduling power unit activities. Additionally, there is the option to use a plethora of other applications. The researcher used two distinct machine learning approaches, including Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), also known to forecast the expected future demand for electrical power in this study. Historical load information’s are used to assess the efficiency of implemented measures. The Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) and Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) are analytical metrics used to assess the accuracy of the methods being used.

articleTitle: An Innovative IoT-Driven Smart Streetlight Management System Design
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: This research introduces a cutting-edge approach to optimizing the management of streetlight systems through automation by using IoT. Traditional methods often suffer from inefficiencies, leading to unnecessary energy consumption and maintenance costs. In this study, we propose a novel automated streetlight management system that leverages advanced technologies such as IoT sensors, machine learning algorithms, and smart scheduling mechanisms. By dynamically adjusting lighting levels based on real-time factors such as traffic density, weather conditions, and time of day, our system aims to achieve significant energy savings while ensuring optimal illumination for pedestrians and vehicles. We present the design architecture of our system, along with experimental results demonstrating its effectiveness in various urban environments. Our findings highlight the potential of automated streetlight management systems to enhance sustainability, improve safety, and reduce operational expenses for municipalities and urban planners.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Futuristic Scope of Artificial Intelligence in the Healthcare Sector in India
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: With the use of enormous databases, artificial intelligence (AI) methods are transforming the evaluation of illnesses by recognizing trends and building trustworthy systems. This method, along with the availability of large healthcare records enables physicians in India to establish more reliable diagnostic instruments, optimizing the outcomes of patients. The study examines the application of AI on information associated with liver and cardiac illnesses. A novel nutcracker search- driven kernelized support vector machine (NS-KSVM) framework is presented in this work to effectively analyze liver and cardiac illnesses. In the framework, the NS optimization strategy is employed to enhance the KSVM's parameters. To train the NS-KSVM method, datasets are initially collected from public sources. Then, a min-max scalar is applied to raw data samples for normalizing purposes. After that, linear discriminant analysis (LDA) is employed to extract the significant features from the normalized data. Then, the illness prediction process is carried out by the proposed method. This research is implemented in a Python tool to analyze the NS- KSVM's performance in terms of various metrics. It demonstrated that our proposed method achieved better performance in the healthcare sector than other existing methodologies.

Author Keywords: nutcracker search-driven kernelized support vector machine (NS-KSVM)

articleTitle: Advancing Dental Radiograph Analysis: A Convolutional Neural Network Approach for Enhanced Diagnostic Precision
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Diagnosing many dental diseases including cavities, fillings, impacted teeth, and implants depends on dental radiography. Dental professionals have always been the accurate interpreters of these radiographs; this takes time and is prone to mistakes. This work automates the classification of dental radiographs into five categories: Cavity, Fillings, Impacted Tooth, Implant, and Normal using deep learning, more especially CNNs. We constructed a CNN model able to learn and extract features from images using TensorFlow and Keras, hence improving classification accuracy without hand feature extraction. Having been trained on 25,136 photos from the Kaggle platform, the model attained an accuracy of 89%. This method seeks to improve healthcare delivery by means of enhanced diagnostic accuracy, lower human error, and support of artificial intelligence integration into clinical environments. The suggested system advances dental diagnostics by helping to ensure fair access to quality dental treatment and by supporting sustainable development in healthcare.

articleTitle: Fault Estimation-Based Design of Robust Fault Tolerant Controller for Descriptor System: A Decoupled Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: This work deals with active robust fault tolerant control (FTC) design for uncertain Descriptor systems (DS) with unknown actuator faults. An adaptive augmented sliding mode observer (AUIO) is introduced to estimate the system states, actuator faults and external uncertainties in the system. Further, the FTC module is designed based on the robust sliding mode philosophy to compensate for the effect of actuator faults and external uncertainties on the system. The integrated FE based robust FTC eliminates directional interaction between then estimation and control modules that is present in the conventional design framework of integrated FE-based FTC systems. A detailed investigation is carried out for stability and robustness analysis of the proposed method. Finally, the claim made is verified with simulation study of a DC motor controlled inverted pendulum modeled as DS.

articleTitle: Integration of Vision and Language in Multi-Mode Video Converters (Partially) Aligns with the Brain
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: One of the most important requirements for providing AI systems with a foundation, in reality, is the integration of data from many modalities is yet unclear how successfully these models include modalities, even though there has been some progress in the development of video transformers that can learn by watching the video, reading text, and listening to audio over time. Here, the researcher provides an encouraging method for testing a multimodal video transformer model that has already been trained, using findings from neuroscience that show how the brain processes information in a multimodal fashion. By utilising brain recordings of individuals who were viewing a well-known television show, researchers investigate the influence that multi-modal connections and interactions have on the alignment of multi-modal and uni-modal brain regions in multi-modal video transformers that have previously been well-trained. Evidence suggests that visual processing improves masked prediction ability in linguistic processing; this lends credence to the idea that models including representations from many modalities might have a positive impact on each one. Despite this, researchers have not discovered any evidence that the combined multi-modal transformer representations collect any more brain-relevant information beyond what is already recorded by each modality. Show, last, that a task requiring vision-language inferences may be used for fine-tuning to enhance the brain alignments of the already trained joint representation. These results suggest that multi-modal transformers can integrate vision and language in ways that are somewhat relevant to the brain, which is encouraging. However, also found that additional techniques may be needed to improve the brain alignment of these models.

articleTitle: AI based Algorithm for Environmental and Techno-economic analysis in Grid-connected Charging Station of Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: By combining solar and wind energy sources, renewable microgrids lower greenhouse gas emissions while improving security, dependability, and power quality in power systems. The three alternative configurations' technological, economical, and environmental viability are examined using meta-heuristic methodologies. The optimisation technique aims to minimise the overall net current cost and levelized energy cost while maintaining a low chance of a power supply outage. The salp swarm algorithm, the grey wolf optimisation, and the modified salp swarm algorithm are used to the same issue, and the results are compared to those of the MSSA in order to validate the quality of the solution achieved using the MSSA. It is promoting the use of renewable resources and optimizing energy systems for better efficiency and reduced environmental impact.

articleTitle: The Role of Overconfidence in Trading: Behavioral Patterns and Market Impacts
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The purpose of this research is to investigate the role that overconfidence plays in trading, with a particular emphasis on how behaviors that are affected by cognitive bias affect the dynamics of requests. Overconfidence, a mental condition that is common among dealers, frequently results in excessive trading and risk-taking, both of which have the potential to alter the effectiveness of requests and add to volatility. The study identifies significant patterns linked with foolish decision-making by analyzing trading data and behavioral inclinations. These patterns include overvaluing one's knowledge, undervaluing potential risks, and dismissing information from the outside world. Based on the data, it appears that overconfidence not only has an effect on the trading behavior of individuals, but it also has wide-ranging implications for the stability of requests and the pricing of other assets. The research underlines how important it is to have a solid grasp of these behavioral tendencies to devise techniques that help mitigate the adverse effects that overconfidence can have on asking for financial assistance. This investigation contributes to the expanding body of research on behavioral finance by providing insights that have the potential to inspire individual trading strategies as well as nonsupervisory programs that are designed to improve request adaptability.

articleTitle: Real-Time Data Processing and Analytics in IoT Cloud Computing Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: From the cloud computing systems perspective, IoT real-time data analytics plays a major role in innovation boost and the value creation of a number of industries. This paper proposes a method for operations of real-time analytics in the internet of things cloud configurations with the background of data collection, ingestion, processing, analysis, and visualization. Adoption of intelligent technologies like machine learning, edge computing, and cloud-native architectures, the algorithm will easily transform the raw data from IoT streams into real-time actionable insights for the organizations. Having a system in order with a methodical approach, which includes identifying data sources, query processing, and scalability evaluation enables organizations to design and implement robust, resilient and cost-effective real time analytics ones that are tailor-made to suit the unique requirements of the organization. Through the value-based analysis, the key role of an immediate glimpse depicting process improvement, better decision making, and profit generation as well as customer experience perfection are emphasized. While robust uses the word that meshes several key ideas and has a negative connotation privacy and security measures aim for data integrity, confidentiality, compliance, and data protection against possible risks and liabilities (as criticism, protection, or a plan). The creation of an environment where people think innovatively and collaborate with each other and have the ability to review and build on their performance can be done with the help of the real-time data analytics. This can drive the businesses to sustainable growth and success in the digital era.

articleTitle: IoT-Enabled Educational Management Systems: Enhancing Efficiency and Accessibility
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Using administrative tools that use Internet of Things (IoT) technology could make educational places much easier to get to and more useful. The Internet of Things (IoT) can speed up administrative tasks, improve communication between stakeholders, collect real-time data, and make personalised learning plans possible. It can also be used to improve the efficiency of school administration systems. This study looks into the many ways that the Internet of Things (IoT) can improve school administration. Some of these ways are managing resources, tracking attendance automatically, making classrooms smarter, and improving safety. With the help of the Internet of Things (IoT), schools can improve the accessibility and inclusiveness of their learning settings, cut costs, and run their businesses more efficiently.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Analysis of Intrusion Detection Systems Based on Artificial Intelligence Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Machine learning (ML)is primarily utilized in intrusion detection systems (IDS) to autonomously discover and classify intrusions at both the system and host tiers. Criminal assaults are unpredictable and happen in high quantities, posing obstacles for scaled solutions. The cybersecurity area can research various malicious databases that are open to everyone. Currently, no investigation has analyzed the outcomes of ML techniques on openly accessible databases. To keep up with the ever-changing characteristics of malicious code, accessible databases should be regularly upgraded and contrasted. The Internet of Things (IoT) is revolutionizing the medical field and has the potential to revolutionize technology, society, and the economy, leading to a better tomorrow. To increase IoT safety, this study requires IoT-specific databases, instruments, and approaches. As a consequence, safeguarding the IoT-based medical environment against intrusions becomes critical. The fundamental motive of this investigation is to show how ML and RNN approaches are utilized to build an IDS in an IoT-orientated context for classifying and detecting unexpected intrusions. The data from routers is regulated and preprocessed. This investigation subsequently utilized a particle swarm technique with a bio-based layout to maximize the qualities. Traditional data are used to undertake a thorough study of RNN and associated ML experiments for recognizing intrusions.

articleTitle: Integrating Artificial Intelligence for Sustainable and Adaptable Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: In nature, flexibility is essential, and AI may enhance it in architecture. The article integrates AI to develop self-learning buildings that can adapt to future obstacles. This research aims to create structures that use sensors to gather environmental data and respond. Phases comprise this study's strategy. In Phase 1, AI in architecture is extensively researched. That study in Phase 1 guided Phase 2's building design. The parametric building design in phase 2 uses machine learning and computational design techniques. Grasshopper scripting and Rhino modelling were used to create an algorithm that would create shapes that would both biomimetic the process of coral growth and be tailored to the project's chosen location. The selection procedure for the produced experimental investigations is shown in Phase 3. To determine which type used the least amount of energy, many evaluations were conducted, including measurements of sunshine, radiation, and shadows. Phase 4 involves developing the shape to improve the building's efficiency. Phase 5 involves conducting performance assessments to demonstrate that the final form is highly adaptable and climatic or ecologically sensitive. This building's radiation exposure, according to the research, is between 200 and 300 kWh/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. According to the shadow study, the building shape casts a shadow for eight hours. According to the analysis, the building's shape makes it more adaptive by reducing its energy use. An AI engine technology is used in the last stage to forecast the building's future growth. By incorporating technology into building design, we may create flexible structures that reduce building energy use and contribute to the creation of a sustainable world

articleTitle: Analysis and Recognition of Blood Cells to Detect Leukaemia Using Stack-Trained and Colour-Trained Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Leukemia is a lethal cancer condition that impacts people of every demographic, both kids and adolescents. It is a leading factor for mortality globally. It has a special relationship with White Blood Cells (WBC), followed by an increase in young lymphocytes, and triggers bone marrow and blood harm. As a result, timely and accurate cancer detection is essential for effective treatment and increased lifetime chances. At present, diagnosing the condition requires physical examination of blood specimens using microscopic visuals, which can be laborious and inaccurate. Under the microscope, cells with leukemia resemble normal cells, making diagnosis challenging. This paper introduces a novel stack and color-trained convolution neural network (CNN) for diagnosing leukemia blood cells using microscopic visuals of blood specimens. This study allowed us to autonomously recognize and categorize 7 types of blood cells, unlike previously reported techniques that often concentrated solely on a single kind of blood cell. This study concluded that by integrating statistical form and structural factors into the basic leukocyte numbers of traditional evaluation, CNN-based computerized blood cell assessment has a chance to simplify and enhance routine diagnoses.

articleTitle: Grid Search Hyperparameters Tuning with Supervised Machine Learning for Awngi Language Named Entity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Named entity recognition has emerged as a critical step in recognizing, classifying, and extracting the most significant information from unstructured text without human intervention. It is used in information retrieval, conversation systems, machine translation, data mining, and information extraction. However, the Awngi language lacks a NER system due to inadequate datasets. This study combines feature extraction techniques with supervised machine learning algorithms, including support vector machines, Naïve Bayes, and conditional random fields with a grid search algorithm parameter optimization. These supervised machine-learning models often have various hyperparameters that must be tuned to optimize the model's performance by automatically selecting the parameter. Furthermore, the dataset used for training and testing consists of 20,193 annotated Awngi tokens, collected from Amhara Media Corporation, Awngi Telegram, and Facebook pages. The proposed SVM with grid search algorithm approach provided a promising result in ANER with an accuracy of 92% compared with Naïve Bayes, conditional random field, and decision-tree supervised machine learning models. Finally, the experiment results show that the proposed parameter tuning-based model can detect and categorize Awingi-named entities and outperforms the performance accuracy without parameter adjustment.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Models for Predictive Marketing Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The objective of this study is to perform an investigation into the utilization of machine literacy models within the framework of prophetic marketing analytics. Because they make use of vast amounts of consumer data, machine literacy algorithms can recognise patterns and trends that traditional statistical approaches would be unable to recognise. This study investigates several different machine literacy approaches, including retrogression analysis, decision trees, and neural networks, to read client motions and preferences. Examples of these techniques include. It is important to concentrate attention on the sensitive character of the model, as well as its interpretability and its connection to the real world. The results of the inquiry demonstrate how improved marketing strategies may be achieved through the utilization of these advanced models, which offer a practical perspective. The result of this is that it can eventually lead to improved client targeting, marketing juggernauts that are substantiated, and an improvement in return on investment. The purpose of this article is to make a contribution to the growing body of knowledge in the field of predictive analytics by giving an in-depth assessment of how machine literacy has the potential to alter marketing processes by making them more data-driven and efficient.

articleTitle: Forensic Eye: Convolutional Neural Network-based Crime Scene Object Detection System
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Forensic investigations rely heavily on the accurate detection and analysis of crime related objects present at crime scenes. Traditional methods of object detection often involve manual labor and are error prone process to human error. In recent years, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have shown remarkable success in various computer vision tasks, including in object detection. In this article, we introduce ForensicEye, a novel CNN-based crime scene object detection system designed to assist forensic investigators in identifying the objects related to the crime. It utilizes a state-of-the-art CNN architecture trained on a large dataset of crime scene images, enabling robust detection even in challenging lighting and environmental conditions. We evaluated the performance of the ForensicEye on benchmark datasets with various preprocessing techniques, demonstrating its superior accuracy and efficiency compared to traditional methods. Our proposed model achieved the accuracy of 96.2%, precision of 97.9%, Recall of 96.9%, F1-score of 97.4%.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Model to Analyse Noisy Data by Scanning Probe Microscope
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The emergence of massive multidimensional datasets may be attributed to the fast advancement of spectral imaging technologies in scanning probes, electrons, and visual microscopy during the past decade. When reducing hyperspectral data to lower-dimensional materials-specific properties, functional fitting is often used. This method requires determining the parameters of the fit function, but it is recognized how to estimate it. The problem is that iterative approaches, such as least-square gradient descent, that attempt to fit noisy data functionally might provide misleading results because they are so vulnerable to first assumptions. They provide a method for reducing hyperspectral data by use of a machine learning technique. By combining machine learning with a least-squares method, the efficacy signal-to-noise ratio of band-excitation piezoresponse force microscopy is shown to be over an order of magnitude higher. This enables characterisation even with extremely tiny driving signals or weak material responses.

articleTitle: Data Science collaboration in Human AI: Decision Optimization using Human-centered Automation
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Through human-centered automation, the fusion of artificial intelligence (AI) and human expertise has enabled notable progress in decision optimization. This work examines the relationship between data science and human-AI cooperation, with a focus on improving decision-making across a range of fields. AI systems are capable of processing and interpreting enormous volumes of data, finding patterns and insights that may escape human analysts, by utilizing sophisticated machine learning algorithms and data analytics. But to refine these automated procedures and guarantee morally sound, transparent, and contextually appropriate results, human judgment must be incorporated. This paper explores methods for maximizing decision-making through the integration of human-centered and AI-driven automation. It presents case studies of how cooperation between humans and AI has enhanced productivity, accuracy, and adaptability in challenging decision-making situations. It also tackles issues like user trust, bias prevention, and the dynamic interaction between machine precision and human intuition. The outcomes address how critical it is to promote a mutually beneficial partnership between humans and AI, supporting systems that enhance human skills while upholding diversity and responsibility. This study adds to the continuing conversation about the nature of employment in the future by putting forth a well-balanced paradigm in which AI efficiencies and human insights work together to produce the best possible decisions.

articleTitle: Intelligent Spectrum Resource Management Integrating Time and Space & Frequency Domain Sensing Data
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Edge computing is a promising model for building the IIoT because it transfers computationally intensive tasks from devices with limited resources to servers in the network's periphery, where they are more robustly powered. To fulfil the quality-of-service demands of different applications, it is important to effectively manage the available spectrum resources, taking into account the spectrum's restrictions, the battery's health, and the characteristics of the changes in the spectrum. Using time-space-frequency interference analysis to optimise variables, thinking motors to deduce inactive channels from backup channel lists and training motors for selecting the most suitable backup channels based on past data this study suggests a biological algorithm-based platform for intelligent flexible spectrum resource management. Researchers put the proposed spectrum resource management system through its paces by tracking variables such as energy usage, connection maintenance likelihood, the quantity of IoT devices, the amount of spectrum handoffs, and optimally transmitted parameters across all traffic scenarios. The outcomes show that the suggested system outperforms the current spectrum supply organization purposes.

articleTitle: Role of Renewable Energy in Sustainable Development
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Developing energy sustainably involves efficiently using every resource that is accessible, whether they are renewable or non-renewable, including financial, human, and technological resources. The increasing depletion of natural fossil fuel supplies and the consequent harm to the natural environment need the search for alternatives. A comprehensive understanding of the advantages and disadvantages of several possible energy-producing sources may be achieved via a comparative analysis. This article aims to provide a thorough examination of the advantages and disadvantages of using renewable energy sources (RES), by the principles of sustainable development. The research utilizes description approaches, which include making comparisons. From 2000 to 2022, the data was sourced from the Central Statistical Office (CSO) and the Energy Regulatory Office (ERO). Investments in renewable energy (RE) should be heavily subsidized and encouraged by the government, particularly in rural regions, by ecological development principles. The effort to systematize factors that influence renewable energy use identified the significance of economic conditions and traditional approaches to the energy sector; the desire to protect the natural world by reducing pollution and modifying the greenhouse gas effect; the need to educate culture on the execution and rapid growth of technology; and the desire to increase self-reliance and individuality.

articleTitle: AI in E-commerce Personalization
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: This study investigates the revolutionary impact that artificial intelligence (AI) has had on personalization practices technologies have become increasingly important in improving customer experiences through acclimatized relationships as the evolution of online purchasing proceeds. The purpose of this study is to investigate how artificial intelligence-driven algorithms analyze stoners' preferences regarding gestures and their buying history to provide personalized product recommendations, targeted announcements, and dynamic content. E-commerce companies can generate largely tailored shopping gestures by utilizing machine literacy and data analytics. These gestures have the potential to boost customer happiness and motivate customers to make purchases. Along the same lines as data sequestration businesses and algorithmic impulses, the study also offers a discussion of the difficulties and ethical problems that are involved with the implementation of artificial intelligence in personalization. The exploration provides insight into how businesses can effectively integrate these technologies to optimize their personalization ideas and maintain a competitive advantage in the digital business world. This is accomplished throughcase studies, which highlight the benefits and implicit risks of artificial intelligence in e-commerce.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Position based Routing in Wireless Sensor Networks using DREAM and LAR Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The limited energy and transmission capacities of wireless sensor networks and MANET present serious routing issues. Two energy-efficient position-based routing algorithms, Energy-efficient DREAM convergence and Energy-efficient LAR Coordinate routing, have been proposed in response to these issues. The development of these algorithms is based on the concepts of Location-Aided Routing (LAR) and Distance Routing Effect Algorithm for Mobility (DREAM). To successfully reduce routing overhead, our suggested algorithms make use of strategies like "compass routing" and "most forward within a specified radius."
