Increasing the overall network lifetime of Mobile Ad-hoc Networks (MANETs) is the main objective, with a special emphasis on sensor networks and MANET. We have rigorously experimented to prove our approach's effectiveness. The findings show a significant decrease in the number of hops needed between the source and the destination for different convergence angles. This shows that, in the context of position-based routing, energy usage in MANET nodes during data transmission has been successfully minimized. Our suggested method introduces energy-efficient algorithms that improve routing and lengthen network lifespan, thereby addressing the difficulties presented by energy and transmission limits in wireless sensor networks and MANET. The experimental findings demonstrate how well our method works in lowering hop counts and decreasing energy loss in MANET nodes while transmitting data.

articleTitle: Improving Sepsis Detection through Enchanced Random Forest and SMOTE: An Innovative Method for Addressing Class Imbalance
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Severe sepsis is a deadly condition in which the immune system's reaction to an infection causes extensive inflammation. Although the immune system is designed to fight off bacteria, it sometimes attacks internal organs instead. This can increase the risk of blood clots, which in turn can reduce the blood and oxygen supply to vital organs, potentially resulting in organ failure and death. To diagnose sepsis, various diagnostic methods including laboratory tests and imaging are necessary, as the disease can be asymptomatic in its early stages. Early detection is crucial for improving patient outcomes. Given the challenges in diagnosing sepsis, researchers and medical professionals are actively seeking innovative ways to predict the condition earlier. In the healthcare sector, data mining and machine learning play a vital role. Machine learning models offer enhanced accuracy in analyzing medical data. For this research work, the model is developed for the prediction of sepsis using an advanced version of the random forest algorithm, known as the Adaptive Entropy Random Forest algorithm. We utilized the MIMIC III Database, which includes patient vital signs, demographic information, and test results. The dataset contains a class imbalance, indicating that there are significantly fewer instances of sepsis than there are non-sepsis cases. In order to rectify this, we created artificial instances of the minority class utilizing SMOTE technology (Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique), which balanced the dataset. The balancing dataset was subsequently submitted to this technique, and its efficacy was assessed using measures for accuracy, precision, recall and F1 score. The algorithm operated more accurately with the balanced data, as demonstrated by the results of the pre- and post-SMOTE performance comparisons.Applying the SMOTE approach, the algorithm provides the greatest accuracy value of 98.6.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Workforce Planning and Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Workforce planning and analytics are two of the most significant goals that may be accomplished through their appropriate use. Two of the most crucial goals are to optimize organizational performance and adjust to changing market conditions. This research study aims to assess how deep learning technology can be applied to enhance workforce analytics and planning. We employ advanced neural network architectures, such as convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and recurrent neural networks (RNNs), to offer novel approaches for evaluating workforce data, predicting personnel trends, and improving decision-making processes. We propose several different forms of neural networks, some of which are exemplified by the neural networks shown above. To accomplish this investigation's goal, a comprehensive evaluation of multiple deep learning models and their ability to handle workforce datasets on a big scale is underway. This study will focus on three main areas of analysis: forecasting employee turnover, detecting skill gaps, and allocating resources as efficiently as possible. We demonstrate how deep learning algorithms may produce useful insights, guide decisions about human resource strategy, and further business goals using actual test results and case study completion. The results of our study demonstrate how deep learning has the power to completely transform traditional workforce management techniques. They also offer a framework that may be used to integrate these technologies with already-in-use analytics systems, enhancing the precision and effectiveness of labor planning.

articleTitle: Optimized PV Power Under Partial Shading Using CIO-based MPPT Method
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: In this paper, a metaheuristic strategy based on Circle-Inspired Optimization (CIO) algorithm is used to enhance power point tracking in partially shaded photovoltaic (PV) arrays. Traditional MPPT algorithms often fail in non-uniform shading conditions. This is due to reduced power generation, consumption, and reverse bias in shaded cells, leading to energy inefficiency and overheating. This study introduces the Circle-Inspired Optimization, the algorithm effectively captures the maximum power point in varying partial shading scenarios. The algorithm provides the optimum operating point and has low dependence on initial guess, allowing it to find a more exact solution. The CIO exhibits quick convergence in all analyzed issues. Complex optimization issues can be solved with the help of the Circle-Inspired Optimization Algorithm. When compared directly to other algorithms, the CIO produced the best global optimization result. Simulations are used in this study to confirm the CIO algorithm's efficacy. In terms of tracking efficiency, speed, and maximum power acquisition, it performs better than other well-known algorithms. As a result, the CIO algorithm offers a viable way to achieve effective and economical MPPT in PV systems when partially shaded.

articleTitle: Classification and Signal Detection in Shared Spectrum Using a Deep Learning Method
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: In shared spectrum networks, proper signal type identification is essential for equitable coexistence and effective resource allocation. To increase system throughput and prevent accidents, particularly in situations when the environment is changing quickly, it may be utilised for scheduling gearbox chances. To train deep neural networks, or DNNs, to distinguish coexisting signal kinds without encoding them, researchers use the In-phase/Quadrature (I/Q) sample as input. Two neural networks, one convolutional and one recurrent, are trained using input segments taken from the received signal samples utilising categorical cross-entropy (CE) optimisation. Results for the 5-6 GHz unlicensed band, where LTE LAA, Wi-Fi, and 5G NR-U signals coexist, demonstrate that the suggested architecture is quite accurate. After that, use spectral analysis on the I/Q sequence to boost classification precision even further. More data in the frequency domain may be shown as a spectrogram by using a Short-time Fourier Transform (STFT). Increasing the size of the DNN's input accordingly. Researchers use USRP radios to carry out over-the-air (OTA) tests that validate the efficacy of the suggested detection system. In both software and hardware trials, the suggested method achieves precise categorization.

articleTitle: Survey of AI and ML Techniques for Enhancing Performance of 5G Cognitive Radio Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The importance of Cognitive Radio (CR) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) in 5G communication systems is paramount, as these technologies provide effective solutions to critical issues such as spectrum scarcity, escalating data demands, and network congestion. CR facilitates dynamic spectrum access, enabling Secondary Users (SUs) to exploit underutilized licensed spectrum without causing interference to Primary Users (PUs). This paper investigates the integration of AI and machine learning (ML) techniques into Cognitive Radio Networks, focusing on main functions: spectrum sensing, spectrum management, spectrum sharing, and spectrum mobility. Various spectrum handoff strategies including proactive, reactive, and hybrid approaches are discussed to illustrate the balance between latency and operational efficiency. AI-driven techniques such as Q-learning, reinforcement learning, and swarm intelligence are employed to optimize spectrum handoff, enhance decision-making processes, and mitigate service disruptions. Additionally, optimization algorithms like Artificial Bee Colony (ABC), Ant Colony Optimization (ACO), and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) are reviewed how to significantly increase spectrum availability while minimizing handoff delays in the domain of CRNs. The potential for incorporating advanced ML models, such as transformers and generative adversarial networks, is also examined to further enhance spectrum efficiency within 5G environments. These innovations are critical for maintaining continuous, high-quality communication in next-generation networks.

articleTitle: Impact of Emerging Technologies on Financial Management Systems: AI, ML, and Cybersecurity Perspectives
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The purpose of this research study is to investigate the transformative effects that emerging technologies have on financial management systems, with a particular emphasis on artificial intelligence (AI), machine literacy (ML), and cybersecurity. This is because artificial intelligence and machine learning offer increased capabilities for data analysis, predictive modelling, and decision-making processes. This is because financial institutions are borrowing less of these technologies. By altering traditional methods of financial operation, the combination of artificial intelligence and machine learning improves the functional efficacy, delicacy, and strategic perceptivity of a system. Nevertheless, this transition in technology also includes the introduction of substantial cybersecurity challenges, which pose a challenge to the sophisticated security fabrics that are used to protect sensitive financial information from growing mistakes. The study investigates the interaction between these technologies and the steps taken to ensure cybersecurity, highlighting both opportunities and potential difficulties. The exploration finds significant trends and provides recommendations for effectively utilising artificial intelligence and machine learning while adhering to stringent cybersecurity rules. This is accomplished through employing a complete analysis. It is the purpose of this study to make a contribution to the understanding of how emerging technologies are transforming the operation of the financial system and to provide strategic counsel for navigating the issues that are connected with this.

articleTitle: Cybersecurity And Ipr: Legal And Policy Frameworks For Innovation Management And Promotion
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: This article's goal is to initiate a conversation on how publicly funded R&D may help improve cyber security and privacy. Businesses and institutions must immediately implement innovative, robust, and state-of-the-art computer security and privacy solutions in this very risky environment. The public and commercial sectors must work together in a systematic and coordinated fashion to solve this problem. When it comes to increasing the impact of R&D on cyber security and privacy, every major player in the innovation ecosystem—from policymakers to incumbent service providers to emerging innovators—has their own opinion. All of these major players in the ecosystem are interdependent on one another. This study presents a research instrument and framework for management of innovation in cyber security and privacy, with the goal of establishing an integrated picture. Research and development literature and the concept of road mapping form the basis of the research instrument and framework.

articleTitle: Meta-Learning for Efficient Cross-Domain Sentiment Categorization: Leveraging Small Training Datasets for Enhanced Classifier Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Researchers and technologists working on sentiment categorization algorithms need to collect and organize data for every new domain. Annotating these corpora is expensive work, particularly in areas where features change over time. Therefore, this study explores the concept of training classifiers on a small range of domains before applying them to more domains. One problem is that when the data of training and testing distribution differ, classifiers usually perform poorly. A further problem is that it's not obvious how to select domains that will be appropriate for training and testing other domains based on similarities. To overcome this challenge, we develop classifiers that are adaptable and still perform well on test sets obtained from various distributions by applying several, smaller training datasets, we propose to improve cross-domain embedding learning for the Few-Shot Learning (FSL) environment by using the most recent advancements in Meta-Learning (MetaL).

articleTitle: Comparison of Refractive Indices of Binary Liquid Mixtures of Diethyl Carbonate and Some Alcohols Using Various Empirical and Semi-Empirical Rules
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Applicability of eight empirical and semi-empirical rules to predict the refractive index of binary organic liquid mixtures has been examined. Various binary mixtures have been chosen with a view to generalize the outcome on the basis of diversified experimental data. It has been found that no single rule is applicable with same accuracy for every mixture and applicability of these empirical and semi-empirical rules varies according to the degree of molecular interaction among the mixture-components.

articleTitle: Transforming Business Intelligence using Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: A wide range of businesses values generation through decision-making is crucial use business intelligence solutions. Business Intelligence is the process of using existing data to extract, analyse, and forecast business-critical insights. This paper looks at how artificial intelligence and data analytics are revolutionising business intelligence and how this has drastically changed how businesses plan their plans and make decisions. Business need to use ML and business intelligence to obtain an competitive hand and pursue informed choices in the present information driven market. This study takes a gander at how strategies from machine learning can be applied to further develop significant business experiences. An apple dataset was exposed to three unique classifiers: Random Forest, Decision Tree, and SVM. This article shows how machine learning algorithms may revolutionise business intelligence and provide businesses with a competitive edge. Businesses may predict future trends, find hidden patterns, and automate decision-making processes by utilising machine learning algorithms. The importance of selecting the right classifier for predictive modelling is further shown by the fact that Random Forest outperformed all other classifiers evaluated by 92%. This study also emphasises how important it is for business organisations to use machine learning and data analytics in order to improve business insights and drive business success.

articleTitle: Leveraging High-Performance Computing in Smart Contracts and Decentralized Finance: Innovations in Financial Transactions
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The incorporation of smart contracts with decentralized finance (DeFi) is causing a revolution in fiscal geography by providing additional sale mechanisms that are transparent, secure, and efficient. This exploratory article investigates the role that smart contracts play in developing decentralized finance platforms. Particular attention is paid to the capacity of smart contracts to automate and streamline complicated financial procedures without the need for intermediaries. The research investigates the significant innovations that smart contracts bring to the realm of financial transactions. These innovations include programmable financial instruments, automated asset operation, and uncertain exchanges. These contracts can apply agreements with perfection thanks to the utilization of blockchain technology, which helps to reduce the risks that are linked with conventional financial systems. There are also problems and implied traps that are discussed in the study. These include security vulnerabilities and nonsupervisory hurdles, both of which have the potential to affect the widespread abandonment of smart contracts in decentralized finance. In conclusion, this investigation sheds light on how smart contracts have the potential to revolutionize the future of finance by facilitating the provision of further decentralized, efficient, and easily accessible financial services.

articleTitle: Exploring Advancements in 6G Wireless Networks for the Future of High-Speed Connectivity
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: High-speed connectivity technologies that aim to be faster and more secure have been explored so that there will be a change of the very nature of wireless communication. This article presents advances concerning the high-speed connection component of the sixth-generation wireless networks, which is simply denoted as 6G. Different performance parameters of 6G are compared with 4G (LTE) and 5G (5G) through multiplicity of research analyses done across disciplines. Our findings suggested that 6G networks are incredibly dynamic and will change how the internet is used. These SixG networks are due to accompany massive data transmission rates of 100 Gbps, five times higher than 5G’s 20 Gbps. Latency also approaches same level as 6G where on average 1 millisecond is noticed compared to 5G's 10 and 4G's 50. Server speed and its response time in milliseconds will expose room for a number of real-time applications from only augmented reality imaging to the world of driverless automobiles and interactive games. Our study outlines the major consequences of the coming health shift. 4G allowed only for slow/limited improvements in healthcare whereas the 5G made telemedicine possible. On the other hand, 6G reportedly offers "precision remote surgery", allowing surgeons to be located remotely of a patient while still performing a high precision surgery. Attitude of people becomes completely unaware when they are briefed about concepts of latest generation known as 6G. Before studying about 6G, the number of those are eagerly delighted are 20%, having no idea on how it will be is 50%, while the other 30% are skeptics. Meanwhile, once people are better cognizant of 6G, fanatics raise up from 60 percent and sceptics drop till 10 percent. The significant shift is a reflection of 6G technology in the stakeholders’ mind.

articleTitle: Neural Networks for Real-Time Fraud Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: For companies and financial institutions trying to safeguard themselves against financial losses and security breaches, real-time fraud detection poses a serious challenge. The goal of this research is to better understand how neural networks can be used to enhance real-time systems' ability to identify fraudulent activities. This work aims to present a novel framework for the more accurate and efficient identification and reduction of fraudulent activities by utilizing cutting-edge neural network architectures, such as recurrent neural networks and deep learning. To find intricate patterns and anomalies that point to fraudulent activity, the research requires building and deploying a multi-layered neural network model that has been trained on enormous transaction datasets. Evaluations of performance indicate significant gains in detection speed and accuracy when compared to traditional techniques. The information suggests that adding neural networks to fraud detection systems could greatly enhance real-time monitoring, reduce false positives, and strengthen security protocols in general. The present study offers a noteworthy contribution to the ongoing advancements in fraud detection technologies and offers crucial perspectives for the use of neural networks in financial and transaction security domains.

articleTitle: Natural Language Processing in Strategic Planning Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Natural Language Processing (NLP) has emerged as a game-changing technique in the field of strategic planning analysis. This development represents a significant step forward. Improved methods for obtaining meaningful insights from massive amounts of textual data are made available by natural language processing (NLP). According to the findings of this research project, the application of natural language processing (NLP) technology to enhance the strategic planning processes that are carried out within enterprises is being investigated. Natural language processing (NLP) approaches, such as semantic analysis, sentiment identification, and topic modeling, can be utilized to acquire a more in-depth grasp of market tendencies, consumer feedback, and internal communications. This can be accomplished by utilizing these techniques. The study demonstrates how natural language processing (NLP) can facilitate the discovery of emergent patterns, simplify the understanding of data, and encourage decision-making that is driven by data. There are a great number of case studies that demonstrate the incorporation of natural language processing (NLP) into strategic frameworks. These case studies show improvements in the accuracy of forecasting, risk management, and competitive analysis processes. The findings of this study demonstrate the potential for natural language processing (NLP) to revolutionize strategic planning by providing a more nuanced and comprehensive evaluation of qualitative data. This, in turn, will ultimately result in strategic decisions that are more informed and agile.

articleTitle: PLC Based Humidity and Carbon Dioxide Monitoring and Control System for Industries using SCADA Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: To optimize manufacturing processes and ensure environmental compliance, careful management of humidity and carbon dioxide levels is crucial in industrial contexts. The creation and deployment of a monitoring and control system that measures humidity and CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> levels accurately using the Vaisala GMW90 sensor is presented in this study. The Allen-Bradley MicroLogix 1400 Series A PLC provides power to the system. PLC manages digital input/output operations. However, for an analog signal, we use an analog input module that is integrated before the PLC, and an analog output module is attached following the PLC to handle continuous analog signals. Analog signals are scaled to guarantee precise control and monitoring. Wonderware's InTouch SCADA software provides real-time monitoring and control since continuous visibility of sensor data is required. By tackling the issues of intermittent data visibility in industrial settings, this technology enables smooth automation and effective environmental control. Because of its enhanced control accuracy, scalability, and adaptability, the suggested solution can be applied to various industrial applications that call for constant ecological monitoring.

articleTitle: A review of Augmented Reality (AR) and Virtual Reality (VR) applications in the Digital Healthcare Training and Education Sector
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The importance of good healthcare in any country cannot be debated and like any other field, technological advancements are rapidly taking over the healthcare industry. In this shifting scenario, healthcare practitioners are looking for cost-effective, easily accessible ways to learn and practice medicine without posing a danger to patients’ health. AR and VR systems can provide applications and products that can effectively imitate healthcare situations. This paper explores the AR and VR applications that enhance the medical education and training of professionals. The work also defines the flow of development of an AR model for medical training and education.

articleTitle: Development of an Electric Automation Control Model Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The design of an AI-based electrical computerization control system is implemented to efficiently address the challenges encountered by contemporary electrical engineering. A model of an AI-based control system for electrical automation is presented. To achieve optimal control settings, the control strategy makes use of an artificial intelligence system. Even in the presence of a twenty per cent load intervention and 2.1 Hz wavelength interference, the research demonstrates that the organisation has significant anti-interference capabilities, as shown by an acceptable fail rate of 0.02 for each at the system management level. Consequently, using an AI algorithm in automated electrification control may lead to a significant improvement in control reaction time, cost savings, and efficient construction.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of Machine Learning and Deep Learning Techniques for Plant Disease Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Plant diseases have become more dangerous to both global food security and environmental stability in recent years. Currently, significant efforts are being made to identify plant diseases that are affecting various crops in different regions of the world. Researchers are currently conducting significant research to identify the causes of these disorders. Certain illnesses are characterized by the presence of viruses, whereas others are caused by fungal infections. When we fail to identify the underlying cause before it spreads to critical production areas, it becomes a significant problem. This research examines the latest progress in using ML/DL methods to identify plant diseases. The research specifically examines articles from 2016 to 2024. The studies mentioned in this paper provide evidence of the efficacy of using these strategies to enhance plant disease identification precision and efficiency. The research offers valuable insights for industry professionals, practitioners, and researchers working on plant disease detection.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Analogue Circuit Design for Stage Categorization and Evolutionary Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The goal of this study is to provide a two-stage bottom-up approach that uses machine learning to simplify the development of analogue devices. Analogue CMOS (complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor) circuit designers use their expertise to address complex problems, involving multiple factors and goals. The research delves into the possibilities of libraries housing open-source machine-learning models to aid designers and provides a framework outlining the specifics of ML-generated analogue circuits. Creating neural network designs has traditionally relied on commercialized CMOS or software simulations; however, these approaches don't guarantee optimal performance. The proposed approach is validated using a three-stage device design. In the first stage, the type is accurately predicted with a precision of 89.75% utilising a machine learning approach called the decision tree. Both of these rule induction strategies are used to generate prediction logic. The second stage involves forecasting the usual parameters for each stage type using four learning techniques: decision trees, gradient-boosted trees, random forests, and support vector machines. When compared to other approaches, the support vector machine outperforms them all while exhibiting the lowest error rates.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence-based Guiding for Advancement of Mathematics with Human Intuition
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The discipline of mathematics could undergo a revolution due to the possibility of artificial intelligence (AI) to accelerate mathematical findings and guide human intuition. An approach for applying machine learning methods to help mathematicians find patterns, formulate hypotheses, and gain understanding of complicated mathematical objects is presented in current research. Large datasets of mathematical representations are generated as part of the suggested process, which also entails training machine learning algorithms to identify patterns and decoding the functions that are learnt to extract practical mathematical knowledge. Two important new findings in representation theory and topology have already resulted from this method. This structure attempts to supplement human intuition and allow the discovery of correlations that could have gone overlooked by incorporating AI into the mathematician's arsenal. The study illustrates how well this strategy works to help mathematicians comprehend the behaviour of objects that are too big to see patterns with conventional methods.

articleTitle: Interpretation of Sign Language Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Sign language detection using machine learning has emerged as a crucial area of research aimed at bridging communication barriers between individuals with hearing impairments and the broader community. This paper explores the application of machine learning techniques for the automatic recognition and interpretation of sign language gestures. A systematic review of existing methodologies, including traditional machine learning approaches and recent advancements in deep learning architectures, reveals key challenges such as variability in signing styles, regional dialects, and real-time processing requirements. To address these challenges, we propose a novel approach that leverages convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and long short-term memory (LSTM) models, which have demonstrated significant improvements in accuracy and generalization across diverse datasets. Our experimental results show the efficacy of these models on benchmark sign language datasets, achieving high levels of accuracy and robustness in real-world conditions. Furthermore, this study discusses the potential societal impacts of sign language detection systems in education, healthcare, and everyday communication, emphasizing the role of technological innovation in fostering inclusivity. By advancing machine learning methodologies, we contribute to the development of accessible communication solutions for individuals with hearing impairments.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Machine Learning Models for Intrusion Detection in 5G Traffic
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The expanding use of 5G networks necessitates robust security measures due to their intricate architecture and enlarged attack landscape. Intrusion detection systems (IDS) are crucial for shielding these networks by pinpointing malicious traffic. This study explores the efficacy of machine learning models for intrusion detection in 5G traffic. This research employs three established machine learning algorithms: Random Forest (RF), XGBoost, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) and Histogram-based Gradient Boosting(HistGradient Boosting). We conduct a comparative analysis on both datasets, assessing their performance metrics like accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. Feature selection techniques are implemented to enhance model performance and address potential dimensionality challenges. The research tackles the class imbalance issue commonly found in intrusion detection datasets, ensuring a fair evaluation of the model’s ability to detect both normal and malicious traffic. The findings offer valuable insights into the suitability of these machine learning models for 5G network intrusion detection. We compare the strengths and weaknesses of each model across the datasets, highlighting their effectiveness in identifying diverse attack types. This research contributes to the ongoing development of reliable and efficient IDS solutions specifically designed for the security needs of 5G networks. The highest achieved accuracy is 99.97% for binary classification of "Attack type" to detect intrusion.

articleTitle: Implementing ML and IoT-Based Predictive Traffic-Management Systems for Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The exponential increase in the number of automobiles on the road has caused pollution, gridlock, and logistical transit delays in densely populated places. A new invention, the Internet of Things (IoT) is guiding the cosmos towards intelligent management systems and automated procedures. The advancement of automation and smart societies relies on this management of congestion and traffic control that are both effective and dependable and can save a lot of valuable resources. Autonomous cars and smart gadgets use an Internet of Things (IoT)-based ITM system of sensors to detect, collect, and communicate data. The transportation system may also benefit from machine learning (ML). Many problems plague current transport management methods, leading to gridlock, delays, and a high number of casualties. This study details the process of developing and launching an ATM that makes use of machine learning and the Internet of Things. Transportation, physical structures, and occurrences are the three pillars upon which the suggested system rests. The design takes into account every potential difficulty with the transportation system by using many scenarios. Using the machine learning-based DBSCAN clustering technology, the suggested ATM systems further guarantee that no inadvertent abnormalities are overlooked. The proposed ATM model can adapt the timing of the traffic lights based on current conditions as well as predicted movements at nearby crossings. Reducing traffic congestion eases vehicles over green lights and shortens travel times by improving the transition between turns. The experimental findings show that the proposed ATM system significantly outperformed the conventional traffic-management method, making it the ideal candidate for use in smart-city-based transportation planning. The proposed ATM system aims to reduce road accidents, improve the overall route experience, and minimise vehicle waiting durations.

articleTitle: Optimization Techniques and Algorithmic Control in Power Electronics for Renewable Energy Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The research area of interest covers the application of mathematical optimization, and control theory in power electronics interfacing renewable energy systems to achieve higher efficiency, reliability and system performance. In this context, the Paper’s key strengths are proposed as follows: By identifying the suitable datasets and designing the improved optimization techniques like genetic algorithm, particle swarm optimization, and neural network the proposed methodology intends to overcome the issue associated with the variability and intermittency of the renewable energy sources. Ensured to work with efficient software tools like MATLAB/Simulink and Python the methodology has undergone simulation and real world tests. Results demonstrated significant improvements: efficiency was raised to a level of 7-8%, at the same time as the cost was decreased in the range of 16%. Between 7-20%, power quality had received improvement in voltage and frequency fluctuations that was reduced to half; while the reliability factor increased to 5%. The outcomes of this study underscore the ability of multi-objective optimization in development of proper balanced solutions for the analysis of renewable energy system. Furthermore, the study stresses the necessity of a steady examination and fine-tuning process for the effective incorporation of RES into the power grid and the effective and eco-friendly power supply. As for the future works, Component performance optimization, compatibility with current infrastructure and effective control of large distributed generation should be the focus of future researches.

articleTitle: Exploring Potential of Extended Reality in Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: This review explores the possibilities of Extended Reality (XR) in healthcare, examining its various types and practical applications. From its types, uses, impacts to its security and privacy challenges. The review delves into the ethical considerations surrounding patient consent and privacy in XR applications. Despite these challenges, the paper concludes on a positive note, highlighting the transformative potential of XR in healthcare. It emphasizes the importance of addressing privacy issues through technological advancements and ethical guidelines. The future scope of XR in healthcare is given promising notes, with ongoing research and development aiming to enhance user experiences, improve medical education, and advance patient outcomes. As XR continues to evolve, this review serves as a valuable resource for understanding its current state, challenges, and the important values it holds for the future of healthcare.

articleTitle: Natural Language Processing for Sentiment Analysis in Marketing
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The use of Natural Language Processing (NLP) has become an indispensable instrument for conducting sentiment analysis in the field of marketing. This technology enables organizations to decipher and analyze the thoughts of customers based on huge amounts of unstructured data. In this study, we investigate the use of natural language processing (NLP) techniques to analyze the feelings conveyed in customer reviews, social media posts, and other forms of digital communication. Through the utilization of advanced natural language processing techniques, such as sentiment brackets, emotion detection, and opinion mining, businesses can acquire a practical understanding of the preferences and stations of their customers. The purpose of this study is to examine several natural language processing (NLP) algorithms and models, including machine literacy-based approaches and deep literacy methods, and to evaluate how effective they are at comprehending delicate feelings. Additionally, it investigates case studies that demonstrate how natural language processing (NLP)-driven sentiment analysis has been successfully implemented to improve marketing strategies, enhance client interaction, and provide valuable insights for product development. Some challenges are similar to these, such as analyzing the surroundings, discovering affronts, and doing multilingual analysis. The findings highlight the revolutionary potential of natural language processing (NLP) in the process of establishing valuable sentiment perceptivity for insights generated by data in marketing.

articleTitle: Utilization of Dynamic Spectrum for Cognitive Radio Systems Enabled by Smart Sensing
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Wireless communication and the management of radio spectrum have both been profoundly altered by the introduction of Cognitive Radio Networks (CRNs). The capacity to change transmission parameters and perform dynamic spectrum sensing are two features of cognitive radio networks (CRNs) that allow for the proactive reduction of interference and optimisation of the spectrum. This work seeks to address the challenge of managing Quality of Service (QoS) in dynamic CRN environments, where mobility is prevalent. Due to its direct impact on network running costs and sustainability, energy efficiency is emphasised as being of paramount significance in the article. The goal of the proposed SDSM system is to assist CRNs in effectively managing their energy usage without compromising service quality. Smart sensing controls cognitive user energy inside the SSDSM framework, and dynamic spectrum management governs the quality of service. Improving fuzzy-based controllers and implementing periodic sensing prompted by specified rules optimise service response time and reduce energy usage, respectively, in the suggested system. In a centralised paradigm, the network is run by a single node that is responsible for assigning channels to cognitive users and creating an appropriate list of channels using the SSDSM method.

articleTitle: Learning Style Classification: An Efficient Modeling of DNN-PCA with Facial Expressions
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Individual learning style offer insights to both students and teachers to effectively organize learning activities and materials accordingly to optimize learning process. Learning style defined students’ preferred ways to assimilate new information. E-learning systems lacks personalize feedback unlike physical learning settings where student can physical interact with their teacher. However, modern e-learning systems employed the use of learner’s model which essentially represents learners’ behaviour for decisions making to provide personalization of learning environment. Many studies used alternate approaches in identifying learning style in various learning system through varying learner behavior in order to improve personalization in learning systems. This study proposes a novel approach that affirmed the roles of facial expression and Deep Neural Network with Principal Component Analysis toward improving accuracy of learning style detection. The development of this approach harmonize both steps form learning style detection process and classification techniques which follows; data collection, pre-processing, model selection, and evaluation. The findings of this research unveil an alternate approach that uses facial expressions and Deep Neural Network with Principal Component Analysis to detect learning style. The proposed approach avails and unlocks the potential using DNN with PCA toward improving of learning style detection with facial expression.

articleTitle: Iot Based Condition Monitoring of Electrical Equipment
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: In recent years, the surveillance of the health of electrical appliances has been transformed by the Internet of Things (IoT). This investigation offers a comprehensive account of a system that employs the Internet of Things (IoT) to conduct predictive maintenance and analysis of electrical equipment. The network of interconnected sensors in the proposed system enables the real-time monitoring of a variety of operating characteristics, including temperature, current, voltage, and vibration. Upon the identification of equipment health indicators, the data collected by these sensors is transmitted to a centralised cloud platform. Sophisticated analytics and machine learning algorithms analyse the data on this platform to detect any patterns. The system's predictive warnings and real-time insights facilitate the implementation of preventive maintenance, reduce downtime, and enhance the reliability and efficacy of electrical equipment. The article explores the benefits of utilising Internet of Things (IoT) condition monitoring in industrial and utility settings. It also addresses pertinent topics, including system architecture, data processing methodologies, and other pertinent topics.

articleTitle: Protecting SDIIOT Network from Key Breach Attack by using Secret Hash Chain Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Attacks in a software-defined network (SDN) are hard to find. In light of this, this article offers a versatile modular architecture that enables DDoS attack prevention and mitigation in SDN environments. The interlinked computational devices present in the small items over the communication channel, which allows those devices to transmit industrial data, is known as the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT). Since the conversation is conducted online, security and privacy breaches are possible. As a result, the authenticated key agreement (AKA) of communicating devices is crucial. However, every IOT device is limited in computational resources, so it might be difficult to add robust privacy and security features. AKA research is now focused on forward secrecy (FS) feasibility that provides control over future keys when a secret key is compromised. IoT devices with limited resources cannot process public key cryptosystems because of intensive calculations. The primary goal of AKA with FS for IIoT is to provide a lightweight security framework. Instead of using a public key security framework, it is using multiple hash values. The security strength of the suggested framework is built on challenge-response mechanisms, one-way hash functions, and symmetric key encryption. The inclusion of this suggested architecture demonstrates that it provides a protection against a variety of attacks, secret key negotiation, anonymity, and unlinkability. The proposed approach is analyzed to assess the performance of the security framework and demonstrates that it is a lightweight mechanism for IIoT.

Author Keywords: Industrial Internet of Things; Software-Defined Network

articleTitle: Enhancing Cancer Detection with Machine Learning and Deep Learning: A Focus on Breast and Skin Cancer
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) are transforming cancer detection, offering significant improvements in early diagnosis and treatment. These technologies analyze diverse data sources to enhance accuracy, efficiency, and accessibility in cancer care. ML models have achieved remarkable accuracy in cancer detection, reaching around 96 percent sensitivity and specificity, surpassing traditional methods. By analyzing large-scale datasets, these models detect subtle patterns and biomarkers indicative of cancer, enabling earlier intervention. They also facilitate personalized medicine by developing tailored strategies based on individual patient characteristics. Automating cancer detection tasks streamlines clinical workflows, reduces diagnostic turnaround times, and eases the burden on healthcare professionals. Ongoing research continues to refine DL architectures, enabling the processing of multi-modal data and capturing complex disease patterns. The integration of multiomic data, including genomics, proteomics, and imaging, enhances our understanding of cancer biology, leading to new biomarkers and therapeutic targets. This comprehensive approach promises to revolutionize cancer diagnosis and treatment, potentially achieving an overall accuracy of around 80 percent. In conclusion, ML and DL integration in cancer detection represents a significant advancement in medical research and clinical practice, with far-reaching implications for improving patient care and outcomes.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Risk Management in Financial Markets and Fintech
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The combination of cutting-edge artificial intelligence technologies like as machine literacy, predictive analytics, and natural language processing is how we want to achieve our goal of enhancing the sensitivity and effectiveness of the processes that are engaged in threat assessment and mitigation. The study analyses the different applications of artificial intelligence, including the analysis of request data, the prediction of implicit traps, and the automation of decision-making in real-time. Among the applications that are being investigated is the analysis of request data. According to the findings of the study, artificial intelligence is a useful tool for identifying potential problems, improving portfolio operations, and achieving overall fiscal stability. This can be achieved by doing a comprehensive analysis of the methods and case studies that are currently in use. In light of the facts, it would appear that threat operations that are driven by artificial intelligence not only improve prophetic capacities but also speed up operations, reduce the chance of making errors that could result in fatalities, and increase responsiveness to request oscillations. In the process of rethinking threat operation techniques, the outcomes of this inquiry shed insight into the transformative potential of artificial intelligence. Additionally, it lays a strong platform for future advancements in financial technology, which is a significant additional benefit.

articleTitle: Exploring the development of Machine Learning Innovation Technology for Data Mining in Smart Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: In this research, machine learning (ML) modernization technology is developed for Data Mining (DM) in smart healthcare. Internet-of-things (IoT) and ML are used in contemporary technologies to support DM approaches for predicting and interpreting data from different sources. The collection of data and its application domain have an impact on these techniques’ effectiveness. The objective of this research is to examine the ML approach functions in smart healthcare and to analyze the DM technique for predicting breast cancer for smart healthcare. Initially, the datasets for breast cancer were gathered from public sources. The preprocessing of raw data samples is carried out using the min-max normalization technique. Then, follow the feature extraction stage with independent component analysis (ICA). A novel augmented beetle swarm-intelligent-driven quadratic support vector machine (ABS-QSVM) strategy is proposed to examine breast cancer. The Python platform is applied to implement the proposed method, and various metrics are analyzed. The experimental outcomes demonstrated that the ABS-QSVM approach achieved greater accuracy in healthcare examinations than other existing approaches.

Author Keywords: augmented beetle swarm-intelligent driven quadratic support vector machine (ABS-QSVM)

articleTitle: Enhancing Consumer Interaction with AI Chatbots: Investigating the Impact of Human-Like Attributes, Social Connectivity, and Engagement Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Through the utilization of chatbots powered by artificial intelligence, the objective of this study is to evaluate the influence that human-like traits, social connectivity, and engagement dynamics have on consumer commerce. Because the use of chatbots powered by artificial intelligence in customer service is becoming less widespread, it is necessary to have a solid understanding of the factors that contribute to a positive experience for stoners. This study's objective is to research how the utilization of mortal-like features, such as validated answers and emotional intelligence, can lead to the establishment of a more profound connection between chatbots and individuals who use drugs. In addition to this, it investigates the role that social connectivity plays in the process of developing trust and fellowship with clients, as well as the ability of chatbots to replicate social interactions. The goal of this inquiry is to identify key aspects that are vital to the continued commerce and satisfaction of customers over an extended time. Performing an analysis of engagement dynamics, such as reaction time and conversation inflow, will be conducted to achieve this goal. The findings offer valuable insights into the construction of more artificial intelligence chatbots that are not only successful but also engaging. This will ultimately lead to dramatically enhanced levels of customer satisfaction and loyalty.

articleTitle: Sustainable Development Goals and Their Significance for Students of Sustainability and the Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The United Nations has officially approved and adopted 20 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) to tackle the most urgent global challenges faced by humanity. For these objectives to be realised, it is critical that those who will have power in society in the future value them. Students' priorities in 41 nations with strong environmental sectors were thus assessed in this research. A triangulation of the SDGs reflecting the three cornerstones of sustainability social, economic, and environmental was achieved via the examination of these evaluations. According to conventional wisdom, these three tenets are of differing degrees of significance between nations. The correlations between country-specific metrics like the index of human development and the assessments of these higher-level characteristics. The SDGs are seen as less essential in nations with higher indices compared to those with lower indices, according to the connections between indicators and the upper-level components. Stakeholders may use these findings as a roadmap for promoting the SDGs in their nation.

articleTitle: Generative AI for Synthetic Data Generation in IoT-Based Healthcare Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Due to adoption of IoT in healthcare systems, patients’ care has been improved by monitoring and constant data acquiring in real time. Nevertheless, some issues like data privacy and security and data accessibility impede the usage of IoT data. To this end, this research outlines a robust framework for the generation of synthetic data with the help of generative AI methods, namely GANs and VAEs appropriate for the context of IoT-based healthcare applications. The framework also tackles the privacy issue since the methods used, namely differential privacy, protects information of an individual while maintaining usefulness. Some of the activities include data collection and preparation, model training and development, synthetic data generation, plus testing, and validation techniques. The generated synthetic data captures similar characteristics as the original data as well as important patterns that can be used to improve model building exercising and validating. Altogether the experimental results show how the synthetic data with the same characteristics can be useful in different healthcare situations while keeping high fidelities and utility. This paper demonstrates ways in which synthetic data can revolutionalize healthcare through secure opening of data for innovation and quality improvement of patients’ care.

articleTitle: Harnessing Gradient Boosting for Precision Date Classification: A Path to Sustainable Data-Driven Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: This study presents a classification technique for date varieties using Gradient Boosting, a robust ensemble learning technique. The classification model is evaluated on a dataset comprising various date types, and the performance metrics are detailed through recall, precision and F1-scores for each class. The Gradient Boosting model exhibits high precision and recall across most classes, with notable performance for the DOKOL (F1-score: 0.95) and ROTANA (F1-score: 0.96) varieties, demonstrating its capability to distinguish these dates effectively. SAFAVI also indicates outstanding results with a high recall of 0.98, perfect precision of 1.00 . reflecting the model's performance in identifying this class. Conversely, the DEGLET and SOGAY classes present lower performance, with DEGLET achieving an F1-score of 0.68 and SOGAY 0.64, indicating areas where the model's predictive accuracy could be improved. The overall accuracy of the Gradient Boosting model is 89%, highlighting its strong classification capability across the dataset. The macro average F1-score of 0.85 underscores balanced performance, while the weighted average F1-score of 0.89 aligns closely with the overall accuracy, affirming the model's accuracy in distinguishing between different date varieties.

articleTitle: AI and IoT Enabled Soil Health Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: This paper reviews the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Internet of Things (IoT) technologies in soil health restoration systems. We analyze the smart sensing, data communication, and artificial intelligence systems which are used for soil classification and forecasting models. The use-definition connected with the precision agriculture, including the efficient irrigation and nutrient supply, is elaborated. New technologies like remote sensing and eco acoustics are also utilized for soil monitoring. The report describes the prospects of these systems as a way to increase agrarian sustainability despite the technical and operational problems that arise. The authors recommend possible interventions regarding the incorporation of AI and IoT in soil health management going forward.

articleTitle: AI Powered Recommender Systems for E-commerce
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The disruptive influence that artificial intelligence-powered recommender systems can have on e-commerce platforms. The delivery of largely individualized buying gestures is accomplished by these systems by the utilization of sophisticated machine learning algorithms, which analyze enormous numbers of stoner data. When it comes to artificial intelligence, we investigate several methods, such as cooperative filtering, content-based filtering, and mongrel models, that improve the quality of recommendations and the level of satisfaction experienced by stoners. The research underlines the importance of having a high level of reading to comprehend the tastes of stoners and to forecast the purchases of unborn children. In the same vein, it examines the difficulties that will be encountered while implementing AI recommender systems. These difficulties include data sequestration businesses, algorithmic impulses, and scalability. The article explains how e-commerce businesses may optimize their recommendation machines to promote client engagement and increase deals by using case studies and empirical analysis to illustrate the effectiveness of these optimization strategies. In the end, this investigation highlights the significance of artificial intelligence in revolutionizing online buying, providing valuable insight for organizations that are looking to improve their competitive edge in the digital market.

articleTitle: A Review on Cooperative Network using Noma (Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access) Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: For upcoming 5G networks, the non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) system seems like an appropriate multiple access technique. Enhanced data rate, decreased latency, improved connectivity, user fairness, and spectrum efficiency are all provided by NOMA. For performance enhancement, Cooperation in wireless network is known as proven technique and this can be achieved by cooperative network. Interference is the main challenge in 5G networks that affects quality of service in many 4G and 5G applications. The increasing need of bandwidth requirement, data rates and more deployment of to multimedia application led to a non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) scheme that provides better spectral efficiency, fulfil bandwidth requirement and provides interference cancellation. Our study suggest that NOMA technique provides better response when used cooperative relaying, power domain and with other variants. The paper provides an overview of cooperative network using NOMA technique and also provides an insight of future research directions of this area. In our study we discussed various types of cooperative networks, NOMA variant system and latest work done in the area and also possibility of future research work directions in this field.

articleTitle: Sustainable Agriculture through Affordable, Real-Time Crop Health Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: This paper introduces a low-cost, Arduino-based crop health monitoring system designed to optimize agricultural productivity through collection and analysis of data in real-time. The system integrates essential sensors to measuremoisture content of soil, pH levels, temperature, rainfall, and nutrient content (NPK), providing comprehensive insights into crop health. Through the use of Internet of Things (IoT), computer vision, and machine learning (ML) technologies, the device not only monitors but also predicts crop health, offering actionable recommendations for irrigation and nutrient management. This innovative approach aims to make advanced agricultural technology accessible to small and medium-sized farms, promoting sustainability and enhancing crop yields. The system's adaptability to various crops and soil conditions, coupled with its user-friendly interface, positions it as a vital tool in modern precision agriculture.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Liver Cancer Detection using Neural Network Algorithm and Correlation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The fast development of machine learning and AI in recent years has made it a widely used method. Because of its widespread use and effective pattern recognition and classification techniques, big institutions have begun funding research in the healthcare sector to boost the precision with which illnesses may be predicted. However, there are a number of difficulties in applying these methods. A significant barrier is the lack of a sufficient medical picture data set. This paper aims to provide a modest introduction to deep learning in medical image processing, including both the theoretical foundations and practical implementations of this technique. This thesis explores various major advances in computer science that contribute to the widespread appeal of deep learning (DL). This sheds light on the causes behind deep learning’s meteoric rise in numerous application fields, including medical image processing. The aim was to deploy new methodologies on existing cancer datasets to see if machine learning and deep learning algorithms might be used for the detection of cancer. The purpose of this study was to classify cancer using many text and picture datasets. Liver BUPA disease database is the dataset that is processed using various machine learning and deep learning models. In this paper, we provide optimization algorithms that outperform the existing strategies in terms of efficiency.

articleTitle: AI for Enhanced Customer Experience in Banking
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The customer experience is changing as a result of artificial intelligence (AI) in banking. Transparent, effective, and secure services are being offered to achieve this. This article’s goal is to examine how artificial intelligence technologies are being used in the banking sector. These technologies include, among other things, machine literacy algorithms, chatbots, and predictive analytics. It investigates how artificial intelligence-driven solutions that provide individualized financial advice, real-time support, and fraud detection systems may enhance client connections. The study highlights several advantages of artificial intelligence. These advantages include the potential to lower the costs of functional operations, improve customer satisfaction, and streamline banking procedures. Through an analysis of case studies and current AI operations, the investigation demonstrates important trends and prospects for AI in the banking sector. Artificial Intelligence is used to achieve this. The results show that the implementation of artificial intelligence can greatly enhance banks' capacities to provide customer service. This will eventually lead to increased client loyalty and a competitive edge for the banks. Upon the conclusion of the article, recommendations are made to financial institutions for the application of artificial intelligence (AI) to optimize client advantages and operational efficiency.

articleTitle: Role of AI assisted ChatGPT in revolutionizing Data Science Field
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: ChatGPT is a conversational AI interface that utilises natural language processing and machine learning is the talk of the town across a wide range of sectors. ChatGPT provide readers a glimpse of ChatGPT's benefits, convey a description of the possible advantages and disadvantages related to utilising it in data science, and spark interest in using it for data science projects given the model's likely impact on the field.Using ChatGPT with AI assistance provides a workable method for automating facts and technical know-how. Record unit validation, analysis, exploration, and statistics processing may all be automated with ChatGPT's AI assistance. It eliminates the need for data scientists to manually sort through vast amounts of numbers in order to manage them. In data technological know-how activities, ChatGPT uses AI to help recognise styles, uncover insights, and optimise algorithms. To swiftly evaluate the effects of changes and pinpoint instant successes, they might also scale up and automate predictive and prescriptive analytics. It is now possible for agencies to use statistics-driven decision-making and advanced analytics to propel their agency forward with the help of AI-assisted ChatGPT. The findings indicate increased customer satisfaction and improved performance, with new possibilities for automation and optimization and includes the speed at which the systems process and analyse data as well as the amount of time it takes to use the system. Improved accuracy, increased performance overall across information technology approaches using ChatGPT.

articleTitle: Assessing the Impact of Print Media in the Digital Era: An AI-Driven Analysis of Millennial Buying Decisions
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The purpose of this exploratory article is to investigate the impact that print media has on the purchasing decisions of Millennials in the context of the digital geography of the present moment. By utilizing sophisticated methods of artificial intelligence, the research analyses how traditional print advertising influences the purchasing decisions of Millennials, taking into consideration the widespread nature of digital media. The purpose of this article is to provide insight into the relative success of print marketing in comparison to digital marketing by analyzing data from colorful print media juggernauts and their related digital relations. In the investigation that is driven by artificial intelligence, the complexities of Millennials' responses to print media are brought to light, illustrating how it either complements or clashes with digital influences. The findings are intended to provide a nuanced perspective on the effectiveness of media in forming ultramodern consumer opinions, with the ultimate goal of guiding marketers in optimizing their tactics by gaining a grasp of the solidarity between print and digital platforms.

articleTitle: Cognitive Computing for Marketing Decision Support
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The use of artificial intelligence (AI) in cognitive computing allows for the simulation of human learning processes and the improvement of decision-making across a comprehensive range of fields. Within the context of marketing decision support, this study investigates the application of cognitive computing and focuses on how advanced artificial intelligence technologies might transform marketing tactics. Cognitive computing systems provide practical perceptivity that may be used to inform strategic opinions, maximize campaign performance, and exemplify client relations. This is accomplished by analyzing enormous datasets and observing patterns in consumer gestures. For this article, case studies that demonstrate the efficacy of cognitive computing in predicting request trends, segmenting target demographics, and perfecting client engagement are reviewed. Additionally, it addresses the issues that are associated with implementing cognitive computing in marketing, such as the integration of data, the transparency of algorithms, and ethical considerations being taken into account. According to the findings, cognitive computing presents a great opportunity for improving marketing decision-making processes, which in turn facilitates the development of strategies that are both better informed and more effective. The investigation of new directions for exploration includes the investigation of developments in cognitive computing technologies and the integration of these technologies with emerging marketing tools and platforms.

articleTitle: Supervised Learning for Customized Educational Content
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The operation of supervised literacy methods to develop individualized educational content that is adapted to the requirements of each student. To analyze the many datasets that include student performance criteria, learning preferences, and commerce patterns, we make use of machine literacy algorithms. Our process involves training models to predict the information that will be most beneficial for each learner, which ultimately results in improvements to educational challenges. The purpose of this paper is to provide a complete evaluation of several supervised literacy approaches, such as decision trees, support vector machines, and neural networks, to determine the effectiveness of these approaches in incorporating pedagogical strategies. When employing customised content that is developed through these approaches, the outcomes reveal considerable increases in the level of engagement and appreciation that students have for the material. In addition to this, we discuss the practical counterarguments to the incorporation of supervised literacy in educational technology and figure out the implicit future exploration routes. The findings of this study highlight the potential role that artificial intelligence could play in transforming education by making learning more adaptable and responsive to the specific needs of each individual.

articleTitle: Role of AI enabled HR Analytics in Re-inventing Human Resource Management
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Traditional human resource management processes are being revolutionised as a result of the incorporation of artificial intelligence (AI) into human resource analytics. The purpose of this study is to investigate the transformative element of AI-enabled HR analytics in the context of rethinking the fundamental roles of human resource management. By utilising technology that is powered by artificial intelligence, organisations can improve data-driven decision-making, improve gift accession, and optimise hand performance and engagement. The purpose of this project is to investigate how artificial intelligence-driven perceptivity can facilitate extra individualised hand gestures, simplify reclamation procedures, and provide support for predictive analytics for pool planning. In addition, the study investigates the difficulties and ethical concerns that are linked with the implementation of AI in human resources, with a particular focus on the importance of transparency and justice. Specifically, the findings highlight the potential for artificial intelligence to not only improve efficiency but also to encourage a more strategic and forward-thinking approach to human resource management. Providing interpreters and scholars working on the subject with new perspectives, this investigation contributes to the ongoing conversation about how artificial intelligence is influencing the future of human resources.

articleTitle: Improving Rice Disease Classification through Data Augmentation in Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The worldwide production of rice is seriously threatened by rice leaf diseases, which calls for effective and precise detection techniques. This study investigates the detection of these diseases using advanced models like Xception and InceptionV3 and CNN. We compared the performance of each model with and without data augmentation. According to the findings, InceptionV3 with data augmentation had best accuracy at 83.33%, while InceptionV3 without augmentation had the lowest accuracy at 80.00%. Additionally, Xception with enhancement did well, scoring 76.67%. This research presents an effective method for automating agricultural disease management by demonstrating how integrating advanced deep learning techniques with data augmentation can enhance the precision of identifying rice leaf diseases.

articleTitle: Enhanced Cyber-Physical System Security for Next-Generation Healthcare IT Using a Deep Learning Technique Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The goal of utilising cyber-physical systems (CPSs) is to improve efficiency and effectiveness in many areas, both quantitative and qualitative, including technical and organisational ones. This is accomplished by integrating physical components and processes with computing facilities and data storage. A crucial opportunity for CPS to succeed has arisen due to the proliferation of the web and the expanding network made possible by the Internet of Things (IoT). Progress in these systems should undeniably focus on making them efficient and secure, even if this technology is already used in programmed pilot flying, sophisticated mechanical contexts, clinical checking, current control systems, etc. Experts may improve these systems' robustness, trustworthiness, and security by combining the CPS with blockchain technology, which incorporates a combination of consensus computations, secure standards, and disseminated information capacity. An effective blockchain-based deep learning method for medical cyber-physical systems (CPS) is presented here. The method consists of two main parts: (a) a security framework that encrypts medical data and (b) a classifier that uses these features to conduct anomaly scans. The experimental assessment shows that the proposed system achieves better results than the current models, with a sensitivity score of 0.95 and an accuracy rate of 0.96.

articleTitle: Enhancing Hostel Security: Integration of Deep Learning Models for Smoking and Violence Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Security and safety are paramount concerns in hostels, necessitating the development of advanced monitoring systems.
