This research paper presents a novel hostel monitoring system employing two deep learning models trained using You only look once algorithm (YOLOv5). The first model focuses on object detection and accurately identifies smoking instances by detecting individuals holding cigarettes, achieving an impressive accuracy of 93%. The second model, designed to detect violent behavior, achieved an accuracy of 94%. By seamlessly integrating these models into the monitoring system, administrators can proactively identify and respond to potential threats in real-time. The system's robust performance in detecting smoking and violence contributes to fostering a secure and safe environment for hostel residents. Future research can explore further applications and enhancements to maximize the system's capabilities and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Drug Targets Prediction of Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Rv Using In Silico Genome Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Mycobacterium tuberculosis, the causal agent of tuberculosis, is a major global health concern. The most widely studied strain for understanding the mechanism of drug resistance is H37Rv. To identify possible therapeutic targets, in silico analyses of Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Rv genome were carried out. The genome sequence was downloaded from the website of NCBI (National Center for Biotechnology Information). To identify essential genes, the DEG (Database of Essential Genes) was consulted. Additionally, homology searches with the human genome were conducted using BLASTX. Out of a total of 3924 genes, 594 were determined to be essential for Mycobacterium tuberculosis, of which 366 had no sequence similarity to the human genome. Out of 366 genes, 242 potential drug targets have been found after being screened for fictitious and unidentified genes.

articleTitle: Hybrid Deep Learning Models to Recognise the Solar Power Quality Distribution by Integrating Power System
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Modern energy supplies are intricately built to accommodate the always-growing demand for energetic strength and technological progress. This predicament has made the plan of capacity quality in the energetic capacity arrangement more influential. This study provides a deep education-located whole that can discover capacity quality disturbances (PQDs) in SPV plants related to the capacity gridiron. The PQDs endanger constant wavelet translate (CWT) study, and CWT scalograms are used to produce picture files. Afterwards, a composite deep knowledge method that utilises convolutional affecting animate nerve organs networks (CNNs), neighbour component reasonings (NCAs), and support heading machines (SVMs) is used to recognize PQDs in these picture files. AlexNet and GoogLeNet are fed the picture files as input in a hybrid deep-learning strategy. Features extracted from each architecture's last dropout layer undergo NCA processing. The SVM method is used for classifying the unique characteristics that are acquired during the NCA procedure. Using a changed IEEE 13-bus test method that includes the SPV models, PQD data is gathered to assess the suggested technique. The effectiveness of the recommended method is confirmed by doing many comparisons and analyses. Even when the SPV plant combined power system negatively impacts power quality, the proposed hybrid deep learning method can still correctly identify PQDs.

articleTitle: Exploring Effective Decision-Making Techniques in Learning Environment: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Effective decision-making within learning environments is crucial for optimizing educational outcomes and fostering student success. This comprehensive review examined the current landscape of decision-making strategies employed in educational settings in relation to its theoretical underpinnings, practical implementations, advantages, drawbacks, and pertinence to the intricate educational context. The review emphasizes the significance of developing a comprehensive comprehension of various decision-making methodologies and their possible synergistic effects in order to make well-informed and efficient decisions in the field of education. The review explores the theoretical foundations of decision-making strategies in educational contexts, highlighting their impact on teaching practices, curriculum development, student assessment, and organizational management. Additionally, it discusses emerging trends and innovations in decision science that hold promise for enhancing decision-making processes within learning environments. Through a critical analysis of existing research, this review identifies both strengths and limitations of current decision-making strategies in education, shedding light on areas for improvement and future research directions. Furthermore, it underscores the importance of evidence-based decision-making and the need for ongoing professional development to equip educational stakeholders with the skills and knowledge necessary to make informed decisions in dynamic learning environments.

articleTitle: Impact of COVID-19 Pandemic in India Challenges and Future Directions
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) is the infectious disease that is causing the worldwide coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic. Novel coronavirus (nCoV) cases were initially reported in China in December 2019, and the virus has since spread quickly to other nations throughout the globe. As a result, on January 30, 2020, the World Health Organization (WHO) declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), and on March 11, 2020, it classified the outbreak as a pandemic (Source: WHO). Normal daily life has been disrupted by the COVID-19 epidemic. Various actions are being taken by nations to break the COVID-19 virus from spreading. The Indian government imposed a nationwide lockdown to hearten social distancing. Because of these unfavorable circumstances, the nation suffered in a number of areas, including healthcare, education, and social systems. The current study discusses the numerous effects of COVID-19 on the social life of citizens, the healthcare system, the school system, and the economy. The most noteworthy effects that were mentioned were better family dynamics, financial loss, and disruptions in the schooling of the children. Few respondents mentioned negative effects on their health, such as worsening symptoms and skipping hospital visits. COVID-19 had a serious negative impact on tourism as well. For the sample of people who are still making a living from this industry, the predictable loss in total income ranges between 3.12 and 6.39%, while the estimated decline in wages runs between 3.21 and 5.98%.

articleTitle: The Implication of Multimedia in the Information Revolution
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: The Information Revolution has been greatly influenced by advancements in the integrated use of various media, including documents, images, and audiovisual content transmitted via radio waves and television. Multimedia enhances ideas by making facts more charming and accessible, aiding better understanding and memory. The unification of the combined use of several media into digital terraces has transformed using what interacts with accompanying facts, making it an indispensable aspect of the new information countryside. This research explores the importance of multimedia, an advanced technology that is present in people's lives regularly. Explore the whole article to get a deeper understanding of the role and influence of multimedia in educational settings, professional environments, and other contexts. This study investigates and broadens the understanding of the importance of multimedia by using primary data collection methods, online journals, and publications. The advancement of technology in the modern world has shown the powerful use of multimedia. The internet and social media have been major catalysts for the advancements in multimedia. The use of multimedia is advantageous in converting images and other types of unorganised data into practical information, given the exponential growth of such data. This article serves as a valuable resource for anyone who has an interest in expanding their knowledge of multimedia and its significant impacts on both business and academics. The research demonstrates that external stakeholders may use technology innovation to stimulate and guide innovation inside firms.

articleTitle: Optimizing Facial Age Recognition: A Deep Convolutional Approach to Accurate and Robust Age Group Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Essential technology having uses in security, tailored services, and demographic analysis is age identification from facial photos. This paper introduces a fresh method to improve age categorization accuracy by use of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). The proposed approach reduces spatial dimensions and emphasizes important aspects by first using CNN architecture with several convolutional layers to extract hierarchical features from facial images. Dense layers at last classify into three age categories: YOUNG, MIDDLE, and OLD, ending the architecture. Resizing, normalizing, and augmenting data pretreatment methods help to increase generalizing and model resilience. Using a classification report, which displays an overall accuracy of 82%, the efficacy of the model is assessed. For every age group, reports of precision, recall, and F1-scores highlight great performance. The MIDDLE category displays an accuracy of 0.81 and recall of 0.89; the OLD category reaches a precision of 0.80 and recall of 0.60; the YOUNG category has a precision of 0.84 and recall of 0.78. By use of their capacity to learn intricate feature representations, these results show the ability of the model to precisely categorize age groups based on facial characteristics, hence transcending conventional approaches. In many useful applications, this method promises great accuracy and dependability as well as notable developments in facial age identification.

articleTitle: Utilizing Machine Learning to Analyze Investor Sentiment and Detect Market Anomalies
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: This research paper's goal is to examine machine learning techniques and how they are used to gauge investor sentiment and identify market abnormalities. Strong machine learning methods are used in this research project to assess sentiment trends and how they affect consumer behavior. Large datasets drawn from trade activity, social media, and financial news are used to carry out this review. The purpose of this study is to identify emotional patterns in investors that are associated with anomalous market movements, like abrupt price changes or volatility spikes. This study's goal is to try and pinpoint these trends. This study assesses several machine learning algorithms to find out how effectively they can forecast these anomalies. Neural networks, Random Forests, and Support Vector Machines (SVM) were some of these techniques. The sentiment analysis module performed incredibly well; the SVM classifier accurately predicted. Consequently, the research provides valuable perspectives on the real-world implementation of these algorithms in the financial markets. The results enhance our comprehension of the connection between market dynamics and investor mood, which benefits the creation of more efficient risk management strategies and better-informed decision-making by financial institutions and investors alike. The results of this study show that machine learning has the potential to be a useful tool for enhancing market analysis and identifying early warning signs of market disruptions. Machine learning is capable of serving as this kind of tool.

articleTitle: Proactive Congestion Management in Next-Generation Wireless Networks: Evaluating Traditional Approaches Against Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: sensible congestion control approaches continue to be imperative in attaining the highest capability of the next-generation facilities for wireless networks. To this end, the objective of the present research is to establish the effectiveness of the study conducted with classical congestion management techniques to that of the machine models. The proposed work environments a novel and controlled setup of the next-generation wireless network and applies, assesses, and optimizes the traditional QoS and traffic-shaping methodologies, and generic AI forms of the supervised learning and reinforcement learning. Other standards that were utilized and incorporated in the efficient aspect included the latency, through put and packet loss with the view of evaluating efficiency levels of the employed methods. This simply measures that the use of ML is more superior to the conventional methods because it relieves latency and packet loss while at times enhancing through put. The analysis of the two states’ comparison proof that congestion recovery problems are more fit for the application of ML algorithms in modern transport systems due to better flexibility and online decision-making chances. Nevertheless, it discusses some problems that exist and they include; The major challenge of how to integrate the ML model in the system and the need to obtain massive training data. Therefore, one can state that the approach of applying more preventive ML models in controlling congestion also appears to be wiser when it comes to deploying lesions over wireless networks from the viewpoints of efficiency and scalability. Future work includes: working with real data; further work on the Advanced ML section; Security and Compliance.

articleTitle: Improving Stock Price Prediction Accuracy Using Multivalued Regression: The Role of Normalization Techniques in Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Due to price volatility and multifactor, stock price prediction is difficult in financial markets. This paper explores the use of multivalued regression models for stock price forecasting, with a particular focus on improving prediction accuracy through the application of various data normalization techniques. Normalization plays a crucial role in machine learning by ensuring that different features are on a comparable scale, which can enhance model convergence and generalization. In this study, we employ multivalued regression as the primary forecasting method, as it offers flexibility in handling multiple continuous outputs. Min-Max scaling, Z-score normalization, and robust scaling are tested for model performance. Hyper parameter tweaking optimizes regression models to minimize prediction errors across numerous stock datasets. We optimize the regression models using hyper parameter tuning, aiming to minimize prediction errors across multiple stock datasets. Through comprehensive experimentation, we demonstrate that the choice of normalization technique significantly affects the prediction accuracy of multivalued regression models. Our findings reveal that specific normalization methods can improve model performance by reducing over fitting and improving the model's ability to generalize to unseen data. The results highlight the importance of selecting appropriate data preprocessing methods to achieve reliable and accurate stock price forecasts. This research contributes to the growing field of financial machine learning by offering insights into how normalization techniques can enhance stock price prediction when applied to multivalued regression models. The study’s findings could help financial analysts, traders, and researchers develop more robust predictive models for complex market conditions.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Feature-Selection Method Based on mRMR and Binary Peacock Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: An essential aspect of developing effective biomarkers that facilitate disease diagnosis and drug discovery is identifying the most critical characteristics from microarray data. Since it is expensive to validate biomarkers, the number of biomarkers must be reduced while retaining their effectiveness. A common challenge with microarray data is that it results in a large number of properties, known as the curse of dimensionality. Almost all the feature selection (FS) techniques developed up-to-date do not possess the ability to result in lower dimensionality, ensure sound classification, easy algorithms and exhaustive search of the parameter space. This study describes a hybrid FS approach by combining the mRMR and binary variant of the peacock algorithm (Binary POA) algorithm. It introduces mRMR by modifying its quantization functions to the continuous nature of the microarray data attribute and uses mRMR as a first step to normalize both datasets and select an initial feature subset. In the following step, a binary POA algorithm is deployed to optimize the selected feature subset. The performance of the proposed mRMR-BPOA ML model is evaluated using benchmark classifier Support Vector Machine. The Result analysis proves that the performance of mRMR-BPOA is superior to the existing counterparts.

articleTitle: AI-Enabled Autonomous Navigation Systems for Space Exploration
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference Computational and Characterization Techniques in Engineering & Sciences (IC3TES)
abstract: Intelligent autonomous navigation systems that are AI-enabled may be considered equal to great revolution in space exploration and should be given momentum because these systems are able to operate independently and also do what is expected of them at a particular time. This paper presents the design philosophy which is to construct such systems based on the integration of several sensors, the utilization of modern machine learning techniques, and the employment of strong path planning and hazard detection mechanism. Extensive simulations and testing help get a grip on the dramatic drops in performance and reliability of the spacecraft during struggle with the aggressive space environment.
